name: Acolyte
desc: Acolytes are junior members of a clergy, usually answerable to a priest. They perform a variety of functions in a temple and are granted minor spellcasting power by their deities.

special_abilities.name: Spellcasting

The acolyte is a 1st-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 12, +4 to hit with spell attacks). The acolyte has following cleric spells prepared:

special_abilities.name: Amphibious
special_abilities.desc: The aboleth can breathe air and water.

special_abilities.desc: While underwater, the aboleth is surrounded by transformative mucus. A creature that touches the aboleth or that hits it with a melee attack while within 5 ft. of it must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the creature is diseased for 1d4 hours. The diseased creature can breathe only underwater.

special_abilities.name: Probing Telepathy
special_abilities.desc: If a creature communicates telepathically with the aboleth, the aboleth learns the creature's greatest desires if the aboleth can see the creature.

actions.desc: The aboleth makes three tentacle attacks.

actions.name: Tentacle
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or become diseased. The disease has no effect for 1 minute and can be removed by any magic that cures disease. After 1 minute, the diseased creature's skin becomes translucent and slimy, the creature can't regain hit points unless it is underwater, and the disease can be removed only by heal or another disease-curing spell of 6th level or higher. When the creature is outside a body of water, it takes 6 (1d12) acid damage every 10 minutes unless moisture is applied to the skin before 10 minutes have passed.

actions.name: Tail
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Enslave
actions.desc:
The aboleth targets one creature it can see within 30 ft. of it. The target must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be magically charmed by the aboleth until the aboleth dies or until it is on a different plane of existence from the target. The charmed target is under the aboleth's control and can't take reactions, and the aboleth and the target can communicate telepathically with each other over any distance.
Whenever the charmed target takes damage, the target can repeat the saving throw. On a success, the effect ends. No more than once every 24 hours, the target can also repeat the saving throw when it is at least 1 mile away from the aboleth.

legendary_actions.name: Detect
legendary_actions.desc: The aboleth makes a Wisdom (Perception) check.

legendary_actions.name: Tail Swipe
legendary_actions.desc: The aboleth makes one tail attack.

legendary_actions.name: Psychic Drain (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: One creature charmed by the aboleth takes 10 (3d6) psychic damage, and the aboleth regains hit points equal to the damage the creature takes.

actions.desc:
The sphinx emits a magical roar. Each time it roars before finishing a long rest, the roar is louder and the effect is different, as detailed below. Each creature within 500 feet of the sphinx and able to hear the roar must make a saving throw.

First Roar. Each creature that fails a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw is frightened for 1 minute. A frightened creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

Second Roar. Each creature that fails a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw is deafened and frightened for 1 minute. A frightened creature is paralyzed and can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

Third Roar. Each creature makes a DC 18 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 44 (8d10) thunder damage and is knocked prone. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and isn't knocked prone.

name: Archmage
desc:
Archmages are powerful (and usually quite old) spellcasters dedicated to the study of the arcane arts. Benevolent ones counsel kings and queens, while evil ones rule as tyrants and pursue lichdom. Those who are neither good nor evil sequester themselves in remote towers to practice their magic without interruption. 

An archmage typically has one or more apprentice mages, and an archmage’s abode has numerous magical wards and guardians to discourage interlopers.

name: Bandit Captain
desc:
It takes a strong personality, ruthless cunning, and a silver tongue to keep a gang of bandits in line. The **bandit captain** has these qualities in spades.

In addition to managing a crew of selfish malcontents, the **pirate captain** is a variation of the bandit captain, with a ship to protect and command. To keep the crew in line, the captain must mete out rewards and punishment on a regular basis.

More than treasure, a bandit captain or pirate captain craves infamy. A prisoner who appeals to the captain’s vanity or ego is more likely to be treated fairly than a prisoner who does not or claims not to know anything of the captain’s colorful reputation.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The captain makes three melee attacks: two with its scimitar and one with its dagger. Or the captain makes two ranged attacks with its daggers.

actions.name: Scimitar
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.desc: The captain adds 2 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it. To do so, the captain must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

content: Bandit Captain is a Medium humanoid with any race subtype and any non-lawful alignment. This formidable leader is armed with Studded Leather Armor providing an armor class of 15 and has 65 hit points. With a proficiency bonus of 2, the captain excels in saving throws for STR, DEX, and WIS, as well as skills in Athletics and Deception. Multiattack allows the captain to make three melee attacks with a scimitar and dagger, or two ranged attacks with daggers. The Scimitar deals 1d6+3 slashing damage, while the Dagger inflicts 1d4+3 piercing damage. The captain's defensive prowess includes the Parry reaction, adding 2 to its AC against melee attacks. This versatile foe boasts strengths in strength, dexterity, constitution, intelligence, charisma, and a passive perception of 10. A charismatic and cunning figure, the Bandit Captain craves infamy and rewards those who acknowledge their colorful reputation.

name: Assassin
desc: Trained in the use of poison, assassins are remorseless killers who work for nobles, guildmasters, sovereigns, and anyone else who can afford them.
languages: Thieves' cant plus any two languages

special_abilities.name: Assassinate
special_abilities.desc: During its first turn, the assassin has advantage on attack rolls against any creature that hasn't taken a turn. Any hit the assassin scores against a surprised creature is a critical hit.

special_abilities.name: Evasion
special_abilities.desc: If the assassin is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, the assassin instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if it fails.

special_abilities.name: Sneak Attack (1/Turn)
special_abilities.desc: The assassin deals an extra 13 (4d6) damage when it hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 ft. of an ally of the assassin that isn't incapacitated and the assassin doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The assassin makes two shortsword attacks.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw, taking 24 (7d6) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Light Crossbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw, taking 24 (7d6) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

content: The Assassin is a Medium humanoid of any race with an alignment of any non-good alignment. Trained in the use of poison, assassins are remorseless killers who work for nobles, guildmasters, sovereigns, and anyone else who can afford them. They wear Studded Leather Armor with an armor class of 15 and have 78 hit points. Their proficiency bonus is 3 and have a challenge rating of 8. With a proficiency in Dexterity saving throws and skills like Acrobatics, Deception, Perception, and Stealth, they excel in stealth and precision. The Assassin's special abilities include Assassinate, Evasion, and Sneak Attack, making them deadly adversaries. They have a passive perception of 13 and speak Thieves' cant plus any two languages. In combat, they make two shortsword attacks or use a Light Crossbow, dealing poison damage on failed saving throws. With a mix of lethal skills and cunning tactics, the Assassin is a formidable foe.

name: Balor
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons

special_abilities.name: Death Throes
special_abilities.desc: When the balor dies, it explodes, and each creature within 30 feet of it must make a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw, taking 70 (20d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The explosion ignites flammable objects in that area that aren't being worn or carried, and it destroys the balor's weapons.

special_abilities.name: Fire Aura
special_abilities.desc: At the start of each of the balor's turns, each creature within 5 feet of it takes 10 (3d6) fire damage, and flammable objects in the aura that aren't being worn or carried ignite. A creature that touches the balor or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 10 (3d6) fire damage.

special_abilities.name: Magic Resistance
special_abilities.desc: The balor has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

special_abilities.name: Magic Weapons
special_abilities.desc: The balor's weapon attacks are magical.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The balor makes two attacks: one with its longsword and one with its whip.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (3d8 + 8) slashing damage plus 13 (3d8) lightning damage. If the balor scores a critical hit, it rolls damage dice three times, instead of twice.

actions.name: Whip
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d6 + 8) slashing damage plus 10 (3d6) fire damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 20 Strength saving throw or be pulled up to 25 feet toward the balor.

actions.name: Teleport
actions.desc: The balor magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

content: Balor is a Huge fiend subtype demon with chaotic evil alignment, boasting a natural armor class of 19 and a whopping 262 hit points from 21d12 hit dice. This formidable creature has a speed of 40 ft. walking and 80 ft. flying, along with strength of 26, dexterity of 15, constitution of 22, intelligence of 20, wisdom of 16, and charisma of 22. Balor excels in saving throws for STR, CON, WIS, and CHA, as well as boasting cold, lightning, fire, and poison resistances, along with immunity to fire and poison damage. Not to mention, it is immune to the poisoned condition and has a challenge rating of 19. Balor's special abilities include Death Throes, Fire Aura, Magic Resistance, and Magic Weapons, while its actions involve Multiattack with a longsword and whip, both of which deal slashing and fire damage. Additionally, Balor can teleport up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space.

name: Basilisk

special_abilities.name: Petrifying Gaze
special_abilities.desc:
If a creature starts its turn within 30 ft. of the basilisk and the two of them can see each other, the basilisk can force the creature to make a DC 12 Constitution saving throw if the basilisk isn't incapacitated. On a failed save, the creature magically begins to turn to stone and is restrained. It must repeat the saving throw at the end of its next turn. On a success, the effect ends. On a failure, the creature is petrified until freed by the greater restoration spell or other magic.
A creature that isn't surprised can avert its eyes to avoid the saving throw at the start of its turn. If it does so, it can't see the basilisk until the start of its next turn, when it can avert its eyes again. If it looks at the basilisk in the meantime, it must immediately make the save.
If the basilisk sees its reflection within 30 ft. of it in bright light, it mistakes itself for a rival and targets itself with its gaze.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage.

content: The Basilisk is a Medium monstrosity with an armor class of 12, 52 hit points, and a challenge rating of 3. It has a Petrifying Gaze special ability that can turn creatures to stone on a failed DC 12 Constitution saving throw. The Basilisk's Bite action deals 10 piercing damage and 7 poison damage. It has a strength of 16, dexterity of 8, constitution of 15, intelligence of 2, wisdom of 8, and charisma of 7. The Basilisk has darkvision of 60 ft. and a passive perception of 9. It has a proficiency bonus of 2 and an XP value of 700.

name: Bat

special_abilities.name: Echolocation
special_abilities.desc: The bat can't use its blindsight while deafened.

special_abilities.name: Keen Hearing
special_abilities.desc: The bat has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +0 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 1 piercing damage.

content: The Bat is a Tiny beast with unaligned alignment, an armor class of 12 (dex), 1 hit point, 1d4 hit dice, and a speed of 5 ft. walking and 30 ft. flying. It has low strength (2), high dexterity (15), average constitution (8), low intelligence (2), moderate wisdom (12), and low charisma (4). The bat has blindsight up to 60 ft. and a passive perception of 11. It is proficient in no skills, has no damage vulnerabilities, resistances, or immunities, and no condition immunities. The bat has a challenge rating of 0, a proficiency bonus of 2, and yields 10 XP. Special abilities include Echolocation (cannot use blindsight while deafened) and Keen Hearing (advantage on hearing-based perception checks). Its action is a Bite attack with +0 to hit, dealing 1 piercing damage.

name: Barbed Devil
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons that aren't silvered

special_abilities.name: Barbed Hide
special_abilities.desc: At the start of each of its turns, the barbed devil deals 5 (1d10) piercing damage to any creature grappling it.

special_abilities.name: Devil's Sight
special_abilities.desc: Magical darkness doesn't impede the devil's darkvision.

special_abilities.name: Magic Resistance
special_abilities.desc: The devil has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The devil makes three melee attacks: one with its tail and two with its claws. Alternatively, it can use Hurl Flame twice.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Tail
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Hurl Flame
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack: +5 to hit, range 150 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (3d6) fire damage. If the target is a flammable object that isn't being worn or carried, it also catches fire.

content: The Barbed Devil is a Medium fiend subtype devil with lawful evil alignment, boasting an armor class of 15 and 110 hit points from 13d8 hit dice. It has a speed of 30 ft. and excels in strength, dexterity, constitution, intelligence, wisdom, and charisma. Proficient in saving throws and skills like Deception, Insight, and Perception, this devil is resistant to cold and nonmagical weapons not silvered, immune to fire and poison, and conditionally immune to being poisoned. With darkvision of 120 ft. and passive perception of 18, it speaks Infernal and possesses telepathy. The devil's special abilities include Barbed Hide, Devil's Sight, and Magic Resistance, granting it the ability to deal piercing damage, see through magical darkness, and resist spells. In combat, it utilizes Multiattack, making three melee attacks or using Hurl Flame, along with actions like Claw, Tail, and Hurl Flame. Overall, the Barbed Devil presents a formidable challenge with a proficiency bonus of 3 and a challenge rating of 5.

name: Berserker

special_abilities.name: Reckless
special_abilities.desc: At the start of its turn, the berserker can gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls during that turn, but attack rolls against it have advantage until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Greataxe
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d12 + 3) slashing damage.

content: The Berserker is a Medium humanoid with any race subtype and any chaotic alignment. It wears Hide Armor with an armor class of 13. With 67 hit points and a Constitution of 17, it has a hit dice of 9d8+27. It has a speed of 30 ft. and excels in strength and dexterity with 16 and 12 respectively. The Berserker's special ability, Reckless, allows it to gain advantage on melee attacks but also grants advantage to attacks against it. It wields a Greataxe with a +5 attack bonus and deals 1d12+3 slashing damage. This creature is proficient in combat and has a proficiency bonus of 2.

name: Bearded Devil
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons that aren't silvered

special_abilities.name: Devil's Sight
special_abilities.desc: Magical darkness doesn't impede the devil's darkvision.

special_abilities.name: Magic Resistance
special_abilities.desc: The devil has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

special_abilities.name: Steadfast
special_abilities.desc: The devil can't be frightened while it can see an allied creature within 30 feet of it.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The devil makes two attacks: one with its beard and one with its glaive.

actions.name: Beard
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. While poisoned in this way, the target can't regain hit points. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Glaive
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) slashing damage. If the target is a creature other than an undead or a construct, it must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or lose 5 (1d10) hit points at the start of each of its turns due to an infernal wound. Each time the devil hits the wounded target with this attack, the damage dealt by the wound increases by 5 (1d10). Any creature can take an action to stanch the wound with a successful DC 12 Wisdom (Medicine) check. The wound also closes if the target receives magical healing.

content: The Bearded Devil is a Medium fiend subtype devil with an armor class of 13, 52 hit points, and a speed of 30 ft. It has strengths in Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution, with proficiency in saving throws for Strength, Constitution, and Wisdom. This devil is resistant to cold damage, nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage, immune to fire and poison, and immune to the poisoned condition. It has darkvision of 120 ft., passive perception of 10, and speaks Infernal with telepathy up to 120 ft. The Bearded Devil has special abilities including Devil's Sight, Magic Resistance, and Steadfast, and can multiattack with its beard and glaive. Its actions include using its beard for piercing damage and a poison effect, as well as using a glaive for slashing damage and causing infernal wounds. This devil has a challenge rating of 3 and proficiency bonus of 2, making it a formidable opponent in battle.

name: Behir

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The behir makes two attacks: one with its bite and one to constrict.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (3d10 + 6) piercing damage.

actions.name: Constrict
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one Large or smaller creature. Hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage plus 17 (2d10 + 6) slashing damage. The target is grappled (escape DC 16) if the behir isn't already constricting a creature, and the target is restrained until this grapple ends.

actions.name: Lightning Breath
actions.desc: The behir exhales a line of lightning that is 20 ft. long and 5 ft. wide. Each creature in that line must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw, taking 66 (12d10) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Swallow
actions.desc:
The behir makes one bite attack against a Medium or smaller target it is grappling. If the attack hits, the target is also swallowed, and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the target is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the behir, and it takes 21 (6d6) acid damage at the start of each of the behir's turns. A behir can have only one creature swallowed at a time.
If the behir takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from the swallowed creature, the behir must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate the creature, which falls prone in a space within 10 ft. of the behir. If the behir dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse by using 15 ft. of movement, exiting prone.

content: The Behir is a Huge monstrosity with neutral evil alignment, boasting a natural armor class of 17 and 168 hit points from 16d12 hit dice. It has a speed of 50 ft. walking and 40 ft. climbing, with notable attributes like 23 strength, 16 dexterity, and 18 constitution. The Behir excels in perception and stealth skills, with proficiency values of 6 and 7 respectively. It possesses immunity to lightning damage and has darkvision up to 90 ft., complemented by a passive perception of 16. This creature speaks Draconic, has a challenge rating of 11, and offers 7200 XP upon defeat. In combat, the Behir utilizes multiattack, bite, constrict, lightning breath, and swallow actions to devastate foes with piercing, bludgeoning, slashing, and acid damage types. Its lightning breath attack requires a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw and deals 66 lightning damage on a failed save. The swallow action allows the Behir to consume and harm targets with 6d6 acid damage, showcasing its formidable and deadly capabilities.

name: Black Bear

special_abilities.name: Keen Smell
special_abilities.desc: The bear has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The bear makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) slashing damage.

content: The Black Bear is a Medium-sized beast with an unaligned alignment. It has a natural armor class of 11 and 19 hit points, derived from a hit dice of 3d8 and a constitution of 14. With a speed of 40 ft. walking and 30 ft. climbing, it excels in mobility. The bear has strengths in strength, wisdom, and passive perception. It also possesses the special ability "Keen Smell," granting advantage on Perception checks relying on smell. In combat, the bear utilizes a Multiattack action to make two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws. The Bite action deals 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage, while the Claws action inflicts 7 (2d4 + 2) slashing damage. With a challenge rating of 0.5, the Black Bear provides a formidable challenge for adventurers.

name: Blood Hawk
desc: Taking its name from its crimson feathers and aggressive nature, the blood hawk fearlessly attacks almost any animal, stabbing it with its daggerlike beak. Blood hawks flock together in large numbers, attacking as a pack to take down prey.

special_abilities.name: Keen Sight
special_abilities.desc: The hawk has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

special_abilities.name: Pack Tactics
special_abilities.desc: The hawk has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the hawk's allies is within 5 ft. of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

actions.name: Beak
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

content: The Blood Hawk is a Small beast with a size of Small and an unaligned alignment. It has an armor class of 12 based on its dexterity, hit points of 7, and a hit dice of 2d6. With a speed of 10 ft. walking and 60 ft. flying, the Blood Hawk is known for its aggressive nature and crimson feathers. It has a keen sense of sight, granting advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks, as well as pack tactics that allow it to gain advantage on attack rolls when allies are nearby. The Blood Hawk's beak attack has a +4 to hit and deals 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage. Additionally, it is proficient in Perception with a value of 4. This creature has a passive perception of 14 and a challenge rating of 0.125, making it a low-level threat in combat situations.

name: Blue Dragon Wyrmling

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) lightning damage.

actions.name: Lightning Breath
actions.desc: The dragon exhales lightning in a 30-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw, taking 22 (4d10) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

content: Blue Dragon Wyrmling is a Medium dragon with lawful evil alignment, natural armor class of 17, 52 hit points, and 30 ft. walk, 15 ft. burrow, and 60 ft. fly speed. It has proficiency in Dexterity, Constitution, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws, as well as Perception and Stealth skills. This dragon is immune to lightning damage and has darkvision up to 60 ft. It is capable of using Bite attack dealing piercing and lightning damage, and Lightning Breath attack inflicting lightning damage in a 30-foot line. With a proficiency bonus of 2 and a challenge rating of 3, this creature is a formidable opponent.

name: Boar

special_abilities.name: Charge
special_abilities.desc: If the boar moves at least 20 ft. straight toward a target and then hits it with a tusk attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 3 (1d6) slashing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 11 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

special_abilities.name: Relentless
special_abilities.desc: If the boar takes 7 damage or less that would reduce it to 0 hit points, it is reduced to 1 hit point instead.

actions.name: Tusk
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) slashing damage.

content: The Boar is a Medium sized beast with an unaligned alignment, having a natural armor class of 11 and 11 hit points. It has a walking speed of 40 ft. and possesses moderate strength (13), average dexterity (11), and constitution (12). Known for its Charge ability, when moving at least 20 ft. towards a target and hitting with a tusk attack, it deals an extra 3 slashing damage and may knock the target prone on a failed DC 11 Strength saving throw. Additionally, the Boar's Relentless feature allows it to remain at 1 hit point if taking 7 or less damage that would reduce it to 0. In combat, it uses the Tusk attack with a +3 to hit bonus, dealing 4 slashing damage. Its passive perception is 9 and it has no known proficiencies, vulnerabilities, resistances, immunities, or condition immunities. The Boar has a challenge rating of 0.25 and a proficiency bonus of 2, yielding 50 XP upon defeat.

name: Black Dragon Wyrmling

special_abilities.name: Amphibious
special_abilities.desc: The dragon can breathe air and water.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) piercing damage plus 2 (1d4) acid damage.

actions.name: Acid Breath
actions.desc: The dragon exhales acid in a 15-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a DC 11 Dexterity saving throw, taking 22 (Sd8) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

content: The Black Dragon Wyrmling is a Medium-sized dragon with chaotic evil alignment, possessing a natural armor class of 17 and 33 hit points. It has a speed of 30 ft. walking, 60 ft. flying, and 30 ft. swimming. With strengths in DEX, CON, and CHA saving throws, as well as proficiency in Perception and Stealth skills, this dragon is a formidable foe. It is immune to acid damage and has blindsight up to 10 ft., darkvision up to 60 ft., and a passive perception of 14. Speaking Draconic, this creature has a challenge rating of 2 and proficiency bonus of 2, rewarding 450 XP upon defeat. Its special ability "Amphibious" allows it to breathe air and water. In combat, the Black Dragon Wyrmling can use its Bite attack, dealing piercing and acid damage, as well as its Acid Breath attack, unleashing a 15-foot line of acid with a DC 11 Dexterity saving throw. With a recharge on roll mechanic, this dragon's acid breath inflicts significant damage.

name: Blink Dog
desc: A blink dog takes its name from its ability to blink in and out of existence, a talent it uses to aid its attacks and to avoid harm.
languages: Blink Dog, understands Sylvan but can't speak it

special_abilities.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
special_abilities.desc: The dog has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage.

actions.name: Teleport
actions.desc: The dog magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 40 ft. to an unoccupied space it can see. Before or after teleporting, the dog can make one bite attack.

content: The Blink Dog is a Medium fey creature with an armor class of 13 based on dexterity. It has 22 hit points and a hit dice of 4d8, with a speed of 40 ft. It has proficiency in Perception and Stealth skills, a passive perception of 10, and a proficiency bonus of 2. The dog has a challenge rating of 0.25 and special ability called Keen Hearing and Smell, giving it advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks based on hearing or smell. Its actions include a Bite attack dealing 1d6+1 piercing damage and a Teleport ability allowing it to magically teleport up to 40 ft. and make a bite attack. The Blink Dog understands Sylvan but can't speak it, and is lawful good in alignment.

name: Bone Devil
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons that aren't silvered

special_abilities.name: Devil's Sight
special_abilities.desc: Magical darkness doesn't impede the devil's darkvision.

special_abilities.name: Magic Resistance
special_abilities.desc: The devil has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The devil makes three attacks: two with its claws and one with its sting.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Sting
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage plus 17 (5d6) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or become poisoned for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

content: The Bone Devil, a Large fiend subtype devil, has an armor class of 19 and 142 hit points with a hit dice of 15d10+60. It has a speed of 40 ft. walking and flying, and is proficient in saving throws for INT, WIS, and CHA, as well as Deception and Insight skills. This lawful evil creature is resistant to cold, nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage, and immune to fire and poison. It is immune to being poisoned and has darkvision up to 120 ft. It speaks Infernal and has telepathy up to 120 ft. The Bone Devil has a challenge rating of 9 and proficiency bonus of 4. Its special abilities include Devil's Sight, which allows it to see in magical darkness, and Magic Resistance, giving it advantage against spells. In combat, it can make three attacks: two with its claws and one with its sting. The Claw attack has a +8 to hit and deals 1d8+4 slashing damage, while the Sting attack has a +8 to hit, dealing 2d8+4 piercing damage and 5d6 poison damage. It can also poison targets on a failed DC 14 Constitution saving throw.

name: Brown Bear

special_abilities.name: Keen Smell
special_abilities.desc: The bear has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The bear makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage.

content: The Brown Bear is a Large beast with an unaligned alignment, having a natural armor class of 11. It has 34 hit points, with a hit dice of 4d10 and a hit points roll of 4d10+12. This creature has a strength of 19, dexterity of 10, constitution of 16, intelligence of 2, wisdom of 13, and charisma of 7. It is proficient in Perception with a proficiency value of 3. The bear has a passive perception of 13 and a challenge rating of 1, with a proficiency bonus of 2 and an XP value of 200. One of its special abilities is Keen Smell, granting advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks relying on smell. In combat, the bear can make two attacks with Multiattack: one with its Bite and one with its Claws. The Bite attack has a +5 to hit and deals 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage, while the Claws attack has the same to hit bonus and inflicts 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage. The bear has a walking speed of 40 ft. and a climbing speed of 30 ft., making it a formidable opponent in the wild.

name: Brass Dragon Wyrmling

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Breath Weapons
actions.desc:
The dragon uses one of the following breath weapons.
Fire Breath. The dragon exhales fire in an 20-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a DC 11 Dexterity saving throw, taking 14 (4d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
Sleep Breath. The dragon exhales sleep gas in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or fall unconscious for 1 minute. This effect ends for a creature if the creature takes damage or someone uses an action to wake it.

content: The Brass Dragon Wyrmling is a Medium-sized dragon with chaotic good alignment, an armor class of 16, and 16 hit points. It has a speed of 30 ft. walking, 15 ft. burrowing, and 60 ft. flying. With strengths in Dexterity, Constitution, and Charisma, it excels in saving throws for DEX, CON, WIS, and CHA, as well as Perception and Stealth skills. Immune to fire damage, it possesses blindsight within 10 ft., darkvision up to 60 ft., and passive perception of 14. Known for its Bite attack dealing 1d10+2 piercing damage, the dragon also breathes fire or sleep gas, inflicting 4d6 fire damage or causing unconsciousness, respectively. With a challenge rating of 1, proficiency bonus of 2, and XP worth 100, the Brass Dragon Wyrmling is a formidable yet benevolent creature to encounter in Draconic lands.

name: Bugbear

special_abilities.name: Brute
special_abilities.desc: A melee weapon deals one extra die of its damage when the bugbear hits with it (included in the attack).

special_abilities.name: Surprise Attack
special_abilities.desc: If the bugbear surprises a creature and hits it with an attack during the first round of combat, the target takes an extra 7 (2d6) damage from the attack.

actions.name: Morningstar
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d8 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Javelin
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) piercing damage in melee or 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage at range.

content: Bugbear is a Medium humanoid creature with chaotic evil alignment, 16 armor class, 27 hit points, and 30 ft. walking speed. It has strengths in Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution, along with proficiencies in Stealth and Survival skills. Bugbear's special abilities include Brute, enhancing melee weapon damage, and Surprise Attack, dealing extra damage during the first round of combat. Its actions involve using a Morningstar and Javelin for piercing damage. Additionally, Bugbear has Darkvision, speaks Common and Goblin languages, and a challenge rating of 1.

name: Bronze Dragon Wyrmling

special_abilities.name: Amphibious
special_abilities.desc: The dragon can breathe air and water.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Breath Weapons
actions.desc:
The dragon uses one of the following breath weapons.
Lightning Breath. The dragon exhales lightning in a 40-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw, taking 16 (3d10) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
Repulsion Breath. The dragon exhales repulsion energy in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 12 Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is pushed 30 feet away from the dragon.

content: The Bronze Dragon Wyrmling is a Medium dragon with a lawful good alignment and a natural armor class of 17. It has 32 hit points and can move at a speed of 30 ft. on land, 60 ft. flying, and 30 ft. swimming. With strengths in Dexterity, Constitution, and Charisma, it excels in saving throws related to these attributes, as well as Perception and Stealth skills. Immune to lightning damage, it has darkvision up to 60 ft. and a passive perception of 14. Its special ability, Amphibious, allows it to breathe both air and water. In combat, it can use its Bite attack or unleash its Breath Weapons, including a Lightning Breath and Repulsion Breath with varying effects and saving throws. Overall, the Bronze Dragon Wyrmling presents a formidable challenge rating of 2, making it a versatile and powerful adversary.

name: Black Pudding

special_abilities.name: Amorphous
special_abilities.desc: The pudding can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

special_abilities.name: Corrosive Form
special_abilities.desc: A creature that touches the pudding or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 4 (1d8) acid damage. Any nonmagical weapon made of metal or wood that hits the pudding corrodes. After dealing damage, the weapon takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to damage rolls. If its penalty drops to -5, the weapon is destroyed. Nonmagical ammunition made of metal or wood that hits the pudding is destroyed after dealing damage. The pudding can eat through 2-inch-thick, nonmagical wood or metal in 1 round.

special_abilities.name: Spider Climb
special_abilities.desc: The pudding can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 18 (4d8) acid damage. In addition, nonmagical armor worn by the target is partly dissolved and takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to the AC it offers. The armor is destroyed if the penalty reduces its AC to 10.

reactions.name: Split
reactions.desc: When a pudding that is Medium or larger is subjected to lightning or slashing damage, it splits into two new puddings if it has at least 10 hit points. Each new pudding has hit points equal to half the original pudding's, rounded down. New puddings are one size smaller than the original pudding.

content: The Black Pudding is a Large ooze creature with an unaligned alignment, possessing an armor class of 7 from dexterity. It has 85 hit points and a hit dice of 10d10, with a hit points roll of 10d10+30. With a strength of 16, constitution of 16, and other low mental stats, it is immune to acid, cold, lightning, and slashing damage, and resistant to many conditions like blindness and exhaustion. The pudding has blindsight up to 60 ft. and can climb difficult surfaces with ease. Its special abilities include being amorphous, having a corrosive form that deals acid damage, and the ability to climb like a spider. In combat, it can use its pseudopod to deal bludgeoning and acid damage, corroding armor worn by its target. When subjected to lightning or slashing damage, the Black Pudding can split into two smaller puddings. This challenging creature has a proficiency bonus of 2 and is worth 1100 xp for defeating.

name: Bulette

special_abilities.name: Standing Leap
special_abilities.desc: The bulette's long jump is up to 30 ft. and its high jump is up to 15 ft., with or without a running start.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 30 (4d12 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Deadly Leap
actions.desc: If the bulette jumps at least 15 ft. as part of its movement, it can then use this action to land on its feet in a space that contains one or more other creatures. Each of those creatures must succeed on a DC 16 Strength or Dexterity saving throw (target's choice) or be knocked prone and take 14 (3d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 14 (3d6 + 4) slashing damage. On a successful save, the creature takes only half the damage, isn't knocked prone, and is pushed 5 ft. out of the bulette's space into an unoccupied space of the creature's choice. If no unoccupied space is within range, the creature instead falls prone in the bulette's space.

content: The Bulette is a Large monstrosity with an unaligned alignment, possessing a natural armor class of 17 and 94 hit points from 9d10 hit dice. It has a speed of 40 ft. for both walking and burrowing, with notable strengths in strength (19) and constitution (21). The Bulette is proficient in Perception with a value of 6 and has darkvision and tremorsense up to 60 ft., along with a passive perception of 16. Its special abilities include Standing Leap, allowing for impressive jumps, and Deadly Leap, which can knock targets prone and deal significant damage. In combat, the Bulette can use its Bite attack with a +7 to hit and deal 30 piercing damage with 4d12+4 damage dice. Overall, this creature poses a challenge rating of 5, providing 1800 XP upon defeat.

name: Cat

special_abilities.name: Keen Smell
special_abilities.desc: The cat has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +0 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 slashing damage.

content: The Cat creature is a Tiny beast with unaligned alignment, featuring a Dexterity-based armor class of 12 and 2 hit points from 1d4 hit dice. It has a walking speed of 40 ft. and climbing speed of 30 ft., along with strengths in Dexterity (15) and Wisdom (12). The Cat is proficient in Perception (value 3) and Stealth (value 4) skills, with a proficiency bonus of 2 and a passive perception of 13. Its special ability, Keen Smell, grants advantage on Perception checks relying on smell. In combat, the Cat can use its Claws attack with a +0 to hit bonus, dealing 1 slashing damage with a reach of 5 ft. Overall, the Cat presents a challenge rating of 0 and offers 10 experience points upon defeat.

name: Camel

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2 (1d4) bludgeoning damage.

content: The Camel is a Large beast with unaligned alignment, having an armor class of 9 based on dexterity. It has 15 hit points, derived from 2d10 hit dice with a hit points roll of 2d10+4. The Camel has a speed of 50 ft. and notable strengths in strength (16) and constitution (14), but lacks in dexterity (8) and intelligence (2). It also has passive perception of 9 and proficiency bonus of 2, resulting in a challenge rating of 0.125. Its Bite action allows for a melee weapon attack with +5 to hit and deals 2 (1d4) bludgeoning damage. This creature is known for its resilience and swift movement, making it a unique addition to any encounter.

name: Chain Devil
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons that aren't silvered

special_abilities.name: Devil's Sight
special_abilities.desc: Magical darkness doesn't impede the devil's darkvision.

special_abilities.name: Magic Resistance
special_abilities.desc: The devil has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The devil makes two attacks with its chains.

actions.name: Chain
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage. The target is grappled (escape DC 14) if the devil isn't already grappling a creature. Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained and takes 7 (2d6) piercing damage at the start of each of its turns.

actions.name: Animate Chains
actions.desc:
Up to four chains the devil can see within 60 feet of it magically sprout razor-edged barbs and animate under the devil's control, provided that the chains aren't being worn or carried.
Each animated chain is an object with AC 20, 20 hit points, resistance to piercing damage, and immunity to psychic and thunder damage. When the devil uses Multiattack on its turn, it can use each animated chain to make one additional chain attack. An animated chain can grapple one creature of its own but can't make attacks while grappling. An animated chain reverts to its inanimate state if reduced to 0 hit points or if the devil is incapacitated or dies.

reactions.name: Unnerving Mask
reactions.desc: When a creature the devil can see starts its turn within 30 feet of the devil, the devil can create the illusion that it looks like one of the creature's departed loved ones or bitter enemies. If the creature can see the devil, it must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the end of its turn.

content: The Chain Devil is a Medium fiend with lawful evil alignment, boasting an armor class of 16 and 85 hit points. It has a speed of 30 ft. and excels in strength, dexterity, constitution, charisma, and proficiency bonuses. This devil is immune to fire and poison, resistant to cold and nonmagical weapon damage, and proficient in saving throws for CON, WIS, and CHA. It possesses darkvision up to 120 ft., passive perception of 11, and the ability to see in magical darkness. The Chain Devil's actions include Multiattack with chains, grappling targets with its Chain attack, and animating chains to control in combat. It can also create illusions with its Unnerving Mask reaction to frighten enemies. With a challenge rating of 8 and XP worth 3900, the Chain Devil is a formidable adversary in battle.

name: Chimera

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The chimera makes three attacks: one with its bite, one with its horns, and one with its claws. When its fire breath is available, it can use the breath in place of its bite or horns.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Horns
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d12 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Fire Breath
actions.desc: The dragon head exhales fire in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 31 (7d8) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

content: Chimera is a Large monstrosity with chaotic evil alignment, possessing natural armor with an armor class of 14 and 114 hit points from 12d10 hit dice. It has a speed of 30 ft. walking and 60 ft. flying, high strength and constitution with lower intelligence, and proficient in Perception with a proficiency bonus of 8. This creature has darkvision up to 60 ft., passive perception of 18, and understands Draconic but cannot speak. The chimera's challenge rating is 6, providing 2300 XP when defeated. In combat, it can make three attacks with its bite, horns, and claws or use fire breath as an alternative. Its bite deals 2d6 + 4 piercing damage, horns deal 1d12 + 4 bludgeoning damage, and claws deal 2d6 + 4 slashing damage. The fire breath exhales fire in a cone, requiring a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw for half damage on a successful save, dealing 7d8 fire damage.

name: Chuul
languages: understands Deep Speech but can't speak

special_abilities.name: Amphibious
special_abilities.desc: The chuul can breathe air and water.

special_abilities.name: Sense Magic
special_abilities.desc: The chuul senses magic within 120 feet of it at will. This trait otherwise works like the detect magic spell but isn't itself magical.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The chuul makes two pincer attacks. If the chuul is grappling a creature, the chuul can also use its tentacles once.

actions.name: Pincer
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage. The target is grappled (escape DC 14) if it is a Large or smaller creature and the chuul doesn't have two other creatures grappled.

actions.name: Tentacles
actions.desc: One creature grappled by the chuul must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. Until this poison ends, the target is paralyzed. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

content: The Chuul is a Large aberration with chaotic evil alignment, possessing a natural armor class of 16 and 93 hit points. It has strengths in strength, constitution, and passive perception of 14, along with damage immunities to poison and condition immunities to being poisoned. The Chuul can walk and swim at a speed of 30 ft. and can detect magic within 120 feet at will. It is proficient in Perception with a bonus of 4 and has the special abilities of being amphibious and having a Multiattack action option that includes Pincer and Tentacles attacks. The Pincer attack has an attack bonus of +6, dealing 11 bludgeoning damage, while the Tentacles attack can paralyze a target on a failed Constitution saving throw of DC 13. This monstrous creature is a challenge rating 4 encounter with an experience point value of 1100.

name: Clay Golem
damage_immunities: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons that aren't adamantine
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

special_abilities.name: Acid Absorption
special_abilities.desc: Whenever the golem is subjected to acid damage, it takes no damage and instead regains a number of hit points equal to the acid damage dealt.

special_abilities.name: Berserk
special_abilities.desc: Whenever the golem starts its turn with 60 hit points or fewer, roll a d6. On a 6, the golem goes berserk. On each of its turns while berserk, the golem attacks the nearest creature it can see. If no creature is near enough to move to and attack, the golem attacks an object, with preference for an object smaller than itself. Once the golem goes berserk, it continues to do so until it is destroyed or regains all its hit points.

special_abilities.name: Immutable Form
special_abilities.desc: The golem is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

special_abilities.name: Magic Resistance
special_abilities.desc: The golem has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

special_abilities.name: Magic Weapons
special_abilities.desc: The golem's weapon attacks are magical.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The golem makes two slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or have its hit point maximum reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. The target dies if this attack reduces its hit point maximum to 0. The reduction lasts until removed by the greater restoration spell or other magic.

actions.name: Haste
actions.desc: Until the end of its next turn, the golem magically gains a +2 bonus to its AC, has advantage on Dexterity saving throws, and can use its slam attack as a bonus action.

content: The Clay Golem is a Large construct with an armor class of 14, hit points of 133, and a challenge rating of 9. It has strengths in strength (20), constitution (18), and proficiency bonus (4), while weaknesses in dexterity (9), intelligence (3), wisdom (8), and charisma (1). It is immune to acid, poison, psychic damage, and nonmagical weapons that aren't adamantine. The golem has special abilities like Acid Absorption, Berserk, Immutable Form, Magic Resistance, and Magic Weapons. It can sense through darkvision up to 60 ft. and has passive perception of 9. The golem can understand languages but cannot speak, and has the ability to slam attack twice with a hit bonus of +8 and damage of 2d10 + 5 bludgeoning damage. With the Haste action, it gains a +2 bonus to AC, advantage on Dexterity saving throws, and can use slam attack as a bonus action.

name: Cloaker

special_abilities.name: Damage Transfer
special_abilities.desc: While attached to a creature, the cloaker takes only half the damage dealt to it (rounded down). and that creature takes the other half.

special_abilities.name: False Appearance
special_abilities.desc: While the cloaker remains motionless without its underside exposed, it is indistinguishable from a dark leather cloak.

special_abilities.name: Light Sensitivity
special_abilities.desc: While in bright light, the cloaker has disadvantage on attack rolls and Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The cloaker makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its tail.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage, and if the target is Large or smaller, the cloaker attaches to it. If the cloaker has advantage against the target, the cloaker attaches to the target's head, and the target is blinded and unable to breathe while the cloaker is attached. While attached, the cloaker can make this attack only against the target and has advantage on the attack roll. The cloaker can detach itself by spending 5 feet of its movement. A creature, including the target, can take its action to detach the cloaker by succeeding on a DC 16 Strength check.

actions.name: Tail
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Moan
actions.desc: Each creature within 60 feet of the cloaker that can hear its moan and that isn't an aberration must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened until the end of the cloaker's next turn. If a creature's saving throw is successful, the creature is immune to the cloaker's moan for the next 24 hours.

actions.name: Phantasms
actions.desc:
The cloaker magically creates three illusory duplicates of itself if it isn't in bright light. The duplicates move with it and mimic its actions, shifting position so as to make it impossible to track which cloaker is the real one. If the cloaker is ever in an area of bright light, the duplicates disappear.
Whenever any creature targets the cloaker with an attack or a harmful spell while a duplicate remains, that creature rolls randomly to determine whether it targets the cloaker or one of the duplicates. A creature is unaffected by this magical effect if it can't see or if it relies on senses other than sight.
A duplicate has the cloaker's AC and uses its saving throws. If an attack hits a duplicate, or if a duplicate fails a saving throw against an effect that deals damage, the duplicate disappears.

content: Cloaker is a Large aberration with chaotic neutral alignment, having natural armor class of 14 and 78 hit points. It has a speed of 10 ft. walk and 40 ft. fly, with strength 17, dexterity 15, constitution 12, intelligence 13, wisdom 12, and charisma 14. Proficient in Stealth with a bonus of 5, it possesses darkvision of 60 ft. and passive perception of 11, speaks Deep Speech and Undercommon, and has a challenge rating of 8. Special abilities include Damage Transfer, False Appearance, and Light Sensitivity. Multiattack action involves Bite and Tail attacks, while Bite inflicts 10 piercing damage and can attach to a target. Additionally, the Cloaker can use Moan to frighten creatures within 60 ft. and create illusory duplicates with Phantasms ability, providing strategic advantages in combat.

name: Cockatrice

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw against being magically petrified. On a failed save, the creature begins to turn to stone and is restrained. It must repeat the saving throw at the end of its next turn. On a success, the effect ends. On a failure, the creature is petrified for 24 hours.

content: The Cockatrice is a Small monstrosity with an unaligned alignment. It has an armor class of 11 based on dexterity, 27 hit points with 6d6 hit dice, and a speed of 20 ft. walking and 40 ft. flying. Its attributes include strength 6, dexterity 12, constitution 12, intelligence 2, wisdom 13, and charisma 5. It has darkvision of 60 ft. and passive perception of 11. This creature has a challenge rating of 0.5, proficiency bonus of 2, and grants 100 XP. Its Bite action has an attack bonus of +3, dealing 3 (1d4 + 1) piercing damage and potentially petrifying the target.

name: Commoner
desc: Commoners include peasants, serfs, slaves, servants, pilgrims, merchants, artisans, and hermits.

actions.name: Club
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2 (1d4) bludgeoning damage.

content: The Commoner is a Medium humanoid of any race with an alignment of any alignment. They have an armor class of 10 based on dexterity, 4 hit points, and a speed of 30 ft. Their abilities include a strength, dexterity, constitution, intelligence, wisdom, and charisma score of 10 each. Commoners have a passive perception of 10 and can speak any one language, usually Common. They have a proficiency bonus of 2 and are rated at a challenge rating of 0. In combat, they can attack with a Club, with a +2 attack bonus and dealing 2 bludgeoning damage on a hit.

name: Centaur

special_abilities.name: Charge
special_abilities.desc: If the centaur moves at least 30 ft. straight toward a target and then hits it with a pike attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 10 (3d6) piercing damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The centaur makes two attacks: one with its pike and one with its hooves or two with its longbow.

actions.name: Pike
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Hooves
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.

content: The Centaur is a Large monstrosity with neutral good alignment, wearing armor with a dexterity value of 12 for an armor class of 12. It has 45 hit points from 6d10 hit dice and a hit points roll of 6d10+12. With a speed of 50 ft., the Centaur excels in Strength (18), Dexterity (14), and Constitution (14), with proficiencies in Athletics (value: 6), Perception (value: 3), and Survival (value: 3). Its passive perception is 13, and it speaks Elvish and Sylvan. The Centaur's challenge rating is 2, with a proficiency bonus of 2 and an XP value of 450. Special abilities include "Charge," dealing extra piercing damage with a pike attack. In combat, it can make two attacks with its pike and hooves or use a longbow. The Pike attack has a +6 to hit and deals 9 piercing damage, while the Hooves attack has a +6 to hit and deals 11 bludgeoning damage. The Longbow attack has a +4 to hit and deals 6 piercing damage.

name: Constrictor Snake

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Constrict
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 14). Until this grapple ends, the creature is restrained, and the snake can't constrict another target.

content: The Constrictor Snake is a Large beast with an armor class of 12 based on dexterity, 13 hit points, and a proficiency bonus of 2. It has a speed of 30 ft. for both walking and swimming, with a strength of 15, dexterity of 14, constitution of 12, wisdom of 10, and charisma of 3. This creature has blindsight up to 10 ft. and a passive perception of 10. In combat, it can use its Bite attack with a +4 to hit and deal 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage, or its Constrict attack with a +4 to hit and deal 6 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage while also grappling the target. The Constrictor Snake is unaligned and has a challenge rating of 0.25, offering 50 XP when defeated.

name: Cloud Giant

special_abilities.name: Keen Smell
special_abilities.desc: The giant has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

special_abilities.name: Innate Spellcasting
special_abilities.desc:
The giant's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma. It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

At will: detect magic, fog cloud, light
3/day each: feather fall, fly, misty step, telekinesis
1/day each: control weather, gaseous form

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The giant makes two morningstar attacks.

actions.name: Morningstar
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (3d8 + 8) piercing damage.

actions.name: Rock
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. Hit: 30 (4d10 + 8) bludgeoning damage.

content: The Cloud Giant is a Huge giant with neutral good or neutral evil alignment, boasting an armor class of 14 and 200 hit points, derived from 16d12 hit dice with a hit points roll of 16d12+96. With a speed of 40 ft., it excels in strength with a score of 27, while also possessing proficiency in saving throws for CON, WIS, and CHA, as well as skills like Insight and Perception. Noteworthy abilities include Keen Smell, providing advantage on smell-based Perception checks, and Innate Spellcasting using Charisma to cast spells like detect magic, fog cloud, and telekinesis. In combat, it utilizes the Multiattack action to make two morningstar attacks, each dealing 21 piercing damage, along with a ranged Rock attack dealing 30 bludgeoning damage. Additionally, it has passive perception of 17, speaks Common and Giant languages, and holds a challenge rating of 9 with a proficiency bonus of 4.

name: Copper Dragon Wyrmling

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Breath Weapons
actions.desc:
The dragon uses one of the following breath weapons.
Acid Breath. The dragon exhales acid in an 20-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a DC 11 Dexterity saving throw, taking 18 (4d8) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
Slowing Breath. The dragon exhales gas in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature can't use reactions, its speed is halved, and it can't make more than one attack on its turn. In addition, the creature can use either an action or a bonus action on its turn, but not both. These effects last for 1 minute. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself with a successful save.

content: The Copper Dragon Wyrmling is a Medium dragon with chaotic good alignment, 16 natural armor class, 22 hit points, 30 ft. walk, climb, and 60 ft. fly speed, 15 strength, 12 dexterity, 13 constitution, 14 intelligence, 11 wisdom, and 13 charisma. It is proficient in DEX, CON, WIS, CHA saving throws, Perception, and Stealth skills, immune to acid damage, has blindsight of 10 ft., darkvision of 60 ft., and passive perception of 14. This dragon speaks Draconic, has a challenge rating of 1, a proficiency bonus of 2, and XP worth 200. Its actions include a Bite with +4 attack bonus dealing 1d10+2 piercing damage, and Breath Weapons with Acid Breath (DC 11 DEX saving throw for half damage) dealing 4d8 acid damage and Slowing Breath (DC 11 CON saving throw) inflicting speed reduction and action restrictions.

name: Crab

special_abilities.name: Amphibious
special_abilities.desc: The crab can breathe air and water.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +0 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 bludgeoning damage.

content: The Tiny Crab is a beast with natural armor class of 11, 2 hit points, and a speed of 20 ft. on land and in water. It has low strength, average dexterity and constitution, but very low intelligence, wisdom, and charisma. The creature is proficient in Stealth and has blindsight up to 30 ft. with a passive perception of 9. While it has no damage vulnerabilities, resistances, or immunities, it is immune to conditions. With a challenge rating of 0, the Crab's main attack is the Claw, dealing 1 bludgeoning damage on a hit. Additionally, it has the special ability Amphibious, allowing it to breathe air and water.

name: Cult Fanatic
desc: Fanatics are often part of a cult’s leadership, using their charisma and dogma to influence and prey on those of weak will. Most are interested in personal power above all else.

special_abilities.name: Dark Devotion
special_abilities.desc: The fanatic has advantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened.

special_abilities.name: Spellcasting
special_abilities.desc:
The fanatic is a 4th-level spellcaster. Its spell casting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 11, +3 to hit with spell attacks). The fanatic has the following cleric spells prepared:

Cantrips (at will): light, sacred flame, thaumaturgy
- 1st level (4 slots): command, inflict wounds, shield of faith
- 2nd level (3 slots): hold person, spiritual weapon

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The fanatic makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one creature. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

content: The Cult Fanatic is a Medium humanoid with an alignment of any non-good. It has an armor class of 13 with Leather Armor, 22 hit points, and a proficiency bonus of 2. With a strength of 11, dexterity of 14, constitution of 12, intelligence of 10, wisdom of 13, and charisma of 14, it excels in skills like Deception, Persuasion, and Religion. The fanatic's special abilities include Dark Devotion, granting advantage against being charmed or frightened, and Spellcasting as a 4th-level cleric with spells like Light, Sacred Flame, Command, and more. In combat, it can make two melee attacks with a Dagger dealing 4 piercing damage. Overall, the Cult Fanatic presents a charismatic and powerful threat to adventurers.

name: Cultist
desc: Cultists swear allegiance to dark powers such as elemental princes, demon lords, or archdevils. Most conceal their loyalties to avoid being ostracized, imprisoned, or executed for their beliefs. Unlike evil acolytes, cultists often show signs of insanity in their beliefs and practices.

special_abilities.name: Dark Devotion
special_abilities.desc: The cultist has advantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened.

actions.name: Scimitar
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) slashing damage.

content: The Cultist is a Medium humanoid of any race with an alignment of any non-good alignment, wearing Leather Armor with an armor class of 12. They have 9 hit points and a hit dice of 2d8, with a speed of 30 ft. The Cultist has average stats, with a strength of 11, dexterity of 12, constitution of 10, intelligence of 10, wisdom of 11, and charisma of 10. They are proficient in Deception and Religion skills, with a proficiency bonus of 2. The Cultist has a passive perception of 10 and a challenge rating of 0.125, granting 25 XP. Their special ability, Dark Devotion, gives them advantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened. In combat, they use a Scimitar for a +3 to hit, dealing 4 (1d6 + 1) slashing damage.

name: Darkmantle

special_abilities.name: Echolocation
special_abilities.desc: The darkmantle can't use its blindsight while deafened.

special_abilities.name: False Appearance
special_abilities.desc: While the darkmantle remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a cave formation such as a stalactite or stalagmite.

actions.name: Crush
actions.desc:
Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage, and the darkmantle attaches to the target. If the target is Medium or smaller and the darkmantle has advantage on the attack roll, it attaches by engulfing the target's head, and the target is also blinded and unable to breathe while the darkmantle is attached in this way.
While attached to the target, the darkmantle can attack no other creature except the target but has advantage on its attack rolls. The darkmantle's speed also becomes 0, it can't benefit from any bonus to its speed, and it moves with the target.
A creature can detach the darkmantle by making a successful DC 13 Strength check as an action. On its turn, the darkmantle can detach itself from the target by using 5 feet of movement.

actions.name: Darkness Aura
actions.desc: A 15-foot radius of magical darkness extends out from the darkmantle, moves with it, and spreads around corners. The darkness lasts as long as the darkmantle maintains concentration, up to 10 minutes (as if concentrating on a spell). Darkvision can't penetrate this darkness, and no natural light can illuminate it. If any of the darkness overlaps with an area of light created by a spell of 2nd level or lower, the spell creating the light is dispelled.

content: The Darkmantle is a Small monstrosity with an armor class of 11 based on Dexterity. It has 22 hit points, a hit dice of 5d6, and a hit points roll of 5d6+5. With a strength of 16, dexterity of 12, and constitution of 13, it has proficiency in Stealth with a value of 3. This creature has echolocation and false appearance as special abilities. In combat, it can use the Crush action to attach itself to a target and deal bludgeoning damage. Additionally, it can create a Darkness Aura with a 15-foot radius that blocks darkvision. The Darkmantle has a challenge rating of 0.5 and an XP reward of 100.

name: Couatl
damage_immunities: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons

special_abilities.name: Innate Spellcasting
special_abilities.desc:
The couatl's spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 14). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring only verbal components:

At will: detect evil and good, detect magic, detect thoughts
3/day each: bless, create food and water, cure wounds, lesser restoration, protection from poison, sanctuary, shield
1/day each: dream, greater restoration, scrying

special_abilities.name: Magic Weapons
special_abilities.desc: The couatl's weapon attacks are magical.

special_abilities.name: Shielded Mind
special_abilities.desc: The couatl is immune to scrying and to any effect that would sense its emotions, read its thoughts, or detect its location.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 8 (1d6 + 5) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 24 hours. Until this poison ends, the target is unconscious. Another creature can use an action to shake the target awake.

actions.name: Constrict
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one Medium or smaller creature. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 15). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the couatl can't constrict another target.

actions.name: Change Shape
actions.desc:
The couatl magically polymorphs into a humanoid or beast that has a challenge rating equal to or less than its own, or back into its true form. It reverts to its true form if it dies. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying is absorbed or borne by the new form (the couatl's choice).
In a new form, the couatl retains its game statistics and ability to speak, but its AC, movement modes, Strength, Dexterity, and other actions are replaced by those of the new form, and it gains any statistics and capabilities (except class features, legendary actions, and lair actions) that the new form has but that it lacks. If the new form has a bite attack, the couatl can use its bite in that form.

content: The Couatl is a celestial creature with Medium size and a lawful good alignment. It has a natural armor class of 19 and 97 hit points, derived from 13d8 hit dice. With a speed of 30 ft. walking and 90 ft. flying, it excels in mobility. Possessing high ability scores in dexterity, wisdom, and charisma, the Couatl is proficient in saving throws for constitution, wisdom, and charisma. It is resistant to radiant damage and immune to psychic damage, as well as nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing. Its special abilities include innate spellcasting with a spell save DC of 14, allowing it to cast various spells at will or per day. The Couatl's actions include a poisonous Bite and a Constrict attack that grapples and restrains foes. Additionally, it can magically Change Shape into humanoid or beast forms with different abilities. With truesight up to 120 ft. and passive perception of 15, the Couatl is adept at detecting threats. Its shielded mind makes it impervious to scrying and mental detection.

name: Death Dog
desc: A death dog is an ugly two-headed hound that roams plains, and deserts. Hate burns in a death dog’s heart, and a taste for humanoid flesh drives it to attack travelers and explorers. Death dog saliva carries a foul disease that causes a victim’s flesh to slowly rot off the bone.

special_abilities.name: Two-Headed
special_abilities.desc: The dog has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks and on saving throws against being blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, stunned, or knocked unconscious.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The dog makes two bite attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw against disease or become poisoned until the disease is cured. Every 24 hours that elapse, the creature must repeat the saving throw, reducing its hit point maximum by 5 (1d10) on a failure. This reduction lasts until the disease is cured. The creature dies if the disease reduces its hit point maximum to 0.

content: Death Dog is a Medium monstrosity with neutral evil alignment, having 39 hit points and a hit dice of 6d8. This two-headed hound has an armor class of 12, and is proficient in Perception (value: 5) and Stealth (value: 4). With a speed of 40 ft., the dog has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks and saving throws against various conditions. Its Bite attack deals 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage and can inflict disease on failed saving throws. With darkvision of 120 ft. and a passive perception of 15, the Death Dog poses a challenge rating of 1 and awards 200 XP upon defeat.

name: Deep Gnome (Svirfneblin)

special_abilities.name: Stone Camouflage
special_abilities.desc: The gnome has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in rocky terrain.

special_abilities.name: Gnome Cunning
special_abilities.desc: The gnome has advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws against magic.

special_abilities.name: Innate Spellcasting
special_abilities.desc:
The gnome's innate spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 11). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: nondetection (self only)
1/day each: blindness/deafness, blur, disguise self

actions.name: War Pick
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Poisoned Dart
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one creature. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success

content: The Deep Gnome (Svirfneblin) is a Small humanoid subtype of gnome with a neutral good alignment. They have an armor class of 15, wearing a Chain Shirt, and 16 hit points. With strengths in Dexterity, Constitution, and Intelligence, they excel in skills like Investigation, Perception, and Stealth. Their Stone Camouflage ability grants advantage on Stealth in rocky terrain, while Gnome Cunning provides advantage on saving throws against magic. They have darkvision up to 120 ft. and speak Gnomish, Terran, and Undercommon. Innate Spellcasting allows them to cast spells like nondetection, blindness/deafness, blur, and disguise self using Intelligence.
