In combat, they wield a War Pick and Poisoned Dart, inflicting piercing damage. With a proficiency bonus of 2, they pose a challenge rating of 0.5 and are worth 50 XP.

name: Deer

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2 (1d4) piercing damage.

content: The deer is a Medium beast with unaligned alignment, an armor class of 13 from dexterity, 4 hit points, and a walking speed of 50 ft. It has a strength of 11, dexterity of 16, constitution of 11, intelligence of 2, wisdom of 14, and charisma of 5. With a passive perception of 12, it has proficiency in no skills or languages. Despite having no damage vulnerabilities, resistances, or immunities, the deer is immune to no conditions. This creature has a challenge rating of 0, a proficiency bonus of 2, and yields 10 experience points when defeated. Its only action is a Bite attack, dealing 2 piercing damage on a hit.

name: Crocodile

special_abilities.name: Hold Breath
special_abilities.desc: The crocodile can hold its breath for 15 minutes.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) piercing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 12). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the crocodile can't bite another target

content: The Crocodile is a Large beast with an unaligned alignment. It has a natural armor class of 12 and 19 hit points, rolled with 3d10+3 hit dice. With a strength of 15, dexterity of 10, constitution of 13, intelligence of 2, wisdom of 10, and charisma of 5, it is proficient in the Skill: Stealth with a value of 2. This creature can walk and swim at a speed of 20 ft. It has a passive perception of 10 and a challenge rating of 0.5. A special ability called Hold Breath allows it to hold its breath for 15 minutes. In combat, it can use its Bite attack with a +4 to hit, dealing 7 (1d10 + 2) piercing damage and grappling the target with an escape DC of 12. The crocodile is represented by an image and can be found at the provided URL.

name: Deva
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons

special_abilities.name: Angelic Weapons
special_abilities.desc: The deva's weapon attacks are magical. When the deva hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra 4d8 radiant damage (included in the attack).

special_abilities.name: Innate Spellcasting
special_abilities.desc:
The deva's spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 17). The deva can innately cast the following spells, requiring only verbal components:
At will: detect evil and good
1/day each: commune, raise dead

special_abilities.name: Magic Resistance
special_abilities.desc: The deva has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The deva makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Mace
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 18 (4d8) radiant damage.

actions.name: Healing Touch
actions.desc: The deva touches another creature. The target magically regains 20 (4d8 + 2) hit points and is freed from any curse, disease, poison, blindness, or deafness.

actions.name: Change Shape
actions.desc:
The deva magically polymorphs into a humanoid or beast that has a challenge rating equal to or less than its own, or back into its true form. It reverts to its true form if it dies. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying is absorbed or borne by the new form (the deva's choice).
In a new form, the deva retains its game statistics and ability to speak, but its AC, movement modes, Strength, Dexterity, and special senses are replaced by those of the new form, and it gains any statistics and capabilities (except class features, legendary actions, and lair actions) that the new form has but that it lacks.

content: Deva is a Medium celestial creature with a lawful good alignment, boasting an impressive natural armor class of 17 and 136 hit points. With 18 in strength, dexterity, and constitution, along with high wisdom and charisma scores of 20, Deva excels in saving throws, particularly Wisdom and Charisma, as well as skills like Insight and Perception. Resistant to radiant damage and nonmagical weapon attacks, Deva is immune to charm, exhaustion, and fear, boasting darkvision, passive perception of 19, and the ability to speak all languages with telepathy up to 120 ft. In combat, Deva wields magical weapons, casting spells like detect evil and good at will, and commune and raise dead once per day. With a proficiency bonus of 4, Deva's actions include a multiattack with a mace dealing bludgeoning and radiant damage, a healing touch that restores 20 hit points, and the ability to change shape into a humanoid or beast of equal or lower challenge rating.

name: Dire Wolf

special_abilities.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
special_abilities.desc: The wolf has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

special_abilities.name: Pack Tactics
special_abilities.desc: The wolf has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the wolf's allies is within 5 ft. of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

content: The Dire Wolf is a Large beast with an armor class of 14. It has 37 hit points and a hit dice of 5d10, with a hit points roll of 5d10+10. The wolf has a speed of 50 ft. and excels in strength, dexterity, and constitution. It is proficient in Perception and Stealth skills, with a proficiency bonus of 2. With a passive perception of 13, the wolf possesses Keen Hearing and Smell, granting advantage on Perception checks. It also benefits from Pack Tactics, gaining advantage on attack rolls. Its Bite action has an attack bonus of +5 and deals 10 piercing damage, requiring a DC 13 Strength saving throw to avoid being knocked prone.

name: Draft Horse

actions.name: Hooves
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

content: The Draft Horse is a Large beast with an armor class of 10 based on dexterity. It has 19 hit points, a speed of 40 ft., and a strength of 18. With a constitution of 12 and a passive perception of 10, this unaligned creature also has hooves as its action, dealing 9 bludgeoning damage on a hit. Its challenge rating is 0.25, and it has a proficiency bonus of 2. The Draft Horse is known for its physical prowess and resilience, making it a valuable companion in various situations.

name: Dretch
languages: Abyssal, telepathy 60 ft. (works only with creatures that understand Abyssal)

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The dretch makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d6) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (2d4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Fetid Cloud
actions.desc: A 10-foot radius of disgusting green gas extends out from the dretch. The gas spreads around corners, and its area is lightly obscured. It lasts for 1 minute or until a strong wind disperses it. Any creature that starts its turn in that area must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the start of its next turn. While poisoned in this way, the target can take either an action or a bonus action on its turn, not both, and can't take reactions.

content: The Dretch is a Small fiend demon with chaotic evil alignment, having a natural armor class of 11 and 18 hit points from 4d6 hit dice. It has a speed of 20 ft. and is resistant to cold, fire, and lightning damage, while immune to poison. With darkvision of 60 ft. and passive perception of 9, it can speak Abyssal and has telepathy up to 60 ft. The Dretch's challenge rating is 0.25, with a proficiency bonus of 2 and actions like Multiattack (bite and claws), Bite dealing 3 (1d6) piercing damage, and Claws dealing 5 (2d4) slashing damage. It can also emit a Fetid Cloud, poisoning creatures within a 10-foot radius.

name: Dragon Turtle

special_abilities.name: Amphibious
special_abilities.desc: The dragon turtle can breathe air and water.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The dragon turtle makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws. It can make one tail attack in place of its two claw attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 26 (3d12 + 7) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d8 + 7) slashing damage.

actions.name: Tail
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 26 (3d12 + 7) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 20 Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 10 feet away from the dragon turtle and knocked prone.

actions.name: Steam Breath
actions.desc: The dragon turtle exhales scalding steam in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw, taking 52 (15d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Being underwater doesn't grant resistance against this damage.

content: Dragon Turtle is a Gargantuan dragon with neutral alignment, boasting a natural armor class of 20, 341 hit points, and impressive speed of 20 ft. walking and 40 ft. swimming. With strengths in Dexterity, Constitution, Wisdom, and Charisma, this creature excels in saving throws for DEX, CON, and WIS. It has resistance to fire damage and darkvision up to 120 ft. Its Multiattack action allows for a combination of bites, claws, and tail attacks, each with unique damage and effects. Additionally, the Steam Breath ability unleashes scalding steam in a cone, requiring a Constitution saving throw to avoid significant fire damage. The Dragon Turtle's proficiency bonus is 6, making it a formidable opponent with a challenge rating of 17.

name: Drider

special_abilities.name: Fey Ancestry
special_abilities.desc: The drider has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put the drider to sleep.

special_abilities.name: Innate Spellcasting
special_abilities.desc:
The drider's innate spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 13). The drider can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: dancing lights
1/day each: darkness, faerie fire

special_abilities.name: Spider Climb
special_abilities.desc: The drider can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

special_abilities.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
special_abilities.desc: While in sunlight, the drider has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

special_abilities.name: Web Walker
special_abilities.desc: The drider ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The drider makes three attacks, either with its longsword or its longbow. It can replace one of those attacks with a bite attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 2 (1d4) piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) poison damage.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage, or 8 (1d10 + 3) slashing damage if used with two hands.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) poison damage.

content: Drider is a Large monstrosity with chaotic evil alignment, boasting a natural armor class of 19 and 123 hit points from 13d10 hit dice. It has a speed of 30 ft. for walking and climbing. With strengths in strength, dexterity, constitution, intelligence, wisdom, and charisma, it excels in stealth and perception skills. Senses include darkvision up to 120 ft. and passive perception of 15. This creature speaks Elvish and Undercommon, has a challenge rating of 6, and a proficiency bonus of 3. Notable abilities include Fey Ancestry, Innate Spellcasting with spells like dancing lights and faerie fire, Spider Climb, Sunlight Sensitivity, and Web Walker. In combat, it can make three attacks with options for longsword, longbow, and bite attacks. The longsword deals slashing damage, the longbow inflicts piercing and poison damage, and the bite attack combines piercing and poison damage.

name: Drow

special_abilities.name: Fey Ancestry
special_abilities.desc: The drow has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put the drow to sleep.

special_abilities.name: Innate Spellcasting
special_abilities.desc:
The drow's spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 11). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: dancing lights
1/day each: darkness, faerie fire

special_abilities.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
special_abilities.desc: While in sunlight, the drow has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Hand Crossbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 hour. If the saving throw fails by 5 or more, the target is also unconscious while poisoned in this way. The target wakes up if it takes damage or if another creature takes an action to shake it awake.

content: Drow is a Medium humanoid subtype elf with neutral evil alignment, wearing Chain Shirt armor with an armor class of 15. They have 13 hit points, 30 ft. walk speed, and proficiency in Perception and Stealth skills. With a proficiency bonus of 2, they have darkvision up to 120 ft. and passive perception of 12. Drow have Fey Ancestry granting advantage against being charmed and immunity to sleep spells. They possess Innate Spellcasting ability with spells like dancing lights, darkness, and faerie fire. Sunlight Sensitivity gives them disadvantage in sunlight. In combat, Drow use a Shortsword for melee attacks and a Hand Crossbow for ranged attacks, both dealing piercing damage.

name: Druid
desc: **Druids** dwell in forests and other secluded wilderness locations, where they protect the natural world from monsters and the encroachment of civilization. Some are **tribal shamans** who heal the sick, pray to animal spirits, and provide spiritual guidance.

special_abilities.name: Spellcasting
special_abilities.desc:
The druid is a 4th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 12, +4 to hit with spell attacks). It has the following druid spells prepared:

- Cantrips (at will): druidcraft, produce flame, shillelagh
- 1st level (4 slots): entangle, longstrider, speak with animals, thunderwave
- 2nd level (3 slots): animal messenger, barkskin

actions.name: Quarterstaff
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit (+4 to hit with shillelagh), reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage, 4 (1d8) bludgeoning damage if wielded with two hands, or 6 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage with shillelagh.

content: The Druid is a Medium humanoid with any race subtype and an alignment of any alignment. They have 27 hit points with a hit dice of 5d8+5, a speed of 30 ft., and a passive perception of 14. The Druid is proficient in skills like Medicine, Nature, and Perception, and has a proficiency bonus of 2. They are a 4th-level spellcaster with a spell save DC of 12 and +4 to hit with spell attacks. The Druid has spells like druidcraft, produce flame, shillelagh, entangle, longstrider, speak with animals, thunderwave, animal messenger, and barkskin. In combat, they use a Quarterstaff for melee attacks, dealing bludgeoning damage with different options for damage dice and bonuses. The Druid's abilities include tribal shamanism, healing, and spiritual guidance, making them protectors of the natural world from monsters and civilization.

name: Doppelganger

special_abilities.name: Shapechanger
special_abilities.desc: The doppelganger can use its action to polymorph into a Small or Medium humanoid it has seen, or back into its true form. Its statistics, other than its size, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

special_abilities.name: Ambusher
special_abilities.desc: In the first round of combat, the doppelganger has advantage on attack rolls against any creature it has surprised.

special_abilities.name: Surprise Attack
special_abilities.desc: If the doppelganger surprises a creature and hits it with an attack during the first round of combat, the target takes an extra 10 (3d6) damage from the attack.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The doppelganger makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Read Thoughts
actions.desc: The doppelganger magically reads the surface thoughts of one creature within 60 ft. of it. The effect can penetrate barriers, but 3 ft. of wood or dirt, 2 ft. of stone, 2 inches of metal, or a thin sheet of lead blocks it. While the target is in range, the doppelganger can continue reading its thoughts, as long as the doppelganger's concentration isn't broken (as if concentrating on a spell). While reading the target's mind, the doppelganger has advantage on Wisdom (Insight) and Charisma (Deception, Intimidation, and Persuasion) checks against the target.

content: The Doppelganger is a Medium monstrosity with the subtype shapechanger, unaligned alignment, and 14 Dexterity armor class. It has 52 hit points, 30 ft. walk speed, and proficiency in Deception (6) and Insight (3). This creature is immune to being charmed and has darkvision up to 60 ft. It can polymorph into humanoid forms, gains advantage on surprise attacks, and deals extra damage in the first round of combat. In battle, the Doppelganger can make two melee attacks with its Slam ability, dealing 7 bludgeoning damage. Additionally, it can read the surface thoughts of creatures within 60 ft., granting advantages on certain checks. This shapechanger presents a challenge rating of 3 and is proficient in Common language.

name: Duergar

special_abilities.name: Duergar Resilience
special_abilities.desc: The duergar has advantage on saving throws against poison, spells, and illusions, as well as to resist being charmed or paralyzed.

special_abilities.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
special_abilities.desc: While in sunlight, the duergar has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: Enlarge
actions.desc: For 1 minute, the duergar magically increases in size, along with anything it is wearing or carrying. While enlarged, the duergar is Large, doubles its damage dice on Strength-based weapon attacks (included in the attacks), and makes Strength checks and Strength saving throws with advantage. If the duergar lacks the room to become Large, it attains the maximum size possible in the space available.

actions.name: War Pick
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage, or 11 (2d8 + 2) piercing damage while enlarged.

actions.name: Javelin
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage, or 9 (2d6 + 2) piercing damage while enlarged.

actions.name: Invisibility
actions.desc: The duergar magically turns invisible until it attacks, casts a spell, or uses its Enlarge, or until its concentration is broken, up to 1 hour (as if concentrating on a spell). Any equipment the duergar wears or carries is invisible with it.

content: The Duergar is a Medium humanoid subtype dwarf with lawful evil alignment, 16 armor class from Scale Mail and Shield, 26 hit points, 4d8 hit dice, 25 ft. walk speed, 14 strength, 11 dexterity, 14 constitution, 11 intelligence, 10 wisdom, and 9 charisma. It has resistance to poison damage, darkvision of 120 ft., and passive perception of 10. This creature is proficient in Dwarvish and Undercommon languages, has a challenge rating of 1, and a proficiency bonus of 2. Special abilities include Duergar Resilience granting advantage on saving throws against poison, spells, illusions, charm, and paralysis, as well as Sunlight Sensitivity causing disadvantage in sunlight. Actions include Enlarge ability to increase size and damage, War Pick melee attack dealing piercing damage, Javelin melee or ranged attack dealing bludgeoning damage, and Invisibility granting invisibility until attacking or using abilities.

name: Eagle

special_abilities.name: Keen Sight
special_abilities.desc: The eagle has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: Talons
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage.

content: The Eagle is a Small beast with unaligned alignment, an armor class of 12 based on dexterity, 3 hit points, and a walking speed of 10 ft. and flying speed of 60 ft. It has a strength of 6, dexterity of 15, constitution of 10, intelligence of 2, wisdom of 14, and charisma of 7. The Eagle is proficient in Perception with a bonus of 4 and has a passive perception of 14. It has a proficiency bonus of 2 and a challenge rating of 0, with special ability Keen Sight granting advantage on Perception checks relying on sight. The Eagle's action includes Talons attack with a +4 to hit, dealing 4 slashing damage.

name: Dryad

special_abilities.name: Innate Spellcasting
special_abilities.desc:
The dryad's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 14). The dryad can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

At will: druidcraft
3/day each: entangle, goodberry
1/day each: barkskin, pass without trace, shillelagh

special_abilities.name: Magic Resistance
special_abilities.desc: The dryad has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

special_abilities.name: Speak with Beasts and Plants
special_abilities.desc: The dryad can communicate with beasts and plants as if they shared a language.

special_abilities.name: Tree Stride
special_abilities.desc: Once on her turn, the dryad can use 10 ft. of her movement to step magically into one living tree within her reach and emerge from a second living tree within 60 ft. of the first tree, appearing in an unoccupied space within 5 ft. of the second tree. Both trees must be large or bigger.

actions.name: Club
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit (+6 to hit with shillelagh), reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2 (1 d4) bludgeoning damage, or 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage with shillelagh.

actions.name: Fey Charm
actions.desc:
The dryad targets one humanoid or beast that she can see within 30 feet of her. If the target can see the dryad, it must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be magically charmed. The charmed creature regards the dryad as a trusted friend to be heeded and protected. Although the target isn't under the dryad's control, it takes the dryad's requests or actions in the most favorable way it can.
Each time the dryad or its allies do anything harmful to the target, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success. Otherwise, the effect lasts 24 hours or until the dryad dies, is on a different plane of existence from the target, or ends the effect as a bonus action. If a target's saving throw is successful, the target is immune to the dryad's Fey Charm for the next 24 hours.
The dryad can have no more than one humanoid and up to three beasts charmed at a time.

content: The Dryad is a Medium fey creature with neutral alignment, proficient in Dexterity (AC 11) and spellcasting (AC 16 with Barkskin). It has 22 hit points, a speed of 30 ft., and heightened abilities in Charisma (18), Wisdom (15), and Intelligence (14). The Dryad is skilled in Perception and Stealth, has Darkvision (60 ft.) and a passive Perception of 14, speaks Elvish and Sylvan, and possesses innate spellcasting abilities including druidcraft, entangle, goodberry, barkskin, pass without trace, and shillelagh. It also has Magic Resistance, the ability to communicate with beasts and plants, and can use Tree Stride to travel between trees. In combat, the Dryad wields a Club and can charm humanoids and beasts within 30 ft. with Fey Charm, imposing a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw.

name: Dust Mephit

special_abilities.name: Death Burst
special_abilities.desc: When the mephit dies, it explodes in a burst of dust. Each creature within 5 ft. of it must then succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or be blinded for 1 minute. A blinded creature can repeat the saving throw on each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

special_abilities.name: Innate Spellcasting
special_abilities.desc: The mephit can innately cast sleep, requiring no material components. Its innate spellcasting ability is Charisma.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage.

actions.name: Blinding Breath
actions.desc: The mephit exhales a 15-foot cone of blinding dust. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 10 Dexterity saving throw or be blinded for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

content: The Dust Mephit is a Small elemental creature with neutral evil alignment. It has an armor class of 12 based on dexterity, 17 hit points, and a speed of 30 ft. walking and flying. This mephit is proficient in Perception and Stealth skills, has darkvision up to 60 ft., and immunity to poison damage. It also has a challenge rating of 0.5, a proficiency bonus of 2, and special abilities like Death Burst and Innate Spellcasting with the spell Sleep. In combat, it can use its Claws to deal slashing damage and Blinding Breath to blind creatures in a cone. Overall, the Dust Mephit is a dangerous creature with unique abilities and resistances.

name: Earth Elemental
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons

special_abilities.name: Earth Glide
special_abilities.desc: The elemental can burrow through nonmagical, unworked earth and stone. While doing so, the elemental doesn't disturb the material it moves through.

special_abilities.name: Siege Monster
special_abilities.desc: The elemental deals double damage to objects and structures.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The elemental makes two slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

content: The Earth Elemental is a Large elemental creature with neutral alignment, boasting an impressive natural armor class of 17 and 126 hit points from 12d10 hit dice. With a strength of 20 and constitution of 20, it excels in physical combat, while having vulnerabilities to thunder damage and immunities to poison. It possesses darkvision, tremorsense, and a passive perception of 10, as well as the ability to burrow through earth and stone with Earth Glide, and deal double damage to objects as a Siege Monster. In combat, it can make two slam attacks with a +8 attack bonus and deal 14 bludgeoning damage per hit. Its proficiency bonus is 3, and it speaks Terran, challenging adventurers with a CR of 5.

name: Efreeti

special_abilities.name: Elemental Demise
special_abilities.desc: If the efreeti dies, its body disintegrates in a flash of fire and puff of smoke, leaving behind only equipment the djinni was wearing or carrying.

special_abilities.name: Innate Spellcasting
special_abilities.desc:
The efreeti's innate spell casting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 15, +7 to hit with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

At will: detect magic
3/day: enlarge/reduce, tongues
1/day each: conjure elemental (fire elemental only), gaseous form, invisibility, major image, plane shift, wall of fire

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The efreeti makes two scimitar attacks or uses its Hurl Flame twice.

actions.name: Scimitar
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) fire damage.

actions.name: Hurl Flame
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack: +7 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (5d6) fire damage.

content: The Efreeti is a Large elemental creature with a lawful evil alignment, possessing a natural armor class of 17 and 200 hit points. It has a strength of 22, dexterity of 12, constitution of 24, intelligence of 16, wisdom of 15, and charisma of 16. This creature has damage immunities to fire, darkvision up to 120 ft., and passive perception of 12. It speaks Ignan and has a challenge rating of 11. The Efreeti's special abilities include Elemental Demise, where its body disintegrates in fire upon death, and Innate Spellcasting using Charisma with various spells like detect magic and invisibility. In combat, it can use Multiattack with scimitar attacks or Hurl Flame, dealing slashing and fire damage.

name: Djinni

special_abilities.name: Elemental Demise
special_abilities.desc: If the djinni dies, its body disintegrates into a warm breeze, leaving behind only equipment the djinni was wearing or carrying.

special_abilities.name: Innate Spellcasting
special_abilities.desc:
The djinni's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 17, +9 to hit with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

At will: detect evil and good, detect magic, thunderwave
3/day each: create food and water (can create wine instead of water), tongues, wind walk
1/day each: conjure elemental (air elemental only), creation, gaseous form, invisibility, major image, plane shift

spells.name: Create Food and Water
spells.notes: Can create wine instead of water

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The djinni makes three scimitar attacks.

actions.name: Scimitar
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) lightning or thunder damage (djinni's choice).

actions.name: Create Whirlwind
actions.desc:
A 5-foot-radius, 30-foot-tall cylinder of swirling air magically forms on a point the djinni can see within 120 feet of it. The whirlwind lasts as long as the djinni maintains concentration (as if concentrating on a spell). Any creature but the djinni that enters the whirlwind must succeed on a DC 18 Strength saving throw or be restrained by it. The djinni can move the whirlwind up to 60 feet as an action, and creatures restrained by the whirlwind move with it. The whirlwind ends if the djinni loses sight of it.
A creature can use its action to free a creature restrained by the whirlwind, including itself, by succeeding on a DC 18 Strength check. If the check succeeds, the creature is no longer restrained and moves to the nearest space outside the whirlwind.

content: The Djinni is a Large elemental creature with chaotic good alignment, boasting an armor class of 17 and 161 hit points. With a proficiency bonus of 4, this creature excels in saving throws for DEX, WIS, and CHA. It has damage immunities to lightning and thunder, darkvision of 120 ft., and the ability to fly at a speed of 90 ft. It possesses innate spellcasting abilities, including spells like detect evil and good, wind walk, and plane shift. In combat, the Djinni can make three scimitar attacks and create a whirlwind that restrains creatures within it. Additionally, it has impressive ability scores, including 21 in strength, 22 in constitution, and 20 in charisma. Overall, the Djinni's versatile skills and powerful abilities make it a formidable foe with unique elemental powers.

name: Elephant

special_abilities.name: Trampling Charge
special_abilities.desc: If the elephant moves at least 20 ft. straight toward a creature and then hits it with a gore attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 12 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the elephant can make one stomp attack against it as a bonus action.

actions.name: Gore
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) piercing damage.

actions.name: Stomp
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one prone creature. Hit: 22 (3d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

content: Elephant is a Huge (Size) beast with unaligned (Alignment) tendencies. It has a natural armor class of 12 and 76 hit points, derived from 8d12 hit dice. With a speed of 40 ft. (Walk), it possesses impressive strength (22) and constitution (17). Its special ability, Trampling Charge, allows it to knock prone targets with a DC 12 Strength saving throw and make a stomp attack as a bonus action. In combat, it can use its Gore attack with a +8 attack bonus and deal 19 piercing damage, or its Stomp attack with a +8 attack bonus and deal 22 bludgeoning damage. This formidable creature has a challenge rating of 4 and a passive perception of 10.

name: Elk

special_abilities.name: Charge
special_abilities.desc: If the elk moves at least 20 ft. straight toward a target and then hits it with a ram attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 7 (2d6) damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Ram
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Hooves
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one prone creature. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

content: The Elk is a Large beast with an unaligned alignment and an Armor Class of 10 based on Dexterity. It has 13 hit points, moves at a speed of 50 ft., and has a Strength of 16, Dexterity of 10, Constitution of 12, Intelligence of 2, Wisdom of 10, and Charisma of 6. With a Challenge Rating of 0.25, it has a proficiency bonus of 2 and a passive perception of 10. The Elk's special ability, Charge, allows it to deal extra damage and potentially knock a target prone. Its actions include Ram and Hooves, both dealing bludgeoning damage with different attack bonuses and dice rolls. This creature is known for its powerful physical attacks and swift movement in combat.

name: Ettercap

special_abilities.name: Spider Climb
special_abilities.desc: The ettercap can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

special_abilities.name: Web Sense
special_abilities.desc: While in contact with a web, the ettercap knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

special_abilities.name: Web Walker
special_abilities.desc: The ettercap ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The ettercap makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) poison damage. The target must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) slashing damage.

actions.name: Web
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 30/60 ft., one Large or smaller creature. Hit: The creature is restrained by webbing. As an action, the restrained creature can make a DC 11 Strength check, escaping from the webbing on a success. The effect ends if the webbing is destroyed. The webbing has AC 10, 5 hit points, is vulnerable to fire damage and immune to bludgeoning damage.

content: The ettercap is a Medium monstrosity with neutral evil alignment, having a natural armor class of 13 and 44 hit points. It has a speed of 30 ft. for both walking and climbing, along with strengths in dexterity and constitution. Notable proficiencies include Perception, Stealth, and Survival, each with values of 3 or 4. This creature has darkvision up to 60 ft. and a passive perception of 13. Special abilities include Spider Climb, Web Sense, and Web Walker, enhancing its climbing and sensory capabilities. In combat, the ettercap can make two attacks with its bite and claws as part of its Multiattack action. Its bite inflicts piercing and poison damage, while its claws deal slashing damage. Additionally, it can use its Web ability to restrain foes from a distance. With a challenge rating of 2, this monster is a formidable opponent for adventurers.

name: Ettin

special_abilities.name: Two Heads
special_abilities.desc: The ettin has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks and on saving throws against being blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, stunned, and knocked unconscious.

special_abilities.name: Wakeful
special_abilities.desc: When one of the ettin's heads is asleep, its other head is awake.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The ettin makes two attacks: one with its battleaxe and one with its morningstar.

actions.name: Battleaxe
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) slashing damage.

actions.name: Morningstar
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage.

content: The Ettin is a Large giant with chaotic evil alignment, boasting a natural armor class of 12 and 85 hit points from 10d10 hit dice. With a speed of 40 ft., it possesses impressive strength (21) but lacks in dexterity (8) and charisma (8). It excels in Perception, with a proficiency bonus of 4 and darkvision of 60 ft. The Ettin's special abilities include Two Heads, granting advantage on Perception checks and saving throws against various conditions, and Wakeful, allowing one head to remain awake while the other sleeps. In combat, it utilizes a Multiattack action involving a battleaxe and morningstar, each with an attack bonus of +7 and dealing 14 slashing and piercing damage, respectively. With language proficiency in Giant and Orc, this creature presents a challenge rating of 4 and offers 1100 XP upon defeat.

name: Fire Elemental
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons

special_abilities.name: Fire Form
special_abilities.desc: The elemental can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing. A creature that touches the elemental or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 ft. of it takes 5 (1d10) fire damage. In addition, the elemental can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. The first time it enters a creature's space on a turn, that creature takes 5 (1d10) fire damage and catches fire; until someone takes an action to douse the fire, the creature takes 5 (1d10) fire damage at the start of each of its turns.

special_abilities.name: Illumination
special_abilities.desc: The elemental sheds bright light in a 30-foot radius and dim light in an additional 30 ft..

special_abilities.name: Water Susceptibility
special_abilities.desc: For every 5 ft. the elemental moves in water, or for every gallon of water splashed on it, it takes 1 cold damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The elemental makes two touch attacks.

actions.name: Touch
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) fire damage. If the target is a creature or a flammable object, it ignites. Until a creature takes an action to douse the fire, the target takes 5 (1d10) fire damage at the start of each of its turns.

content: The Fire Elemental is a Large elemental creature with a neutral alignment, having an armor class of 13 based on dexterity. It has 102 hit points, with a hit dice of 12d10 and a hit points roll of 12d10+36. The elemental has a walking speed of 50 ft. and is immune to fire and poison damage, while resistant to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons. It is vulnerable to cold damage in water. The creature can move through narrow spaces without squeezing and can deal fire damage to creatures within 5 ft. Its senses include darkvision up to 60 ft. and a passive perception of 10. The Fire Elemental speaks Ignan and has a challenge rating of 5, with special abilities like Fire Form, Illumination, and Water Susceptibility. In combat, it can make two touch attacks with a +6 attack bonus, dealing 10 fire damage on hit. If ignited, the target takes additional fire damage at the start of each turn until extinguished.

name: Erinyes
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons that aren't silvered

special_abilities.name: Hellish Weapons
special_abilities.desc: The erinyes's weapon attacks are magical and deal an extra 13 (3d8) poison damage on a hit (included in the attacks).

special_abilities.name: Magic Resistance
special_abilities.desc: The erinyes has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The erinyes makes three attacks

actions.name: Longsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage, or 9 (1d10 + 4) slashing damage if used with two hands, plus 13 (3d8) poison damage.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage plus 13 (3d8) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned. The poison lasts until it is removed by the lesser restoration spell or similar magic.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.desc: The erinyes adds 4 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it. To do so, the erinyes must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

content: Erinyes is a Medium fiend devil with lawful evil alignment, wearing Plate Armor with an armor class of 18. It has 153 hit points, 18d8 hit dice, and a speed of 30 ft. walking and 60 ft. flying. With strengths in dexterity, constitution, intelligence, wisdom, and charisma, it excels in saving throws for DEX, CON, WIS, and CHA. Erinyes has damage resistances to cold and nonmagical weapons without silvering, while immune to fire and poison, and immune to the Poisoned condition. It possesses truesight for 120 ft. and telepathy, understanding Infernal language. With a challenge rating of 12, it has a proficiency bonus of 4 and specialized abilities in Hellish Weapons and Magic Resistance. In combat, Erinyes utilizes the Multiattack action to make three attacks using Longsword and Longbow, dealing slashing, piercing, and poison damage. Additionally, it can react with Parry to increase its AC against melee attacks.

name: Fire Giant

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The giant makes two greatsword attacks.

actions.name: Greatsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 28 (6d6 + 7) slashing damage.

actions.name: Rock
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. Hit: 29 (4d10 + 7) bludgeoning damage.

content: The Fire Giant is a Huge giant with an armor class of 18, wearing Plate Armor. It has 162 hit points and a speed of 30 ft. Its main attributes include Strength (25), Constitution (23), and Wisdom (14). The giant is proficient in saving throws for Dexterity, Constitution, and Charisma, as well as in skills like Athletics and Perception. It is immune to fire damage and has a passive perception of 16. In combat, the Fire Giant can make two Greatsword attacks or throw Rocks at its enemies. With a challenge rating of 9 and an XP value of 5000, this formidable creature poses a significant threat.

name: Flesh Golem
damage_immunities: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons that aren't adamantine
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

special_abilities.name: Berserk
special_abilities.desc:
Whenever the golem starts its turn with 40 hit points or fewer, roll a d6. On a 6, the golem goes berserk. On each of its turns while berserk, the golem attacks the nearest creature it can see. If no creature is near enough to move to and attack, the golem attacks an object, with preference for an object smaller than itself. Once the golem goes berserk, it continues to do so until it is destroyed or regains all its hit points.
The golem's creator, if within 60 feet of the berserk golem, can try to calm it by speaking firmly and persuasively. The golem must be able to hear its creator, who must take an action to make a DC 15 Charisma (Persuasion) check. If the check succeeds, the golem ceases being berserk. If it takes damage while still at 40 hit points or fewer, the golem might go berserk again.

special_abilities.name: Aversion of Fire
special_abilities.desc: If the golem takes fire damage, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the end of its next turn.

special_abilities.name: Immutable Form
special_abilities.desc: The golem is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

special_abilities.name: Lightning Absorption
special_abilities.desc: Whenever the golem is subjected to lightning damage, it takes no damage and instead regains a number of hit points equal to the lightning damage dealt.

special_abilities.name: Magic Resistance
special_abilities.desc: The golem has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

special_abilities.name: Magic Weapons
special_abilities.desc: The golem's weapon attacks are magical.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The golem makes two slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

content: The Flesh Golem is a Medium construct with neutral alignment having an armor class of 9 based on dexterity. It has 93 hit points from 11d8 hit dice with a hit point roll of 11d8+44. With a speed of 30 ft. walk, the golem has strength of 19, dexterity of 9, constitution of 18, intelligence of 6, wisdom of 10, and charisma of 5. It is immune to lightning, poison, and nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage not from adamantine weapons. The golem is immune to charm, exhaustion, fright, paralysis, petrification, and poisoning. It has darkvision of 60 ft. and passive perception of 10, understanding but unable to speak its creator's languages. With a challenge rating of 5 and proficiency bonus of 3, it is worth 1800 experience points. Special abilities include Berserk, Aversion of Fire, Immutable Form, Lightning Absorption, Magic Resistance, and Magic Weapons. The golem can make two slam attacks as part of its Multiattack action, each having a +7 to hit and dealing 13 bludgeoning damage with a reach of 5 ft.

name: Frog
desc: A frog has no effective attacks. It feeds on small insects and typically dwells near water, in trees, or underground. The frog’s statistics can also be used to represent a toad.

special_abilities.name: Amphibious
special_abilities.desc: The frog can breathe air and water

special_abilities.name: Standing Leap
special_abilities.desc: The frog's long jump is up to 10 ft. and its high jump is up to 5 ft., with or without a running start.

content: The Frog is a Tiny beast with unaligned alignment and an Armor Class of 11, hit points of 1, and a speed of 20 ft. for both walking and swimming. It has low stats in strength, constitution, intelligence, wisdom, and charisma, but higher dexterity at 13. The frog is proficient in Perception and Stealth skills, has darkvision of 30 ft., and passive perception of 11. It has no damage vulnerabilities, resistances, or immunities, and is immune to conditions. The frog has special abilities like Amphibious, allowing it to breathe air and water, and Standing Leap, enabling long jumps up to 10 ft. and high jumps up to 5 ft. It is a basic monster with a challenge rating of 0 and proficiency bonus of 2.

name: Flying Sword

special_abilities.name: Antimagic Susceptibility
special_abilities.desc: The sword is incapacitated while in the area of an antimagic field. If targeted by dispel magic, the sword must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the caster's spell save DC or fall unconscious for 1 minute.

special_abilities.name: False Appearance
special_abilities.desc: While the sword remains motionless and isn't flying, it is indistinguishable from a normal sword.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) slashing damage.

content: The Flying Sword is a Small construct with a natural armor class of 17, 17 hit points, and a flying speed of 50 ft. It has a hover ability and is unaligned, with immunity to poison and psychic damage. This creature is proficient in Dexterity saving throws, with a proficiency bonus of 2, and has special abilities like Antimagic Susceptibility and False Appearance. The sword can use a Longsword attack with a +3 bonus to hit, dealing 5 slashing damage. It has condition immunities to blindness, charm, fear, paralysis, petrification, and poisoning, as well as blindsight up to 60 ft. and passive perception of 7. The Flying Sword has average attributes in Strength, Constitution, Wisdom, and Charisma, with higher scores in Dexterity and Intelligence. Overall, it is a challenging opponent with unique abilities and combat tactics.

name: Flying Snake
desc: A flying snake is a brightly colored, winged serpent found in remote jungles. Tribespeople and cultists sometimes domesticate flying snakes to serve as messengers that deliver scrolls wrapped in their coils.

special_abilities.name: Flyby
special_abilities.desc: The snake doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing damage plus 7 (3d4) poison damage.

content: The Flying Snake is a Tiny beast with unaligned alignment, having an armor class of 14 based on dexterity. It has 5 hit points, 2d4 hit dice, and a speed of 30 ft. walking, 60 ft. flying, and 30 ft. swimming. With a strength of 4, dexterity of 18, constitution of 11, intelligence of 2, wisdom of 12, and charisma of 5, the snake has blindsight of 10 ft. and a passive perception of 11. Its challenge rating is 0.125, and it has a proficiency bonus of 2. The snake's special ability, Flyby, allows it to avoid opportunity attacks when flying out of an enemy's reach. Its main action is a Bite attack, with a +6 attack bonus, dealing 1 piercing damage plus 3d4 poison damage.

name: Frost Giant

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The giant makes two greataxe attacks.

actions.name: Greataxe
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 25 (3d12 + 6) slashing damage.

actions.name: Rock
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. Hit: 28 (4d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

content: The Frost Giant is a Huge creature with neutral evil alignment and patchwork armor for an armor class of 15. It has 138 hit points from 12d12 hit dice and a Constitution saving throw proficiency of 8. With a strength of 23, the giant can move at a speed of 40 ft. and has damage immunities to cold. It has a proficiency bonus of 3 and a challenge rating of 8, granting 3900 XP. In combat, the giant can make two greataxe attacks as a Multiattack action, dealing 25 slashing damage with each hit. It also has a ranged Rock attack that deals 28 bludgeoning damage. The giant's passive perception is 13, and it speaks Giant language.

name: Gargoyle
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons that aren't adamantine

special_abilities.name: False Appearance
special_abilities.desc: While the gargoyle remains motion less, it is indistinguishable from an inanimate statue.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The gargoyle makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage.

content: The Gargoyle is a Medium elemental creature with a chaotic evil alignment, possessing a natural armor class of 15 and 52 hit points. It has a speed of 30 ft. walking and 60 ft. flying, with strength 15, dexterity 11, constitution 16, intelligence 6, wisdom 11, and charisma 7. Resistant to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical weapons, it is immune to poison and immune to exhaustion, petrification, and poisoning conditions. With darkvision of 60 ft. and passive perception of 10, it speaks Terran and has a challenge rating of 2. The Gargoyle's special ability is False Appearance, allowing it to appear as an inanimate statue when motionless. In combat, it can make two attacks with its bite and claws. Its bite attack has +4 to hit and deals 5 piercing damage, while its claws attack also has +4 to hit and deals 5 slashing damage.

name: Gelatinous Cube

special_abilities.name: Ooze Cube
special_abilities.desc:
The cube takes up its entire space. Other creatures can enter the space, but a creature that does so is subjected to the cube's Engulf and has disadvantage on the saving throw.
Creatures inside the cube can be seen but have total cover.
A creature within 5 feet of the cube can take an action to pull a creature or object out of the cube. Doing so requires a successful DC 12 Strength check, and the creature making the attempt takes 10 (3d6) acid damage.
The cube can hold only one Large creature or up to four Medium or smaller creatures inside it at a time.

special_abilities.name: Transparent
special_abilities.desc: Even when the cube is in plain sight, it takes a successful DC 15 Wisdom (Perception) check to spot a cube that has neither moved nor attacked. A creature that tries to enter the cube's space while unaware of the cube is surprised by the cube.

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 10 (3d6) acid damage.

actions.name: Engulf
actions.desc:
The cube moves up to its speed. While doing so, it can enter Large or smaller creatures' spaces. Whenever the cube enters a creature's space, the creature must make a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw.
On a successful save, the creature can choose to be pushed 5 feet back or to the side of the cube. A creature that chooses not to be pushed suffers the consequences of a failed saving throw.
On a failed save, the cube enters the creature's space, and the creature takes 10 (3d6) acid damage and is engulfed. The engulfed creature can't breathe, is restrained, and takes 21 (6d6) acid damage at the start of each of the cube's turns. When the cube moves, the engulfed creature moves with it.
An engulfed creature can try to escape by taking an action to make a DC 12 Strength check. On a success, the creature escapes and enters a space of its choice within 5 feet of the cube.

content: The Gelatinous Cube is a Large ooze creature with unaligned alignment, possessing 84 hit points derived from 8d10 hit dice with a hit points roll of 8d10+40. It has a low dexterity of 3 but compensates with a high constitution of 20 and strength of 14. The cube's senses include blindsight up to 60 ft. and a passive perception of 8. It is immune to conditions like being blinded, charmed, deafened, exhausted, frightened, and prone. The cube's special abilities include Ooze Cube, allowing it to engulf and trap creatures within its space, and its transparency makes it hard to spot when motionless. It can attack with its Pseudopod and Engulf actions, dealing acid damage. Overall, the Gelatinous Cube poses a challenge rating of 2 and provides a proficiency bonus of 2, making it a formidable opponent in combat.

name: Ghoul

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) slashing damage. If the target is a creature other than an elf or undead, it must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or be paralyzed for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

content: The Ghoul is a Medium undead creature with chaotic evil alignment, armor class of 12 based on dexterity, 22 hit points, and a speed of 30 ft. It has strength of 13, dexterity of 15, constitution of 10, intelligence of 7, wisdom of 10, and charisma of 6. The Ghoul is immune to poison damage and has condition immunities to being poisoned, charmed, and exhaustion. It has darkvision of 60 ft. and passive perception of 10, speaks Common, and has a challenge rating of 1. The Ghoul's actions include Bite and Claws, with corresponding attack bonuses and damage types. The Bite attack deals 2d6+2 piercing damage, while the Claws attack deals 2d4+2 slashing damage and can paralyze non-elf, non-undead targets on a failed saving throw.

name: Ghast

special_abilities.name: Stench
special_abilities.desc: Any creature that starts its turn within 5 ft. of the ghast must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the start of its next turn. On a successful saving throw, the creature is immune to the ghast's Stench for 24 hours.

special_abilities.name: Turn Defiance
special_abilities.desc: The ghast and any ghouls within 30 ft. of it have advantage on saving throws against effects that turn undead.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage. If the target is a creature other than an undead, it must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or be paralyzed for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

content: Ghast is a Medium undead creature with chaotic evil alignment, an armor class of 13 from dexterity, 36 hit points, and a speed of 30 ft. It has strength, dexterity, constitution, intelligence, wisdom, and charisma scores of 16, 17, 10, 11, 10, and 8 respectively. This ghast has damage resistances to necrotic damage and immunities to poison damage. It is immune to being poisoned, charmed, and exhausted. With darkvision of 60 ft. and passive perception of 10, this ghast speaks Common and poses a challenge rating of 2. Its special abilities include Stench which poisons creatures within 5 ft. of it and Turn Defiance which grants advantage against effects that turn undead. In combat, it can use Bite for piercing damage or Claws for slashing damage and potential paralysis.

name: Giant Ape

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The ape makes two fist attacks.

actions.name: Fist
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (3d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Rock
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, range 50/100 ft., one target. Hit: 30 (7d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

content: The Giant Ape is a Huge beast with unaligned alignment, an armor class of 12 (based on Dexterity), 157 hit points, and a speed of 40 ft. walking and climbing. It has impressive stats with 23 strength, 14 dexterity, 18 constitution, 12 wisdom, and 7 charisma. The ape excels in Athletics with a proficiency of 9 and Perception with a proficiency of 4. In combat, it can make multiple Fist attacks with a +9 to hit and deals 22 bludgeoning damage with 3d10 + 6 dice. Additionally, it can throw Rocks with a +9 to hit, reaching 50/100 ft., and dealing 30 bludgeoning damage with 7d6 + 6 dice. This formidable creature has a challenge rating of 7 and is worth 2900 XP.

name: Giant Badger

special_abilities.name: Keen Smell
special_abilities.desc: The badger has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The badger makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (2d4 + 1) slashing damage.

content: The Giant Badger is a Medium-sized beast with unaligned alignment, an armor class of 10 (dex), 13 hit points, and a challenge rating of 0.25. It has a speed of 30 ft. (walk) and 10 ft. (burrow), with strengths in Wisdom (12) and Constitution (15). This creature possesses the special ability Keen Smell, granting advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell. In combat, the Giant Badger can perform Multiattack, making two attacks with its Bite and Claws. The Bite attack has a +3 to hit and deals 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage, while the Claws attack has the same hit bonus and inflicts 6 (2d4 + 1) slashing damage. Additionally, it has darkvision of 30 ft. and passive perception of 11. This versatile creature is proficient in no skills but has a proficiency bonus of 2.

name: Ghost
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons
languages: any languages it knew in life

special_abilities.name: Ethereal Sight
special_abilities.desc: The ghost can see 60 ft. into the Ethereal Plane when it is on the Material Plane, and vice versa.

special_abilities.name: Incorporeal Movement
special_abilities.desc: The ghost can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

actions.name: Withering Touch
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (4d6 + 3) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Etherealness
actions.desc: The ghost enters the Ethereal Plane from the Material Plane, or vice versa. It is visible on the Material Plane while it is in the Border Ethereal, and vice versa, yet it can't affect or be affected by anything on the other plane.

actions.name: Horrifying Visage
actions.desc: Each non-undead creature within 60 ft. of the ghost that can see it must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1 minute. If the save fails by 5 or more, the target also ages 1d4 × 10 years. A frightened target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the frightened condition on itself on a success. If a target's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the target is immune to this ghost's Horrifying Visage for the next 24 hours. The aging effect can be reversed with a greater restoration spell, but only within 24 hours of it occurring.

actions.name: Possession
actions.desc:
One humanoid that the ghost can see within 5 ft. of it must succeed on a DC 13 Charisma saving throw or be possessed by the ghost; the ghost then disappears, and the target is incapacitated and loses control of its body. The ghost now controls the body but doesn't deprive the target of awareness. The ghost can't be targeted by any attack, spell, or other effect, except ones that turn undead, and it retains its alignment, Intelligence, Wisdom, Charisma, and immunity to being charmed and frightened. It otherwise uses the possessed target's statistics, but doesn't gain access to the target's knowledge, class features, or proficiencies.
The possession lasts until the body drops to 0 hit points, the ghost ends it as a bonus action, or the ghost is turned or forced out by an effect like the dispel evil and good spell. When the possession ends, the ghost reappears in an unoccupied space within 5 ft. of the body. The target is immune to this ghost's Possession for 24 hours after succeeding on the saving throw or after the possession ends.

content: The ghost is a Medium undead creature with any alignment, 11 dexterity armor class, 45 hit points, and a proficiency bonus of 2. It has 40 ft. of flying speed, can hover, and has darkvision for 60 ft. It is immune to cold, necrotic, and poison damage, while resistant to acid, fire, lightning, thunder, and nonmagical weapon attacks. The ghost has ethereal sight, allowing it to see into the Ethereal Plane, and incorporeal movement, enabling it to move through objects. Its actions include withering touch, etherealness, horrifying visage, and possession, each with unique effects and damage types. The ghost's special abilities make it a formidable foe, capable of frightening creatures and aging them with its horrifying visage. It also has the ability to possess humanoids within 5 ft. and control their bodies, using their statistics but retaining its own characteristics.

name: Giant Bat

special_abilities.name: Echolocation
special_abilities.desc: The bat can't use its blindsight while deafened.

special_abilities.name: Keen Hearing
special_abilities.desc: The bat has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

content: The Giant Bat is a Large beast with unaligned alignment, having an armor class of 13 based on dexterity. It has 22 hit points, with a hit dice of 4d10, and a speed of 10 ft. walking and 60 ft. flying. With strengths in dexterity and wisdom, and weaknesses in intelligence and charisma, it possesses blindsight up to 60 ft. and a passive perception of 11. Notable special abilities include Echolocation and Keen Hearing, enhancing its perception and attack capabilities. In combat, it can use its Bite action with an attack bonus of +4 to hit, dealing 5 piercing damage. Overall, the Giant Bat is a formidable creature with unique sensory abilities and agile movements.

name: Giant Boar

special_abilities.name: Charge
special_abilities.desc: If the boar moves at least 20 ft. straight toward a target and then hits it with a tusk attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 7 (2d6) slashing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

special_abilities.name: Relentless
special_abilities.desc: If the boar takes 10 damage or less that would reduce it to 0 hit points, it is reduced to 1 hit point instead.

actions.name: Tusk
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage.

content: The Giant Boar is a Large beast with unaligned alignment and an armor class of 12. It has 42 hit points and a hit dice of 5d10, with a hit points roll of 5d10+15. With a speed of 40 ft., it has strength of 17, dexterity of 10, constitution of 16, intelligence of 2, wisdom of 7, and charisma of 5. This creature has a passive perception of 8 and a challenge rating of 2, granting it a proficiency bonus of 2 and an experience points value of 450. The Giant Boar possesses the special abilities Charge, allowing it to deal extra slashing damage and potentially knock a target prone, as well as Relentless, enabling it to resist damage that would reduce it to 0 hit points by being reduced to 1 hit point instead. Its main action is Tusk, a melee weapon attack with a +5 attack bonus and dealing 10 slashing damage.

name: Giant Centipede

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or take 10 (3d6) poison damage. If the poison damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, the target is stable but poisoned for 1 hour, even after regaining hit points, and is paralyzed while poisoned in this way.

content: The Giant Centipede is a Small-sized beast with an armor class of 13 and 4 hit points. It has a proficiency bonus of 2 and a challenge rating of 0.25, granting 50 XP when defeated. This creature has a natural armor class and can move at a speed of 30 ft. by walking or climbing. It has a strength of 5, dexterity of 14, constitution of 12, intelligence of 1, wisdom of 7, and charisma of 3. The Giant Centipede has blindsight up to 30 ft. and a passive perception of 8. In combat, it can use its Bite action to make a melee weapon attack with a +4 to hit, dealing 1d4 + 2 piercing damage. Additionally, the target must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or take 3d6 poison damage and become paralyzed.

name: Giant Constrictor Snake

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Constrict
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 16). Until this grapple ends, the creature is restrained, and the snake can't constrict another target.

content: The Giant Constrictor Snake is a Huge beast with an armor class of 12 based on dexterity. It has 60 hit points, 30 ft. walk and swim speed, and a strength of 19. With proficiency in Perception, it has blindsight within 10 ft. and a passive perception of 12. This creature has a challenge rating of 2, proficiency bonus of 2, and XP worth 450. Its actions include a Bite dealing 11 piercing damage and a Constrict attack causing 13 bludgeoning damage and grapples the target with an escape DC of 16.

name: Giant Crab

special_abilities.name: Amphibious
special_abilities.desc: The crab can breathe air and water.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 11). The crab has two claws, each of which can grapple only one target.

content: Giant Crab is a Medium-sized beast with natural armor class of 15, 13 hit points, and a challenge rating of 0.125. It has a speed of 30 ft. for both walk and swim, with strength of 13, dexterity of 15, constitution of 11, intelligence of 1, wisdom of 9, and charisma of 3. This creature has proficiency in Stealth with a value of 4, passive perception of 9, and the ability to breathe air and water. Its Claw action has an attack bonus of +3 and deals 4 (1d6 + 1) bludgeoning damage, capable of grappeling targets with an escape DC of 11.

name: Giant Fire Beetle
desc: A giant fire beetle is a nocturnal creature that takes its name from a pair of glowing glands that give off light. Miners and adventurers prize these creatures, for a giant fire beetle’s glands continue to shed light for 1d6 days after the beetle dies. Giant fire beetles are most commonly found underground and in dark forests.

special_abilities.name: Illumination
special_abilities.desc: The beetle sheds bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 ft..

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +1 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2 (1d6 - 1) slashing damage.

content: The Giant Fire Beetle is a small nocturnal beast known for its glowing glands that emit light, providing illumination in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 ft. Miners and adventurers value these creatures as their glands continue to shed light for 1d6 days after death. This unaligned creature has a natural armor class of 13, 4 hit points, and a hit dice of 1d6. It has a walking speed of 30 ft. and blindsight up to 30 ft., with a passive perception of 8. The beetle has a strength of 8, dexterity of 10, constitution of 12, intelligence of 1, wisdom of 7, and charisma of 3. It is proficient in no skills or languages and has no resistances, immunities, or vulnerabilities. In combat, it can use its Bite action to make a melee weapon attack with a +1 bonus, dealing 2 slashing damage on a hit. With a challenge rating of 0 and an XP value of 10, the Giant Fire Beetle is a unique and valuable creature found underground and in dark forests.

name: Giant Elk
desc: The majestic giant elk is rare to the point that its appearance is often taken as a foreshadowing of an important event, such as the birth of a king. Legends tell of gods that take the form of giant elk when visiting the Material Plane. Many cultures therefore believe that to hunt these creatures is to invite divine wrath.
languages: Giant Elk, understands Common, Elvish, and Sylvan but can't speak

special_abilities.name: Charge
special_abilities.desc: If the elk moves at least 20 ft. straight toward a target and then hits it with a ram attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 7 (2d6) damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Ram
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Hooves
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one prone creature. Hit: 22 (4d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

content: The Giant Elk is a Huge beast with an armor class of 14 that has 42 hit points and a hit dice of 5d12+10. It has a walking speed of 60 ft. and excels in strength, dexterity, wisdom, and constitution. This majestic creature has a passive perception of 14 and proficiency in the skill of Perception. Known for its Charge ability, the elk can deal extra damage and knock targets prone with a successful ram attack. It can use its Ram and Hooves attacks to deal bludgeoning damage, with an attack bonus of +6. The Giant Elk is unaligned and speaks Giant Elk, Common, Elvish, and Sylvan but cannot vocalize. Legends suggest that encountering this rare creature signifies an important event, and hunting it may provoke divine retribution.

name: Giant Crocodile

special_abilities.name: Hold Breath
special_abilities.desc: The crocodile can hold its breath for 30 minutes.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The crocodile makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its tail.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (3d10 + 5) piercing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 16). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the crocodile can't bite another target.

actions.name: Tail
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target not grappled by the crocodile. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

content: The Giant Crocodile is a Huge beast with an armor class of 14, 85 hit points, and a speed of 30 ft. walk and 50 ft. swim. It has a strength of 21, dexterity of 9, constitution of 17, intelligence of 2, wisdom of 10, and charisma of 7. This creature is unaligned and has a challenge rating of 5. It has a proficiency bonus of 3 and a passive perception of 10. The Giant Crocodile can make two attacks with its Bite and Tail, both having a +8 to hit. Its Bite deals 21 (3d10 + 5) piercing damage and can grapple its target, while its Tail deals 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage and can knock a target prone with a DC 16 Strength saving throw. Additionally, it has the special ability Hold Breath, allowing it to hold its breath for 30 minutes. The crocodile is proficient in Stealth with a value of 5.

name: Giant Goat

special_abilities.name: Charge
special_abilities.desc: If the goat moves at least 20 ft. straight toward a target and then hits it with a ram attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 5 (2d4) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

special_abilities.name: Sure-Footed
special_abilities.desc: The goat has advantage on Strength and Dexterity saving throws made against effects that would knock it prone.

actions.name: Ram
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

content: The Giant Goat is a Large beast with an unaligned alignment, an armor class of 11 based on dexterity, 19 hit points, and a speed of 40 ft. It has a strength of 17, dexterity of 11, constitution of 12, intelligence of 3, wisdom of 12, and charisma of 6. This creature has a passive perception of 11 and proficiency bonus of 2, with special abilities like Charge that deals extra bludgeoning damage and can knock a target prone, as well as Sure-Footed which gives advantage on certain saving throws. Its main action is the Ram attack, with a +5 attack bonus and dealing 8 bludgeoning damage. The Giant Goat has a challenge rating of 0.5 and an XP value of 100.

name: Giant Eagle
desc: A giant eagle is a noble creature that speaks its own language and understands speech in the Common tongue. A mated pair of giant eagles typically has up to four eggs or young in their nest (treat the young as normal eagles).
languages: Giant Eagle, understands Common and Auran but can't speak

special_abilities.name: Keen Sight
special_abilities.desc: The eagle has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The eagle makes two attacks: one with its beak and one with its talons.

actions.name: Beak
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Talons
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage.

content: The Giant Eagle is a Large beast with neutral good alignment, having 26 hit points and a hit dice of 4d10. It has a dexterity armor class of 13 and a proficiency bonus of +2. This noble creature has a speed of 10 ft. walk and 80 ft. fly, keen sight with advantage on Perception checks relying on sight, and speaks its own language along with understanding Common and Auran. In combat, it can make two attacks with its beak and talons, each with a +5 to hit. Its beak deals 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage, while its talons deal 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage. The Giant Eagle also has a passive Perception of 14 and a special ability called Keen Sight.

name: Giant Hyena

special_abilities.name: Rampage
special_abilities.desc: When the hyena reduces a creature to 0 hit points with a melee attack on its turn, the hyena can take a bonus action to move up to half its speed and make a bite attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage.

content: The Giant Hyena is a Large beast with an armor class of 12 based on dexterity. It has 45 hit points with a hit dice of 6d10 and a hit points roll of 6d10+12. With a speed of 50 ft., it has strengths in strength, dexterity, and constitution, along with a wisdom of 12. The creature possesses proficiency in Perception with a value of 3. It has a passive perception of 13 and a challenge rating of 1, with a proficiency bonus of 2. Special abilities include Rampage, allowing it to move and make a bite attack after reducing a creature to 0 hit points.
