Its main action is Bite, with a +5 attack bonus, dealing 10 piercing damage with 2d6+3 damage dice.

name: Giant Frog

special_abilities.name: Amphibious
special_abilities.desc: The frog can breathe air and water

special_abilities.name: Standing Leap
special_abilities.desc: The frog's long jump is up to 20 ft. and its high jump is up to 10 ft., with or without a running start.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 11). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the frog can't bite another target.

actions.name: Swallow
actions.desc: The frog makes one bite attack against a Small or smaller target it is grappling. If the attack hits, the target is swallowed, and the grapple ends. The swallowed target is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the frog, and it takes 5 (2d4) acid damage at the start of each of the frog's turns. The frog can have only one target swallowed at a time. If the frog dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse using 5 ft. of movement, exiting prone.

content: The Giant Frog is a Medium sized beast with an armor class of 11 based on dexterity. It has 18 hit points, walks and swims at a speed of 30 ft., and has a proficiency bonus of 2. The frog has strengths in Perception and Stealth skills, with a passive perception of 12. It is unaligned and has a challenge rating of 0.25. The frog has the special abilities of being Amphibious and having a Standing Leap. In combat, it can use its Bite attack to grapple and restrain targets, as well as its Swallow ability to swallow smaller foes. Overall, the Giant Frog is a versatile and agile creature in the wild.

name: Giant Lizard
desc: A giant lizard can be ridden or used as a draft animal. Lizardfolk also keep them as pets, and subterranean giant lizards are used as mounts and pack animals by drow, duergar, and others.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.

content: The Giant Lizard is a Large beast with an armor class of 12 and 19 hit points. It has a speed of 30 ft. for both walking and climbing. With a strength of 15, dexterity of 12, and constitution of 13, this creature is unaligned and has a challenge rating of 0.25. In combat, it can use its Bite attack with a +4 to hit, dealing 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage. The Giant Lizard has darkvision up to 30 ft. and a passive perception of 10. It is known for being used by various humanoid races as mounts, pack animals, and pets, making it a versatile and valuable creature in many settings.

name: Giant Octopus

special_abilities.name: Hold Breath
special_abilities.desc: While out of water, the octopus can hold its breath for 1 hour.

special_abilities.desc: The octopus has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made while underwater.

special_abilities.name: Water Breathing
special_abilities.desc: The octopus can breathe only underwater.

actions.name: Ink Cloud
actions.desc: A 20-foot-radius cloud of ink extends all around the octopus if it is underwater. The area is heavily obscured for 1 minute, although a significant current can disperse the ink. After releasing the ink, the octopus can use the Dash action as a bonus action.

content: The Giant Octopus is a Large beast with an unaligned alignment, armor class of 11 (based on dexterity), 52 hit points, and a speed of 10 ft. walking and 60 ft. swimming. It has strengths in strength (17), dexterity (13), and constitution (13), along with proficiencies in Perception (value 4) and Stealth (value 5). This creature has special abilities like Hold Breath, Underwater Camouflage, and Water Breathing, as well as actions such as Tentacles and Ink Cloud. With a challenge rating of 1, proficiency bonus of 2, and XP of 200, the Giant Octopus is a formidable underwater adversary with versatile combat tactics.

special_abilities.desc: The rat has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

special_abilities.name: Pack Tactics
special_abilities.desc: The rat has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the rat's allies is within 5 ft. of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or contract a disease. Until the disease is cured, the target can't regain hit points except by magical means, and the target's hit point maximum decreases by 3 (1d6) every 24 hours. If the target's hit point maximum drops to 0 as a result of this disease, the target dies.

content: This is a Giant Rat (Diseased), a Small beast with unaligned alignment, an armor class of 12 based on dexterity, 7 hit points, and a speed of 30 ft. It has a strength of 7, dexterity of 15, constitution of 11, intelligence of 2, wisdom of 10, and charisma of 4. It has darkvision of 60 ft. and passive perception of 10. It possesses the special abilities Keen Smell and Pack Tactics, granting advantage on perception checks and attack rolls when allies are nearby. Its Bite action has an attack bonus of +4, dealing 3 piercing damage and potentially causing a disease that decreases hit points over time.

content: The Giant Poisonous Snake is a Medium-sized beast with an alignment of unaligned. It has an armor class of 14, hit points of 11, and a speed of 30 ft. in both walking and swimming. The Giant Poisonous Snake has a challenge rating of 0.25 and is worth 50 XP.

desc: Like their smaller kin, giant sea horses are shy, colorful fish with elongated bodies and curled tails. Aquatic elves train them as mounts.

special_abilities.name: Water Breathing

actions.name: Ram

content: The Giant Sea Horse is a Large beast with a natural armor class of 13, 16 hit points, and a swim speed of 40 ft. It has average strength, above-average dexterity, and slightly below-average constitution, wisdom, and charisma. This aquatic creature is unaligned and has a challenge rating of 0.5, with special abilities like Charge, allowing it to deal extra bludgeoning damage when moving towards a target, and Water Breathing, enabling it to breathe underwater. Its main action is the Ram attack, which has a +3 attack bonus and deals 4 bludgeoning damage. The sea horse has a passive perception of 11 and no known languages or proficiencies.

actions.name: Sting

In combat, the Giant Scorpion can make multiple attacks with its claws and sting, each with their own damage types and effects. Its Claw attack deals 6 bludgeoning damage and can grapple a target, while its Sting attack inflicts 7 piercing damage and requires a Constitution saving throw to avoid poison damage. The scorpion's ability scores include 15 in Strength, 13 in Dexterity, 15 in Constitution, 1 in Intelligence, 9 in Wisdom, and 3 in Charisma. Its passive perception is 9, and it is unaligned with no known languages.

name: Giant Shark
desc: A giant shark is 30 feet long and normally found in deep oceans. Utterly fearless, it preys on anything that crosses its path, including whales and ships.

special_abilities.name: Blood Frenzy

special_abilities.name: Water Breathing
special_abilities.desc: The shark can breathe only underwater.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (3d10 + 6) piercing damage.

content: The Giant Shark is a Huge beast with an armor class of 13, 126 hit points, and a swim speed of 50 ft. It has high strength (23), constitution (21), and proficiency in Perception. This unaligned creature has special abilities like Blood Frenzy, granting advantage on melee attacks, and Water Breathing, allowing it to only breathe underwater. It has a Bite attack with a +9 attack bonus, dealing 22 piercing damage. With blindsight of 60 ft. and passive perception of 13, this fearsome predator is a formidable opponent with a challenge rating of 5.

actions.name: Swallow
actions.desc:
The toad makes one bite attack against a Medium or smaller target it is grappling. If the attack hits, the target is swallowed, and the grapple ends. content: The Giant Toad is a Large beast with unaligned alignment, an armor class of 11 based on dexterity, 39 hit points from 6d10 hit dice, a speed of 20 ft. walking and 40 ft. swimming, and strength, dexterity, and constitution scores of 15, 13, and 13 respectively. It has darkvision up to 30 ft. and a passive perception of 10, along with Amphibious ability to breathe air and water, and Standing Leap to jump up to 20 ft. long and 10 ft. high. In combat, it can use its Bite action to grapple and poison targets, or Swallow action to consume and damage them internally. With a challenge rating of 1, proficiency bonus of 2, and experience points worth 200, the Giant Toad poses a formidable foe in any encounter.

name: Giant Spider
desc: To snare its prey, a giant spider spins elaborate webs or shoots sticky strands of webbing from its abdomen. Giant spiders are most commonly found underground, making their lairs on ceilings or in dark, web-filled crevices. Such lairs are often festooned with web cocoons holding past victims.

special_abilities.name: Spider Climb
special_abilities.desc: The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

special_abilities.name: Web Sense
special_abilities.desc: While in contact with a web, the spider knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

special_abilities.name: Web Walker
special_abilities.desc: The spider ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 11 Constitution saving throw, taking 9 (2d8) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If the poison damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, the target is stable but poisoned for 1 hour, even after regaining hit points, and is paralyzed while poisoned in this way.

actions.name: Web
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 30/60 ft., one creature. Hit: The target is restrained by webbing. As an action, the restrained target can make a DC 12 Strength check, bursting the webbing on a success. The webbing can also be attacked and destroyed (AC 10; hp 5; vulnerability to fire damage; immunity to bludgeoning, poison, and psychic damage).

content: The Giant Spider is a Large beast with an armor class of 14. It has 26 hit points and a hit dice of 4d10, with a proficiency bonus of 2. This creature is unaligned and has a challenge rating of 1, providing 200 XP upon defeat. The Giant Spider has a strength of 14, dexterity of 16, and constitution of 12. Its special abilities include Spider Climb, allowing it to move easily on surfaces, Web Sense, granting it knowledge of creatures in contact with its webs, and Web Walker, enabling it to ignore movement restrictions caused by webbing. In combat, the Giant Spider can use its Bite attack, dealing piercing and poison damage, as well as its Web attack that restrains targets. With darkvision of 60 ft. and blindsight of 10 ft., the Giant Spider is a formidable predator lurking in underground lairs, waiting to ensnare unsuspecting prey.

name: Gibbering Mouther

special_abilities.name: Aberrant Ground
special_abilities.desc: The ground in a 10-foot radius around the mouther is doughlike difficult terrain. Each creature that starts its turn in that area must succeed on a DC 10 Strength saving throw or have its speed reduced to 0 until the start of its next turn.

special_abilities.name: Gibbering
special_abilities.desc: The mouther babbles incoherently while it can see any creature and isn't incapacitated. Each creature that starts its turn within 20 feet of the mouther and can hear the gibbering must succeed on a DC 10 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, the creature can't take reactions until the start of its next turn and rolls a d8 to determine what it does during its turn. On a 1 to 4, the creature does nothing. On a 5 or 6, the creature takes no action or bonus action and uses all its movement to move in a randomly determined direction. On a 7 or 8, the creature makes a melee attack against a randomly determined creature within its reach or does nothing if it can't make such an attack.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The gibbering mouther makes one bite attack and, if it can, uses its Blinding Spittle.

actions.name: Bites
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 17 (5d6) piercing damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, it must succeed on a DC 10 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is killed by this damage, it is absorbed into the mouther.

actions.name: Blinding Spittle
actions.desc: The mouther spits a chemical glob at a point it can see within 15 feet of it. The glob explodes in a blinding flash of light on impact. Each creature within 5 feet of the flash must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or be blinded until the end of the mouther's next turn.

content: The Gibbering Mouther is a Medium aberration with neutral alignment, 67 hit points, and a challenge rating of 2. It has a unique ability called Aberrant Ground, which creates difficult terrain around it. Additionally, it can gibber incoherently to affect nearby creatures' actions and movement. In combat, the Gibbering Mouther can make a Multiattack, consisting of a bite attack and Blinding Spittle ranged attack. The bite attack deals 17 piercing damage and can knock Medium or smaller creatures prone on a failed saving throw. The Blinding Spittle attack can blind creatures within its area of effect. Overall, the Gibbering Mouther presents a challenging and chaotic encounter for adventurers.

name: Giant Vulture

actions.name: Shortbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

content: The Goblin is a Small humanoid creature of goblinoid subtype, with an alignment of neutral evil. It has an armor class of 15, wearing Leather Armor and a Shield. With 7 hit points and 2d6 hit dice, it has a walking speed of 30 ft. The Goblin has strengths in dexterity and proficiency in Stealth. It possesses darkvision of 60 ft. and passive perception of 9, speaking Common and Goblin languages. This creature has a challenge rating of 0.25 and special ability called Nimble Escape, allowing it to take the Disengage or Hide action as a bonus action. In combat, it can use a Scimitar for melee attacks and a Shortbow for ranged attacks. Overall, the Goblin is a cunning and agile foe to encounter.

name: Gladiator
desc: Gladiators battle for the entertainment of raucous crowds. Some gladiators are brutal pit fighters who treat each match as a life-or-death struggle, while others are professional duelists who command huge fees but rarely fight to the death.

special_abilities.name: Brave
special_abilities.desc: The gladiator has advantage on saving throws against being frightened.

special_abilities.name: Brute
special_abilities.desc: A melee weapon deals one extra die of its damage when the gladiator hits with it (included in the attack).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The gladiator makes three melee attacks or two ranged attacks.

actions.name: Spear
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. and range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage, or 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

actions.name: Shield Bash
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.desc: The gladiator adds 3 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it. To do so, the gladiator must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

content: The Gladiator is a Medium humanoid of any race with any alignment, boasting an armor class of 16 from Studded Leather Armor and Shield. With 112 hit points and a constitution of 16, this fierce warrior excels in strength, dexterity, and charisma. Proficient in saving throws for Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution, as well as Athletics and Intimidation skills, the Gladiator is a formidable opponent. Special abilities include Brave for advantage against being frightened and Brute for extra melee weapon damage. In combat, the Gladiator can make three melee attacks or two ranged attacks with options like Spear and Shield Bash. Additionally, the Gladiator can Parry to increase its AC against melee attacks. This challenging foe has a proficiency bonus of 3 and an experience value of 1800.

name: Gorgon

special_abilities.name: Trampling Charge
special_abilities.desc: If the gorgon moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a gore attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the gorgon can make one attack with its hooves against it as a bonus action.

actions.name: Gore
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (2d12 + 5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Hooves
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Petrifying Breath
actions.desc: The gorgon exhales petrifying gas in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a target begins to turn to stone and is restrained. The restrained target must repeat the saving throw at the end of its next turn. On a success, the effect ends on the target. On a failure, the target is petrified until freed by the greater restoration spell or other magic.

content: The Gorgon is a Large monstrosity with an armor class of 19, 114 hit points, and a speed of 40 ft. It has a strength of 20, dexterity of 11, constitution of 18, intelligence of 2, wisdom of 12, and charisma of 7. This creature is proficient in Perception with a value of 4 and has condition immunity to petrified. It has darkvision up to 60 ft. and a passive perception of 14. The Gorgon's challenge rating is 5 with a proficiency bonus of 3, yielding an XP value of 1800. It possesses the special ability Trampling Charge, allowing it to knock creatures prone with a DC 16 Strength saving throw. Additionally, it can make a bonus attack with its hooves against prone targets. The Gorgon's actions include the Gore attack dealing 2d12 + 5 piercing damage and the Hooves attack dealing 2d10 + 5 bludgeoning damage. It also has the Petrifying Breath ability, emitting petrifying gas in a cone that can petrify targets on failed saving throws.

name: Gold Dragon Wyrmling

special_abilities.name: Amphibious
special_abilities.desc: The dragon can breathe air and water.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Breath Weapons
actions.desc:
The dragon uses one of the following breath weapons.
Fire Breath. The dragon exhales fire in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw, taking 22 (4d10) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
Weakening Breath. The dragon exhales gas in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or have disadvantage on Strength-based attack rolls, Strength checks, and Strength saving throws for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

content: The Gold Dragon Wyrmling is a Medium lawful good dragon with an armor class of 17, 60 hit points, and a proficiency bonus of 2. It has a strength of 19, dexterity of 14, constitution of 17, intelligence of 14, wisdom of 11, and charisma of 16. This dragon is immune to fire damage and has darkvision up to 60 ft. It can breathe air and water, has proficiency in saving throws (DEX, CON, WIS, CHA), and skills in Perception and Stealth. Its actions include a Bite attack dealing 9 piercing damage and Breath Weapons option that includes Fire Breath and Weakening Breath attacks. Fire Breath has a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw, dealing 22 fire damage on a failed save, while Weakening Breath imposes disadvantage on Strength-based rolls. The Gold Dragon Wyrmling is a challenging creature with multiple abilities and combat tactics.

name: Gray Ooze

special_abilities.name: Amorphous
special_abilities.desc: The ooze can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

special_abilities.name: Corrode Metal
special_abilities.desc:
Any nonmagical weapon made of metal that hits the ooze corrodes. After dealing damage, the weapon takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to damage rolls. If its penalty drops to -5, the weapon is destroyed. Nonmagical ammunition made of metal that hits the ooze is destroyed after dealing damage.
The ooze can eat through 2-inch-thick, nonmagical metal in 1 round.

special_abilities.name: False Appearance
special_abilities.desc: While the ooze remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an oily pool or wet rock.

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) acid damage, and if the target is wearing nonmagical metal armor, its armor is partly corroded and takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to the AC it offers. The armor is destroyed if the penalty reduces its AC to 10.

content: The Gray Ooze is a Medium ooze with an armor class of 8 (Dexterity), 22 hit points, and a speed of 10 ft. walking and climbing. It has strengths in Constitution, abilities in Amorphous movement and False Appearance camouflage, and the special ability to corrode metal weapons. The Gray Ooze is resistant to acid, cold, and fire damage, immune to conditions like being blinded or charmed, and proficient in Stealth with a bonus of +2. It can sense in blindsight up to 60 ft. and has a passive perception of 8. In combat, it can attack with a Pseudopod for bludgeoning and acid damage. This creature presents a challenge rating of 0.5 and an experience point value of 100.

name: Green Dragon Wyrmling

special_abilities.name: Amphibious
special_abilities.desc: The dragon can breathe air and water.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) poison damage.

actions.name: Poison Breath
actions.desc: The dragon exhales poisonous gas in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 11 Constitution saving throw, taking 21 (6d6) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

content: The Green Dragon Wyrmling is a Medium dragon with a lawful evil alignment, having a natural armor class of 17 and 38 hit points. It has a speed of 30 ft. walking, 60 ft. flying, and 30 ft. swimming, with abilities such as saving throws for Dexterity, Constitution, Wisdom, and Charisma, along with proficiency in Perception and Stealth skills. This dragon is immune to poison damage and the poisoned condition, with darkvision up to 60 ft. and a passive perception of 14. Its special ability includes being amphibious, able to breathe both air and water. In combat, it can use its Bite attack dealing piercing and poison damage, as well as a Poison Breath attack that exhales poisonous gas in a cone, requiring a Constitution saving throw. With a challenge rating of 2, this creature is a formidable opponent worth 450 experience points when defeated.

name: Grick
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons

special_abilities.name: Stone Camouflage
special_abilities.desc: The grick has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in rocky terrain.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The grick makes one attack with its tentacles. If that attack hits, the grick can make one beak attack against the same target.

actions.name: Tentacles
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) slashing damage.

actions.name: Beak
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

content: Grick is a Medium monstrosity with neutral alignment, an armor class of 14, 27 hit points, and a challenge rating of 2. It has a proficiency bonus of 2, speed of 30 ft. walking and climbing, and darkvision of 60 ft. The grick has strength and dexterity at 14, constitution at 11, wisdom at 14, and charisma at 5. It is resistant to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical weapons. The creature's special ability, Stone Camouflage, grants advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks in rocky terrain. In combat, it uses Multiattack to strike with its tentacles and beak, dealing slashing and piercing damage respectively. The grick's tentacles have an attack bonus of +4 and deal 2d6+2 slashing damage, while its beak has an attack bonus of +4 and inflicts 1d6+2 piercing damage.

name: Glabrezu
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons

special_abilities.name: Innate Spellcasting
special_abilities.desc:
The glabrezu's spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 16). The glabrezu can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: darkness, detect magic, dispel magic
1/day each: confusion, fly, power word stun

special_abilities.name: Magic Resistance
special_abilities.desc: The glabrezu has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The glabrezu makes four attacks: two with its pincers and two with its fists. Alternatively, it makes two attacks with its pincers and casts one spell.

actions.name: Pincer
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 15). The glabrezu has two pincers, each of which can grapple only one target.

actions.name: Fist
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

content: The Glabrezu is a Large fiend demon with chaotic evil alignment, boasting an armor class of 17, 157 hit points, and impressive saving throw proficiencies in Strength, Constitution, Wisdom, and Charisma. It has damage resistances to cold, fire, lightning, and nonmagical weapon attacks, as well as immunity to poison and the Poisoned condition. With a challenge rating of 9, this demon has innate spellcasting abilities, including spells like darkness, detect magic, dispel magic, confusion, fly, and power word stun. Additionally, the Glabrezu possesses Magic Resistance, granting it advantage against spells and magical effects. In combat, it can make multiple attacks with its pincers and fists, with the ability to grapple Medium or smaller creatures. Overall, the Glabrezu is a formidable adversary with a variety of offensive and defensive capabilities.

name: Green Hag

special_abilities.name: Amphibious
special_abilities.desc: The hag can breathe air and water.

special_abilities.name: Innate Spellcasting
special_abilities.desc:
The hag's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 12). She can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

At will: dancing lights, minor illusion, vicious mockery

special_abilities.name: Mimicry
special_abilities.desc: The hag can mimic animal sounds and humanoid voices. A creature that hears the sounds can tell they are imitations with a successful DC 14 Wisdom (Insight) check.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Illusory Appearance
actions.desc:
The hag covers herself and anything she is wearing or carrying with a magical illusion that makes her look like another creature of her general size and humanoid shape. The illusion ends if the hag takes a bonus action to end it or if she dies.
The changes wrought by this effect fail to hold up to physical inspection. For example, the hag could appear to have smooth skin, but someone touching her would feel her rough flesh. Otherwise, a creature must take an action to visually inspect the illusion and succeed on a DC 20 Intelligence (Investigation) check to discern that the hag is disguised.

actions.name: Invisible Passage
actions.desc: The hag magically turns invisible until she attacks or casts a spell, or until her concentration ends (as if concentrating on a spell). While invisible, she leaves no physical evidence of her passage, so she can be tracked only by magic. Any equipment she wears or carries is invisible with her.

content: The Green Hag is a Medium fey creature of neutral evil alignment with an armor class of 17 and 82 hit points. It has a walking speed of 30 ft. and notable attributes include strength 18, dexterity 12, constitution 16, intelligence 13, wisdom 14, and charisma 14. Proficient in skills like Arcana, Deception, Perception, and Stealth, the Green Hag also possesses darkvision up to 60 ft. and languages like Common, Draconic, and Sylvan. With a challenge rating of 3, it has special abilities like Amphibious, Innate Spellcasting (including spells like Dancing Lights, Minor Illusion, and Vicious Mockery), and Mimicry. In combat, the Green Hag can use actions like Claws (with +6 to hit and 2d8+4 slashing damage) and special abilities like Illusory Appearance and Invisible Passage.

name: Griffon

special_abilities.name: Keen Sight
special_abilities.desc: The griffon has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The griffon makes two attacks: one with its beak and one with its claws.

actions.name: Beak
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage.

content: Griffon is a Large monstrosity with an unaligned alignment, having a Dexterity-based armor class of 12 and 59 hit points rolled from 7d10+21 hit dice. It has a speed of 30 ft. walking and 80 ft. flying, with notable strengths in Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution. The creature excels at Perception with a proficiency bonus of 5 and a passive perception of 15. It possesses darkvision up to 60 ft. and the special ability Keen Sight granting advantage on Perception checks relying on sight. In combat, the griffon utilizes Multiattack, making one beak attack and one claws attack. The Beak attack has a +6 to hit, dealing 8 piercing damage, while the Claws attack has the same hit bonus, inflicting 11 slashing damage. This formidable creature has a challenge rating of 2 and offers 450 XP upon defeat.

name: Grimlock

senses.blindsight: 30 ft. or 10 ft. while deafened (blind beyond this radius)

special_abilities.name: Blind Senses
special_abilities.desc: The grimlock can't use its blindsight while deafened and unable to smell.

special_abilities.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
special_abilities.desc: The grimlock has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

special_abilities.name: Stone Camouflage
special_abilities.desc: The grimlock has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in rocky terrain.

actions.name: Spiked Bone Club
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 2 (1d4) piercing damage.

content: Grimlock is a Medium humanoid grimlock with neutral evil alignment, 11 hit points, and a speed of 30 ft. Its armor class is 11 (dex), and it has proficiency in Athletics (5), Perception (3), and Stealth (3). The creature has strength 16, dexterity 12, constitution 12, intelligence 9, wisdom 8, and charisma 6. It is immune to being blinded and has blindsight of 30 ft. or 10 ft. while deafened, with passive perception 13. Grimlock speaks Undercommon and has a challenge rating of 0.25. Special abilities include Blind Senses, Keen Hearing and Smell, and Stone Camouflage, providing advantages on Perception checks, Stealth checks in rocky terrain, and using blindsight. Its action, Spiked Bone Club, has an attack bonus of +5 and deals bludgeoning and piercing damage.

name: Guard
desc: Guards include members of a city watch, sentries in a citadel or fortified town, and the bodyguards of merchants and nobles.

actions.name: Spear
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage or 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

content: This is a Medium humanoid creature known as the Guard, which can be of any race and alignment. Guards typically have an armor class of 16, wearing a Chain Shirt and Shield for protection. They have 11 hit points, with a hit dice of 2d8 and a hit points roll of 2d8+2. With a strength of 13, dexterity of 12, constitution of 12, wisdom of 11, and charisma of 10, Guards are proficient in the Perception skill. They have a passive perception of 12 and speak any one language, usually Common. In combat, Guards use a Spear as their primary weapon, dealing 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage or 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage when used with two hands. With a challenge rating of 0.125, Guards have an XP value of 25.

name: Half-Red Dragon Veteran

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The veteran makes two longsword attacks. If it has a shortsword drawn, it can also make a shortsword attack.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage, or 8 (1d10 + 3) slashing damage if used with two hands.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Heavy Crossbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d10 + 1) piercing damage.

actions.name: Fire Breath
actions.desc: The veteran exhales fire in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 24 (7d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

content: The Half-Red Dragon Veteran is a humanoid of medium size and human subtype with an alignment of any alignment. It has an armor class of 18 due to wearing Plate Armor and 65 hit points with a hit dice of 10d8+20. This creature has a speed of 30 ft. and possesses strengths in strength, dexterity, and constitution. It is resistant to fire damage and has darkvision up to 60 ft. The Half-Red Dragon Veteran is proficient in Common and Draconic languages, with a challenge rating of 5 and an XP value of 1800. In combat, it can make two longsword attacks or one shortsword attack using its Multiattack action. The Longsword attack deals 7 slashing damage with an attack bonus of +5, while the Shortsword attack deals 6 piercing damage with the same attack bonus. Additionally, it can use a Heavy Crossbow to deal 6 piercing damage from a range of 100/400 ft. Furthermore, the Half-Red Dragon Veteran can breathe fire in a 15-foot cone, causing 24 fire damage on a failed saving throw.

name: Guardian Naga

special_abilities.name: Rejuvenation
special_abilities.desc: If it dies, the naga returns to life in 1d6 days and regains all its hit points. Only a wish spell can prevent this trait from functioning.

special_abilities.name: Spellcasting
special_abilities.desc:
The naga is an 11th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 16, +8 to hit with spell attacks), and it needs only verbal components to cast its spells. It has the following cleric spells prepared:

- Cantrips (at will): mending, sacred flame, thaumaturgy
- 1st level (4 slots): command, cure wounds, shield of faith
- 2nd level (3 slots): calm emotions, hold person
- 3rd level (3 slots): bestow curse, clairvoyance
- 4th level (3 slots): banishment, freedom of movement
- 5th level (2 slots): flame strike, geas
- 6th level (1 slot): true seeing

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw, taking 45 (10d8) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Spit Poison
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, range 15/30 ft., one creature. Hit: The target must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw, taking 45 (10d8) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

content: The Guardian Naga is a Large monstrosity with lawful good alignment, boasting an armor class of 18 and 127 hit points. This creature has a speed of 40 ft. and excels in strength (19), dexterity (18), constitution (16), intelligence (16), wisdom (19), and charisma (18). It is proficient in saving throws for DEX, CON, INT, WIS, and CHA. The Guardian Naga is immune to poison damage and resistant to being charmed and poisoned. With darkvision of 60 ft. and passive perception of 14, it is a formidable foe with a challenge rating of 10. Special abilities include Rejuvenation and Spellcasting, allowing it to cast various cleric spells with a focus on Wisdom. Its actions include a deadly Bite and Spit Poison attacks. This majestic creature is a force to be reckoned with in any encounter.

name: Harpy

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The harpy makes two attacks: one with its claws and one with its club.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (2d4 + 1) slashing damage.

actions.name: Club
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Luring Song
actions.desc:
The harpy sings a magical melody. Every humanoid and giant within 300 ft. of the harpy that can hear the song must succeed on a DC 11 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed until the song ends. The harpy must take a bonus action on its subsequent turns to continue singing. It can stop singing at any time. The song ends if the harpy is incapacitated.
While charmed by the harpy, a target is incapacitated and ignores the songs of other harpies. If the charmed target is more than 5 ft. away from the harpy, the must move on its turn toward the harpy by the most direct route. It doesn't avoid opportunity attacks, but before moving into damaging terrain, such as lava or a pit, and whenever it takes damage from a source other than the harpy, a target can repeat the saving throw. A creature can also repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns. If a creature's saving throw is successful, the effect ends on it.
A target that successfully saves is immune to this harpy's song for the next 24 hours.

content: The Harpy is a Medium-sized monstrosity with a chaotic evil alignment, having an Armor Class of 11 based on Dexterity. It has 38 hit points, a hit dice of 7d8, and a hit points roll of 7d8+7. With a speed of 20 ft. walking and 40 ft. flying, the Harpy possesses average Strength, Dexterity, Constitution, and Charisma, but low Intelligence and Wisdom. It is proficient in no skills, has no damage vulnerabilities, resistances, or immunities, and is immune to conditions. The Harpy's passive perception is 10, it understands Common language, and has a Challenge Rating of 1. Its actions include Multiattack, where it can make two attacks with its claws and club, each having specific attack bonuses and damage types. Additionally, the Harpy can use its Luring Song to charm humanoid and giant targets within 300 ft., compelling them to move toward it and potentially causing them to be incapacitated.

name: Hawk

special_abilities.name: Keen Sight
special_abilities.desc: The hawk has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: Talons
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 slashing damage.

content: The Hawk is a Tiny beast with unaligned alignment, having a Dexterity armor class of 13. It has 1 hit point, 10 ft. walk speed, and 60 ft. fly speed. With 5 strength, 16 dexterity, 8 constitution, 2 intelligence, 14 wisdom, and 6 charisma, it excels in Perception skill, with a proficiency bonus of 4. It has passive perception of 14 and a challenge rating of 0. The Hawk's special ability, Keen Sight, grants advantage on Perception checks relying on sight. Its action, Talons, has +5 to hit, dealing 1 slashing damage with a slashing damage type.

name: Gynosphinx
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons

special_abilities.name: Inscrutable
special_abilities.desc: The sphinx is immune to any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, as well as any divination spell that it refuses. Wisdom (Insight) checks made to ascertain the sphinx's intentions or sincerity have disadvantage.

special_abilities.name: Magic Weapons
special_abilities.desc: The sphinx's weapon attacks are magical.

special_abilities.name: Spellcasting
special_abilities.desc:
The sphinx is a 9th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 16, +8 to hit with spell attacks). It requires no material components to cast its spells. The sphinx has the following wizard spells prepared:

- Cantrips (at will): mage hand, minor illusion, prestidigitation
- 1st level (4 slots): detect magic, identify, shield
- 2nd level (3 slots): darkness, locate object, suggestion
- 3rd level (3 slots): dispel magic, remove curse, tongues
- 4th level (3 slots): banishment, greater invisibility
- 5th level (1 slot): legend lore

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The sphinx makes two claw attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage.

legendary_actions.name: Claw Attack
legendary_actions.desc: The sphinx makes one claw attack.

legendary_actions.name: Teleport (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: The sphinx magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

legendary_actions.name: Cast a Spell (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: The sphinx casts a spell from its list of prepared spells, using a spell slot as normal.

content: The Gynosphinx is a Large monstrosity with a lawful neutral alignment, boasting an armor class of 17 and 136 hit points. It has a speed of 40 ft. walking and 60 ft. flying, with strengths in strength, dexterity, constitution, intelligence, wisdom, and charisma all at 18. This creature is proficient in skills like Arcana, History, Perception, and Religion, and possesses resistances to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons, as well as immunity to psychic damage. It is immune to being charmed or frightened and has truesight up to 120 ft. It is capable of spellcasting as a 9th-level wizard, with spells like Mage Hand, Shield, and Banishment at its disposal. In combat, it can make multiattacks with its claw attacks and has legendary actions such as teleporting and casting spells.

name: Hell Hound
languages: understands Infernal but can't speak it

special_abilities.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
special_abilities.desc: The hound has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

special_abilities.name: Pack Tactics
special_abilities.desc: The hound has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the hound's allies is within 5 ft. of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) fire damage.

actions.name: Fire Breath
actions.desc: The hound exhales fire in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw, taking 21 (6d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

content: Hell Hound is a Medium fiend with a lawful evil alignment, featuring a natural armor class of 15, 45 hit points, and 50 ft. walk speed. With a strength of 17, dexterity of 12, and constitution of 14, this creature excels in Wisdom (Perception) checks with a proficiency bonus of 5. It is immune to fire damage, possesses darkvision up to 60 ft., and has a passive perception of 15. Special abilities include Keen Hearing and Smell for advantage on Perception checks and Pack Tactics for advantage on attack rolls. Its Bite action deals 1d8 + 3 piercing damage and 2d6 fire damage, while its Fire Breath can inflict 6d6 fire damage in a 15-foot cone with a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw. With a challenge rating of 3 and an XP value of 700, the Hell Hound is a formidable foe in any encounter.

name: Hill Giant

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The giant makes two greatclub attacks.

actions.name: Greatclub
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Rock
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (3d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

content: The Hill Giant is a Huge giant of chaotic evil alignment with natural armor class of 13 and 105 hit points from 10d12 hit dice, having a speed of 40 ft. It excels in strength (21), constitution (19), and proficiency in Perception skill. With a passive perception of 12, it speaks Giant language and poses a challenge rating of 5. In combat, it utilizes the Multiattack action to make two Greatclub attacks, each with a +8 attack bonus dealing 18 bludgeoning damage. It can also hurl Rocks with a +8 attack bonus, inflicting 21 bludgeoning damage.

name: Hezrou
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons

special_abilities.name: Magic Resistance
special_abilities.desc: The hezrou has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

special_abilities.name: Stench
special_abilities.desc: Any creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of the hezrou must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the start of its next turn. On a successful saving throw, the creature is immune to the hezrou's stench for 24 hours.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The hezrou makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage.

content: Hezrou is a Large fiend demon with chaotic evil alignment, possessing a natural armor class of 16 and 136 hit points from 13d10 hit dice. It has a speed of 30 ft. and notable strengths in strength (19), dexterity (17), and constitution (20). The creature also has proficiency in saving throws for STR, CON, and WIS, with resistances to cold, fire, lightning, and nonmagical weapon damage. Additionally, it is immune to poison and has darkvision of 120 ft. Hezrou is known for its Magic Resistance ability, granting advantage on saving throws against magical effects, and its Stench ability that poisons nearby creatures. In combat, it can make three attacks - one bite and two claws - each with a +7 to hit and specific damage rolls. This challenging creature is a formidable adversary with unique abilities and strong combat skills.

name: Hippogriff

special_abilities.name: Keen Sight
special_abilities.desc: The hippogriff has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The hippogriff makes two attacks: one with its beak and one with its claws.

actions.name: Beak
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage.

content: The Hippogriff is a Large monstrosity with unaligned alignment, an armor class of 11 based on Dexterity, 19 hit points, and a speed of 40 ft. walking and 60 ft. flying. It has a Strength of 17, Dexterity of 13, Constitution of 13, Intelligence of 2, Wisdom of 12, and Charisma of 8. The creature is proficient in Perception, has a passive perception of 15, and a proficiency bonus of 2. In combat, it can make two attacks with its beak and claws using a Multiattack action, dealing piercing and slashing damage respectively. The Hippogriff also has the special ability Keen Sight, granting advantage on Perception checks relying on sight. Its challenge rating is 1, yielding an XP of 200.

name: Hobgoblin

special_abilities.name: Martial Advantage
special_abilities.desc: Once per turn, the hobgoblin can deal an extra 7 (2d6) damage to a creature it hits with a weapon attack if that creature is within 5 ft. of an ally of the hobgoblin that isn't incapacitated.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) slashing damage, or 6 (1d10 + 1) slashing damage if used with two hands.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage.

content: The Hobgoblin is a Medium humanoid of goblinoid subtype with an alignment of lawful evil. It has an armor class of 18, consisting of Chain Mail and Shield, and 11 hit points with 2d8 hit dice. With a speed of 30 ft., it has strengths in strength, dexterity, and constitution, along with darkvision of 60 ft. and passive perception of 10. It is proficient in longsword and longbow attacks, dealing slashing and piercing damage respectively. The Hobgoblin's special ability, Martial Advantage, allows it to deal extra damage if near an ally. It speaks Common and Goblin, has a challenge rating of 0.5, and grants 100 xp.

name: Homunculus
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

special_abilities.name: Telepathic Bond
special_abilities.desc: While the homunculus is on the same plane of existence as its master, it can magically convey what it senses to its master, and the two can communicate telepathically.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 1 piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. If the saving throw fails by 5 or more, the target is instead poisoned for 5 (1d10) minutes and unconscious while poisoned in this way.

content: Homunculus, a Tiny construct with neutral alignment, has a natural armor class of 13 and 5 hit points from 2d4 hit dice. It has a walking speed of 20 ft. and a flying speed of 40 ft., with a strength of 4, dexterity of 15, and constitution of 11. While it is immune to poison damage, it is vulnerable to none. This creature understands its creator's languages but cannot speak, with darkvision up to 60 ft. and passive perception of 10. Its special ability is Telepathic Bond, allowing it to communicate telepathically with its master. In combat, it can Bite with a +4 attack bonus, dealing 1 piercing damage and potentially poisoning the target.

name: Hunter Shark
desc: Smaller than a giant shark but larger and fiercer than a reef shark, a hunter shark haunts deep waters. It usually hunts alone, but multiple hunter sharks might feed in the same area. A fully grown hunter shark is 15 to 20 feet long.

special_abilities.name: Blood Frenzy
special_abilities.desc: The shark has advantage on melee attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its hit points.

special_abilities.name: Water Breathing
special_abilities.desc: The shark can breathe only underwater.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage.

content: The Hunter Shark is a Large beast that resides in deep waters, typically hunting alone but sometimes in groups. It has an Armor Class of 12, 45 hit points, and a Swim speed of 40 ft. With a Strength of 18 and Dexterity of 13, it excels in melee combat with its Bite attack that deals 13 piercing damage. The shark's special abilities include Blood Frenzy, granting advantage on attacks against injured foes, and Water Breathing, allowing it to survive underwater. It has Darkvision up to 30 ft. and a Passive Perception of 12. Additionally, the Hunter Shark is proficient in Perception and has a Challenge Rating of 2.

name: Hyena

special_abilities.name: Pack Tactics
special_abilities.desc: The hyena has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the hyena's allies is within 5 ft. of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d6) piercing damage.

content: The Hyena is a Medium-sized beast with unaligned alignment, 11 armor class based on dexterity, 5 hit points, and a speed of 50 ft. It has 11 strength, 13 dexterity, 12 constitution, 2 intelligence, 12 wisdom, and 5 charisma. With a proficiency bonus of 2, it excels in Perception skill with a value of 3. The hyena's special ability, Pack Tactics, allows it to gain advantage on attack rolls when allies are nearby. Its Bite attack has a +2 to hit bonus and deals 3 piercing damage. The hyena has a passive perception of 13 and a challenge rating of 0.

name: Hydra

special_abilities.name: Hold Breath
special_abilities.desc: The hydra can hold its breath for 1 hour.

special_abilities.name: Multiple Heads
special_abilities.desc:
The hydra has five heads. While it has more than one head, the hydra has advantage on saving throws against being blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, stunned, and knocked unconscious.
Whenever the hydra takes 25 or more damage in a single turn, one of its heads dies. If all its heads die, the hydra dies.
At the end of its turn, it grows two heads for each of its heads that died since its last turn, unless it has taken fire damage since its last turn. The hydra regains 10 hit points for each head regrown in this way.

special_abilities.name: Reactive Heads
special_abilities.desc: For each head the hydra has beyond one, it gets an extra reaction that can be used only for opportunity attacks.

special_abilities.name: Wakeful
special_abilities.desc: While the hydra sleeps, at least one of its heads is awake.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The hydra makes as many bite attacks as it has heads.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d10 + 5) piercing damage.

content: The Hydra is a Huge monstrosity with an armor class of 15 and 172 hit points, possessing a strength of 20, dexterity of 12, constitution of 20, intelligence of 2, wisdom of 10, and charisma of 7. It has a walking speed of 30 ft. and a swimming speed of 30 ft., with darkvision for 60 ft. and a passive perception of 16. The Hydra has the special abilities of Hold Breath, Multiple Heads, Reactive Heads, and Wakeful, giving it unique advantages and abilities in combat. It can make multiple bite attacks as part of its Multiattack action, each dealing 10 piercing damage. The Hydra's challenge rating is 8, and it has a proficiency bonus of 3, with a proficiency in Perception. Its XP value is 3900, making it a formidable opponent in battle.

name: Imp
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons that aren't silvered

special_abilities.name: Shapechanger
special_abilities.desc: The imp can use its action to polymorph into a beast form that resembles a rat (speed 20 ft.), a raven (20 ft., fly 60 ft.), or a spider (20 ft., climb 20 ft.), or back into its true form. Its statistics are the same in each form, except for the speed changes noted. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

special_abilities.name: Devil's Sight
special_abilities.desc: Magical darkness doesn't impede the imp's darkvision.

special_abilities.name: Magic Resistance
special_abilities.desc: The imp has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Sting (Bite in Beast Form)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage, and the target must make on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw, taking 10 (3d6) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Invisibility
actions.desc: The imp magically turns invisible until it attacks, or until its concentration ends (as if concentrating on a spell). Any equipment the imp wears or carries is invisible with it.

content: The Imp is a Tiny fiend devil with lawful evil alignment and a Dex armor class of 13. It has 10 hit points, a hit dice of 3d4, and a walking speed of 20 ft. with a flying speed of 40 ft. The Imp excels in Deception, Insight, Persuasion, and Stealth skills with respective values of 4, 3, 4, and 5. It is immune to fire and poison damage, resistant to cold and non-silvered bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage, and has the Poisoned condition immunity. The Imp has darkvision up to 120 ft. and a passive Perception of 11. It speaks Infernal and Common languages, has a challenge rating of 1, and a proficiency bonus of 2. Special abilities include Shapechanger, Devil's Sight, and Magic Resistance, granting the Imp polymorphing capabilities, unaffected darkvision, and advantage against spells. In combat, the Imp can use its Sting attack to deal piercing and poison damage, and turn invisible with its Invisibility action.

name: Ice Devil
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons that aren't silvered

special_abilities.name: Devil's Sight
special_abilities.desc: Magical darkness doesn't impede the devil's darkvision.

special_abilities.name: Magic Resistance
special_abilities.desc: The devil has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The devil makes three attacks: one with its bite, one with its claws, and one with its tail.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) cold damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d4 + 5) slashing damage plus 10 (3d6) cold damage.

actions.name: Tail
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) cold damage.

actions.name: Wall of Ice
actions.desc:
The devil magically forms an opaque wall of ice on a solid surface it can see within 60 feet of it. The wall is 1 foot thick and up to 30 feet long and 10 feet high, or it's a hemispherical dome up to 20 feet in diameter.
When the wall appears, each creature in its space is pushed out of it by the shortest route. The creature chooses which side of the wall to end up on, unless the creature is incapacitated. The creature then makes a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw, taking 35 (10d6) cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
The wall lasts for 1 minute or until the devil is incapacitated or dies. The wall can be damaged and breached; each 10-foot section has AC 5, 30 hit points, vulnerability to fire damage, and immunity to acid, cold, necrotic, poison, and psychic damage. If a section is destroyed, it leaves behind a sheet of frigid air in the space the wall occupied. Whenever a creature finishes moving through the frigid air on a turn, willingly or otherwise, the creature must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw, taking 17 (5d6) cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The frigid air dissipates when the rest of the wall vanishes.

content: The Ice Devil is a Large fiend with a subtype of devil, possessing an armor class of 18, 180 hit points, and a speed of 40 ft. It has strengths in saving throws for Dexterity, Constitution, Wisdom, and Charisma, as well as damage resistances to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons that aren't silvered, and immunities to fire and poison. The devil has special abilities like Devil's Sight and Magic Resistance, and can perform the Multiattack action, making three attacks with its bite, claws, and tail. Its actions include Bite, Claws, Tail, and Wall of Ice, each with specific melee damage types and bonuses. The Ice Devil's senses include blindsight up to 60 ft., darkvision up to 120 ft., and a passive perception of 12. It communicates in Infernal and has telepathy up to 120 ft., presenting a challenge rating of 14 and a proficiency bonus of 5.

name: Ice Mephit

special_abilities.name: Death Burst
special_abilities.desc: When the mephit dies, it explodes in a burst of jagged ice. Each creature within 5 ft. of it must make a DC 10 Dexterity saving throw, taking 4 (1d8) slashing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

special_abilities.name: False Appearance
special_abilities.desc: While the mephit remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary shard of ice.

special_abilities.name: Innate Spellcasting
special_abilities.desc: The mephit can innately cast fog cloud, requiring no material components. Its innate spellcasting ability is Charisma.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) slashing damage plus 2 (1d4) cold damage.

actions.name: Frost Breath
actions.desc: The mephit exhales a 15-foot cone of cold air. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 10 Dexterity saving throw, taking 5 (2d4) cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

content: The Ice Mephit is a Small elemental creature with neutral evil alignment, 11 Dexterity armor class, 21 hit points, 30 ft. walk and fly speed, and proficiency in Perception and Stealth. It is vulnerable to bludgeoning and fire damage, immune to cold and poison, and immune to the poisoned condition. With darkvision of 60 ft. and passive perception of 12, it speaks Aquan and Auran. This monster has a challenge rating of 0.5, proficiency bonus of 2, and special abilities like Death Burst and False Appearance. It can also cast Fog Cloud as an innate spell using Charisma. The Ice Mephit's actions include Claws and Frost Breath attacks dealing slashing and cold damage, with a recharge on a roll mechanic.

name: Jackal

special_abilities.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
special_abilities.desc: The jackal has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

special_abilities.name: Pack Tactics
special_abilities.desc: The jackal has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the jackal's allies is within 5 ft. of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +1 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 (1d4 - 1) piercing damage.

content: The Jackal is a Small beast with unaligned alignment, having an armor class of 12 from dexterity, 3 hit points, and a speed of 40 ft. It has average stats with 8 strength, 15 dexterity, 11 constitution, 3 intelligence, 12 wisdom, and 6 charisma. This creature is proficient in Perception with a value of 3. It has passive perception of 13 and a challenge rating of 0, granting 2 proficiency bonus and 10 xp. Special abilities include Keen Hearing and Smell, providing advantage on Perception checks based on hearing or smell, and Pack Tactics, giving advantage on attack rolls when allies are nearby. Its Bite action has an attack bonus of +1, dealing 1 (1d4 - 1) piercing damage.

name: Invisible Stalker
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons
languages: Auran, understands Common but doesn't speak it

special_abilities.name: Invisibility
special_abilities.desc: The stalker is invisible.

special_abilities.name: Faultless Tracker
special_abilities.desc: The stalker is given a quarry by its summoner. The stalker knows the direction and distance to its quarry as long as the two of them are on the same plane of existence. The stalker also knows the location of its summoner.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The stalker makes two slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

content: The Invisible Stalker is a Medium elemental creature with a neutral alignment, boasting an armor class of 14 based on its dexterity. It has 104 hit points, a hit dice of 16d8, and a speed of 50 ft. walking and flying. Notably, it is immune to poison damage and resistant to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons. This creature is proficient in Perception and Stealth skills, with a proficiency bonus of 3. Its special abilities include Invisibility and Faultless Tracker, which allows it to track a designated target and its summoner. In combat, the Invisible Stalker can make two slam attacks using a melee weapon attack with a +6 to hit. With darkvision of 60 ft. and a passive perception of 18, this creature is a formidable challenge for adventurers, rated at a challenge rating of 6.

name: Horned Devil
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons that aren't silvered

special_abilities.name: Devil's Sight
special_abilities.desc: Magical darkness doesn't impede the devil's darkvision.

special_abilities.name: Magic Resistance
special_abilities.desc: The devil has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The devil makes three melee attacks: two with its fork and one with its tail. It can use Hurl Flame in place of any melee attack.

actions.name: Fork
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) piercing damage.

actions.name: Tail
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d8 + 6) piercing damage. If the target is a creature other than an undead or a construct, it must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or lose 10 (3d6) hit points at the start of each of its turns due to an infernal wound. Each time the devil hits the wounded target with this attack, the damage dealt by the wound increases by 10 (3d6). Any creature can take an action to stanch the wound with a successful DC 12 Wisdom (Medicine) check. The wound also closes if the target receives magical healing.

actions.name: Hurl Flame
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack: +7 to hit, range 150 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (4d6) fire damage. If the target is a flammable object that isn't being worn or carried, it also catches fire.

content: The Horned Devil, a Large fiend subtype devil with lawful evil alignment, boasts an armor class of 18 from its natural defense and 178 hit points rolled with 17d10+85 hit dice. With a speed of 20 ft. walking and 60 ft. flying, its impressive stats include 22 strength, 17 dexterity, 21 constitution, 12 intelligence, 16 wisdom, and 17 charisma. Proficient in saving throws for strength, dexterity, wisdom, and charisma, this devil is resistant to cold and nonmagical weapon damage, immune to fire and poison, and immune to the poisoned condition. Equipped with darkvision of 120 ft. and a passive perception of 13, it communicates in Infernal with telepathy abilities. With a challenge rating of 11 and a proficiency bonus of 4, it is known for its special abilities Devil's Sight and Magic Resistance. In battle, it utilizes Multiattack with various melee and ranged options like Fork, Tail, and Hurl Flame, each with unique attack bonuses and damage dice.

name: Killer Whale

special_abilities.name: Echolocation
special_abilities.desc: The whale can't use its blindsight while deafened.

special_abilities.name: Hold Breath
special_abilities.desc: The whale can hold its breath for 30 minutes

special_abilities.name: Keen Hearing
special_abilities.desc: The whale has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (5d6 + 4) piercing damage.

content: The Killer Whale is a Huge beast with unaligned alignment, boasting a natural armor class of 12 and 90 hit points from 12d12 hit dice. With a swim speed of 60 ft., this creature has notable strengths in strength (19) and wisdom (12), while also possessing proficiencies in Perception. It exhibits special abilities like Echolocation, Hold Breath, and Keen Hearing, enhancing its combat capabilities. In battle, the Killer Whale can unleash a powerful Bite attack with a +6 to hit and dealing 21 (5d6 + 4) piercing damage. With blindsight extending to 120 ft. and a passive perception of 13, this creature is a formidable foe with a challenge rating of 3 and an XP reward of 700.

name: Iron Golem
damage_immunities: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons that aren't adamantine
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

special_abilities.name: Fire Absorption
special_abilities.desc: Whenever the golem is subjected to fire damage, it takes no damage and instead regains a number of hit points equal to the fire damage dealt.

special_abilities.name: Immutable Form
special_abilities.desc: The golem is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

special_abilities.name: Magic Resistance
special_abilities.desc: The golem has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

special_abilities.name: Magic Weapons
special_abilities.desc: The golem's weapon attacks are magical.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The golem makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (3d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Sword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 23 (3d10 + 7) slashing damage.

actions.name: Poison Breath
actions.desc: The golem exhales poisonous gas in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 19 Constitution saving throw, taking 45 (10d8) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

content: The Iron Golem is a Large construct with a natural armor class of 20 and 210 hit points from 20d10 hit dice, immune to fire, poison, psychic, and nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage. It has condition immunities including charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, and poisoned, darkvision of 120 ft., and a passive perception of 10. With a strength of 24, constitution of 20, and proficiency bonus of 5, it has special abilities like Fire Absorption, Immutable Form, Magic Resistance, and Magic Weapons. It can make two melee attacks using Multiattack, with options for Slam and Sword attacks dealing bludgeoning and slashing damage respectively. Additionally, it has a Poison Breath attack that inflicts poison damage in a cone area with a DC 19 Constitution saving throw. This Iron Golem is a formidable foe with versatile combat capabilities and resilience against magic.

name: Knight
desc: Knights are warriors who pledge service to rulers, religious orders, and noble causes. A knight’s alignment determines the extent to which a pledge is honored. Whether undertaking a quest or patrolling a realm, a knight often travels with an entourage that includes squires and hirelings who are commoners.

special_abilities.name: Brave
special_abilities.desc: The knight has advantage on saving throws against being frightened.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The knight makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Greatsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Heavy Crossbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d10) piercing damage.

actions.name: Leadership
actions.desc: For 1 minute, the knight can utter a special command or warning whenever a nonhostile creature that it can see within 30 ft. of it makes an attack roll or a saving throw. The creature can add a d4 to its roll provided it can hear and understand the knight. A creature can benefit from only one Leadership die at a time. This effect ends if the knight is incapacitated.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.desc: The knight adds 2 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it. To do so, the knight must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

content: The Knight is a Medium humanoid warrior who pledges service to rulers, religious orders, and noble causes, traveling with an entourage that includes squires and hirelings. With a hit points of 52 and an armor class of 18 (Plate Armor), the Knight is proficient in Constitution and Wisdom saving throws, has a passive perception of 10, and a proficiency bonus of 2. Their abilities include Brave, granting advantage against being frightened, and Leadership, allowing them to provide a d4 bonus to allies' rolls. In combat, the Knight can make two melee attacks with a Greatsword, dealing 10 slashing damage, or use a Heavy Crossbow for 5 piercing damage. They can also Parry, adding 2 to their AC against a melee attack. The Knight's alignment, size (Medium), subtype (any race), speed (30 ft. walk), and languages (Common) are flexible, making them a versatile and formidable adversary with a challenge rating of 3.

name: Kobold

special_abilities.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
special_abilities.desc: While in sunlight, the kobold has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

special_abilities.name: Pack Tactics
special_abilities.desc: The kobold has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the kobold's allies is within 5 ft. of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Sling
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

content: The Kobold is a Small humanoid creature with a subtype of kobold, known for its lawful evil alignment. It has an armor class of 12, 5 hit points, and a speed of 30 ft. The Kobold has strengths in dexterity (15) and weaknesses in strength (7). It possesses the ability to see in the dark up to 60 ft. and has a passive perception of 8. This creature is proficient with a Dagger and Sling, using its Pack Tactics to gain advantage on attack rolls when allies are nearby. The Kobold is sensitive to sunlight, experiencing disadvantage in sunlight and on certain perception checks. It speaks Common and Draconic languages and has a challenge rating of 0.125.

name: Kraken
damage_immunities: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons
languages: understands Abyssal, Celestial, Infernal, and Primordial but can't speak, telepathy 120 ft.

special_abilities.name: Amphibious
special_abilities.desc: The kraken can breathe air and water.

special_abilities.name: Freedom of Movement
special_abilities.desc: The kraken ignores difficult terrain, and magical effects can't reduce its speed or cause it to be restrained. It can spend 5 feet of movement to escape from nonmagical restraints or being grappled.

special_abilities.name: Siege Monster
special_abilities.desc: The kraken deals double damage to objects and structures.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The kraken makes three tentacle attacks, each of which it can replace with one use of Fling.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 23 (3d8 + 10) piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature grappled by the kraken, that creature is swallowed, and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the creature is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the kraken, and it takes 42 (12d6) acid damage at the start of each of the kraken's turns. If the kraken takes 50 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the kraken must succeed on a DC 25 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall prone in a space within 10 feet of the kraken. If the kraken dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse using 15 feet of movement, exiting prone.

actions.name: Tentacle
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (3d6 + 10) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 18). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained. The kraken has ten tentacles, each of which can grapple one target.

actions.name: Fling
actions.desc: One Large or smaller object held or creature grappled by the kraken is thrown up to 60 feet in a random direction and knocked prone. If a thrown target strikes a solid surface, the target takes 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage for every 10 feet it was thrown. If the target is thrown at another creature, that creature must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or take the same damage and be knocked prone.

actions.name: Lightning Storm
actions.desc: The kraken magically creates three bolts of lightning, each of which can strike a target the kraken can see within 120 feet of it. A target must make a DC 23 Dexterity saving throw, taking 22 (4d10) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

legendary_actions.name: Tentacle Attack or Fling
legendary_actions.desc: The kraken makes one tentacle attack or uses its Fling.

legendary_actions.name: Lightning Storm (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: The kraken uses Lightning Storm.

legendary_actions.name: Ink Cloud (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: While underwater, the kraken expels an ink cloud in a 60-foot radius. The cloud spreads around corners, and that area is heavily obscured to creatures other than the kraken. Each creature other than the kraken that ends its turn there must succeed on a DC 23 Constitution saving throw, taking 16 (3d10) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A strong current disperses the cloud, which otherwise disappears at the end of the kraken's next turn.

content: The Kraken is a Gargantuan monstrosity of chaotic evil alignment, classified as a titan subtype. It boasts an impressive natural armor class of 18 and a hefty 472 hit points, with a constitution of 25 and a proficiency bonus of 7. Known for its extraordinary strength, intelligence, and charisma, the Kraken has proficiency in various saving throws. It is immune to lightning damage and nonmagical weapon attacks, and has condition immunities to being frightened and paralyzed. With truesight up to 120 ft. and passive perception of 14, the Kraken possesses amphibious abilities, freedom of movement, and the ability to deal double damage to objects and structures as a siege monster.
