In combat, it can make three tentacle attacks or use its powerful Bite attack, which can swallow and deal acid damage to its prey. Additionally, it can unleash a powerful Lightning Storm or create an Ink Cloud while underwater as legendary actions. The Kraken exhibits incredible speed, with a walk of 20 ft. and a swim of 60 ft., and understands multiple languages while having telepathy up to 120 ft. Overall, the Kraken is a formidable and versatile creature that commands respect and fear on the battlefield.

name: Lemure

special_abilities.name: Devil's Sight
special_abilities.desc: Magical darkness doesn't impede the lemure's darkvision.

special_abilities.name: Hellish Rejuvenation
special_abilities.desc: A lemure that dies in the Nine Hells comes back to life with all its hit points in 1d10 days unless it is killed by a good-aligned creature with a bless spell cast on that creature or its remains are sprinkled with holy water.

actions.name: Fist
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2 (1d4) bludgeoning damage.

content: Lemure is a Medium fiend devil with lawful evil alignment, an armor class of 7 based on dexterity, 13 hit points from 3d8 hit dice, and a speed of 15 ft. It has damage resistances to cold, immunities to fire and poison, and condition immunities to charmed, frightened, and poisoned. With darkvision of 120 ft. and passive perception of 10, Lemure understands infernal but can't speak and has a proficiency bonus of 2. Special abilities include Devil's Sight which allows darkvision to penetrate magical darkness, and Hellish Rejuvenation which brings Lemure back to life in the Nine Hells if killed by a good-aligned creature without a bless spell. Its actions include a Fist melee attack with +3 to hit, dealing 1d4 bludgeoning damage.

name: Lamia

special_abilities.name: Innate Spellcasting
special_abilities.desc: The lamia's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 13). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components. At will: disguise self (any humanoid form), major image 3/day each: charm person, mirror image, scrying, suggestion 1/day: geas

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The lamia makes two attacks: one with its claws and one with its dagger or Intoxicating Touch.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d10 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Intoxicating Touch
actions.desc: Melee Spell Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: The target is magically cursed for 1 hour. Until the curse ends, the target has disadvantage on Wisdom saving throws and all ability checks.

content: Lamia is a Large monstrosity with chaotic evil alignment, possessing natural armor class of 13 and 97 hit points from 13d10 hit dice. It has a walking speed of 30 ft. and notable abilities such as Innate Spellcasting, allowing it to cast spells like disguise self and charm person. Lamia's attacks include Claws, Dagger, and Intoxicating Touch, each with specific damage types and bonuses. It is proficient in Deception, Insight, and Stealth skills, with darkvision of 60 ft. and passive perception of 12. Additionally, Lamia speaks Abyssal and Common languages, making it a challenging foe with a proficiency bonus of 2.

name: Lizard

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +0 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing damage.

content: The Lizard is a tiny beast with an unaligned alignment, having a dexterity of 11 and hit points of 2. It has a walking speed of 20 ft. and climbing speed of 20 ft., along with darkvision up to 30 ft. and passive perception of 9. This creature has a proficiency bonus of 2 and an XP value of 10. Its only action is a Bite attack with +0 to hit, dealing 1 piercing damage.

name: Lion

special_abilities.name: Keen Smell
special_abilities.desc: The lion has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

special_abilities.name: Pack Tactics
special_abilities.desc: The lion has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the lion's allies is within 5 ft. of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

special_abilities.name: Pounce
special_abilities.desc: If the lion moves at least 20 ft. straight toward a creature and then hits it with a claw attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the lion can make one bite attack against it as a bonus action.

special_abilities.name: Running Leap
special_abilities.desc: With a 10-foot running start, the lion can long jump up to 25 ft..

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.

content: The Lion is a Large beast with unaligned alignment, having an Armor Class of 12 based on Dexterity, 26 hit points, and a speed of 50 ft. It excels in Strength (17), Dexterity (15), and Wisdom (12), but lacks in Intelligence (3) and Charisma (8). With proficiency in Perception and Stealth, passive Perception of 13, and a proficiency bonus of 2, the Lion's special abilities include Keen Smell, Pack Tactics, Pounce, and Running Leap. It has a Challenge Rating of 1, 200 XP, and can attack with Bite (1d8+3 piercing damage) and Claw (1d6+3 slashing damage).

name: Lich
damage_immunities: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons
languages: Common plus up to five other languages

special_abilities.name: Legendary Resistance
special_abilities.desc: If the lich fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

special_abilities.name: Rejuvenation
special_abilities.desc: If it has a phylactery, a destroyed lich gains a new body in 1d10 days, regaining all its hit points and becoming active again. The new body appears within 5 feet of the phylactery.

special_abilities.name: Spellcasting
special_abilities.desc:
The lich is an 18th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 20, +12 to hit with spell attacks). The lich has the following wizard spells prepared:

- Cantrips (at will): mage hand, prestidigitation, ray of frost
- 1st level (4 slots): detect magic, magic missile, shield, thunderwave
- 2nd level (3 slots): acid arrow, detect thoughts, invisibility, mirror image
- 3rd level (3 slots): animate dead, counterspell, dispel magic, fireball
- 4th level (3 slots): blight, dimension door
- 5th level (3 slots): cloudkill, scrying
- 6th level (1 slot): disintegrate, globe of invulnerability
- 7th level (1 slot): finger of death, plane shift
- 8th level (1 slot): dominate monster, power word stun
- 9th level (1 slot): power word kill

special_abilities.name: Turn Resistance
special_abilities.desc: The lich has advantage on saving throws against any effect that turns undead.

actions.name: Paralyzing Touch
actions.desc: Melee Spell Attack: +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 10 (3d6) cold damage. The target must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or be paralyzed for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

legendary_actions.name: Cantrip
legendary_actions.desc: The lich casts a cantrip.

legendary_actions.name: Paralyzing Touch (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: The lich uses its Paralyzing Touch.

legendary_actions.name: Frightening Gaze (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: The lich fixes its gaze on one creature it can see within 10 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw against this magic or become frightened for 1 minute. The frightened target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a target's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the target is immune to the lich's gaze for the next 24 hours.

legendary_actions.name: Disrupt Life (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Each living creature within 20 feet of the lich must make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw against this magic, taking 21 (6d6) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

content: The Lich is a Medium-sized undead creature with an armor class of 17 and 135 hit points. It has a speed of 30 ft. and excels in Intelligence, with proficient saving throws in CON, INT, and WIS, as well as skills in Arcana, History, Insight, and Perception. The Lich is resistant to cold, lightning, and necrotic damage, immune to poison and nonmagical weapon attacks, and immune to conditions like Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, and Poisoned. It has truesight up to 120 ft. and a passive perception of 19, able to speak Common and other languages. With a challenge rating of 21, the Lich possesses Legendary Resistance, Rejuvenation, and Turn Resistance abilities. Its Spellcasting ability as an 18th-level wizard includes a wide range of spells such as Disintegrate, Finger of Death, and Power Word Kill. The Lich can also use actions like Paralyzing Touch and legendary actions like Cantrip, Paralyzing Touch, Frightening Gaze, and Disrupt Life to control and harm its opponents in battle.

name: Mage
desc: Mages spend their lives in the study and practice of magic. Good-aligned mages offer counsel to nobles and others in power, while evil mages dwell in isolated sites to perform unspeakable experiments without interference.

special_abilities.name: Spellcasting
special_abilities.desc:
The mage is a 9th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks). The mage has the following wizard spells prepared:

- Cantrips (at will): fire bolt, light, mage hand, prestidigitation
- 1st level (4 slots): detect magic, mage armor, magic missile, shield
- 2nd level (3 slots): misty step, suggestion
- 3rd level (3 slots): counterspell, fireball, fly
- 4th level (3 slots): greater invisibility, ice storm
- 5th level (1 slot): cone of cold

actions.name: Dagger
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

content: The Mage is a Medium humanoid of any race and alignment, proficient in saving throws for Intelligence and Wisdom along with skills in Arcana and History. With an armor class of 12 (DEX) and 15 (SPELL), it has 40 hit points, a speed of 30 ft., and a proficiency bonus of 3. This 9th-level spellcaster has an Intelligence spell save DC of 14 and a +6 to hit with spell attacks, preparing spells like Fire Bolt, Mage Armor, and Cone of Cold. In combat, it can use a Dagger with a +5 to hit and deals 1d4+2 piercing damage. Its special abilities include Spellcasting, allowing it to cast a variety of wizard spells. With a passive perception of 11, the Mage is a formidable opponent with a challenge rating of 6.

name: Lizardfolk

special_abilities.name: Hold Breath
special_abilities.desc: The lizardfolk can hold its breath for 15 minutes.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The lizardfolk makes two melee attacks, each one with a different weapon.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Heavy Club
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Javelin
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Spiked Shield
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

content: The Lizardfolk is a Medium humanoid creature with a subtype of lizardfolk, possessing a natural armor class of 13 and an additional armor class of 15 when equipped with a Shield. It has 22 hit points, with a hit dice of 4d8+4, and a speed of 30 ft. for both walking and swimming. With strengths in perception, stealth, and survival, it has a proficiency bonus of 2 and a passive perception of 13. The creature is proficient in the Draconic language and has a challenge rating of 0.5, offering 100 experience points upon defeat. Notable special abilities include the ability to hold its breath for 15 minutes. In combat, the Lizardfolk can make multiattacks with a choice of Bite, Heavy Club, Javelin, or Spiked Shield as weapons. Each weapon has specific attack bonuses and damage output, making the Lizardfolk a versatile and formidable opponent.

name: Manticore

special_abilities.name: Tail Spike Regrowth
special_abilities.desc: The manticore has twenty-four tail spikes. Used spikes regrow when the manticore finishes a long rest.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The manticore makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws or three with its tail spikes.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Tail Spike
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 100/200 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.

content: The Manticore is a Large monstrosity with lawful evil alignment, possessing natural armor class of 14 and 68 hit points. It has a speed of 30 ft. walking and 50 ft. flying, with notable strengths in strength, dexterity, and constitution. Its special ability, Tail Spike Regrowth, allows for regenerating spikes after a long rest. In combat, the Manticore utilizes Multiattack to make three attacks: one bite and two claws, or three tail spikes. The Bite attack deals 7 piercing damage, the Claw attack inflicts 6 slashing damage, and the Tail Spike attack delivers 7 piercing damage. With darkvision of 60 ft. and passive perception of 11, the Manticore is a formidable creature with a challenge rating of 3.

name: Mammoth
desc: A mammoth is an elephantine creature with thick fur and long tusks. Stockier and fiercer than normal elephants, mammoths inhabit a wide range of climes, from subarctic to subtropical.

special_abilities.name: Trampling Charge
special_abilities.desc: If the mammoth moves at least 20 ft. straight toward a creature and then hits it with a gore attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 18 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the mammoth can make one stomp attack against it as a bonus action.

actions.name: Gore
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 25 (4d8 + 7) piercing damage.

actions.name: Stomp
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one prone creature. Hit: 29 (4d10 + 7) bludgeoning damage.

content: The Mammoth is a Huge beast with a natural armor class of 13 and 126 hit points, derived from 11d12 hit dice with a hit point roll of 11d12+55. This creature has a walk speed of 40 ft. and excels in strength (24), constitution (21), and wisdom (11) while lacking in dexterity (9), intelligence (3), and charisma (6). It possesses a passive perception of 10 and a proficiency bonus of 3, making it a formidable opponent with a challenge rating of 6 and an XP value of 2300. The Mammoth's special ability, Trampling Charge, allows it to knock prone a target with a DC 18 Strength saving throw and make a bonus stomp attack. In combat, it can use its Gore attack with a +10 to hit and deal 25 piercing damage, as well as its Stomp attack with a +10 to hit and 29 bludgeoning damage against a prone creature within 5 ft. of reach.

name: Magma Mephit

special_abilities.name: Death Burst
special_abilities.desc: When the mephit dies, it explodes in a burst of lava. Each creature within 5 ft. of it must make a DC 11 Dexterity saving throw, taking 7 (2d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

special_abilities.name: False Appearance
special_abilities.desc: While the mephit remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary mound of magma.

special_abilities.name: Innate Spellcasting
special_abilities.desc: The mephit can innately cast heat metal (spell save DC 10), requiring no material components. Its innate spellcasting ability is Charisma.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) slashing damage plus 2 (1d4) fire damage.

actions.name: Fire Breath
actions.desc: The mephit exhales a 15-foot cone of fire. Each creature in that area must make a DC 11 Dexterity saving throw, taking 7 (2d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

content: The Magma Mephit is a Small elemental creature with neutral evil alignment, 11 Dexterity armor class, 22 hit points, and a speed of 30 ft. It has damage vulnerabilities to cold, immunities to fire and poison, and is immune to the poisoned condition. This monster has darkvision of 60 ft. and can speak Ignan and Terran languages. With a challenge rating of 0.5, it has special abilities like Death Burst, False Appearance, and Innate Spellcasting with a proficiency bonus of 2. In combat, it can use its Claws and Fire Breath actions to deal slashing and fire damage. The Magma Mephit's Death Burst ability allows it to explode in a burst of lava upon death, causing fire damage to nearby creatures. Additionally, its False Appearance ability allows it to appear as a mound of magma when stationary, making it difficult to detect. Its Innate Spellcasting ability allows it to cast Heat Metal without material components, using Charisma as its spellcasting ability.

name: Magmin
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons

special_abilities.name: Death Burst
special_abilities.desc: When the magmin dies, it explodes in a burst of fire and magma. Each creature within 10 ft. of it must make a DC 11 Dexterity saving throw, taking 7 (2d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Flammable objects that aren't being worn or carried in that area are ignited.

special_abilities.name: Ignited Illumination
special_abilities.desc: As a bonus action, the magmin can set itself ablaze or extinguish its flames. While ablaze, the magmin sheds bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 ft.

actions.name: Touch
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (2d6) fire damage. If the target is a creature or a flammable object, it ignites. Until a target takes an action to douse the fire, the target takes 3 (1d6) fire damage at the end of each of its turns.

content: Magmin is a Small elemental creature with chaotic neutral alignment, an armor class of 14, 9 hit points, and a speed of 30 ft. It has damage resistances to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons, and immunities to fire damage. The magmin has darkvision for 60 ft. and passive perception of 10, and speaks Ignan. With a challenge rating of 0.5, it possesses the special abilities of Death Burst, causing fire damage upon death, and Ignited Illumination, shedding light while ablaze. In combat, it can use its Touch action to deal fire damage and ignite targets. The magmin has attributes of 7 strength, 15 dexterity, 12 constitution, 8 intelligence, 11 wisdom, and 10 charisma, with a proficiency bonus of 2.

name: Mastiff
desc: Mastiffs are impressive hounds prized by humanoids for their loyalty and keen senses. Mastiffs can be trained as guard dogs, hunting dogs, and war dogs. Halflings and other Small humanoids ride them as mounts.

special_abilities.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
special_abilities.desc: The mastiff has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 11 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

content: The Mastiff is a Medium-sized beast with an armor class of 12, 5 hit points, and a speed of 40 ft. It has a strength of 13, dexterity of 14, constitution of 12, intelligence of 3, wisdom of 12, and charisma of 7. This loyal and keen-sensed hound is unaligned and has a proficiency bonus of 2, offering advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks thanks to its special ability, Keen Hearing and Smell. In combat, the Mastiff can use its Bite attack with a +3 to hit, dealing 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage and potentially knocking the target prone with a DC 11 Strength saving throw. With a passive perception of 13, the Mastiff serves as a versatile guard dog, hunting dog, or war dog, even being ridden by Small humanoids like Halflings.

name: Marilith
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons

special_abilities.name: Magic Resistance
special_abilities.desc: The marilith has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

special_abilities.name: Magic Weapons
special_abilities.desc: The marilith's weapon attacks are magical.

special_abilities.name: Reactive
special_abilities.desc: The marilith can take one reaction on every turn in combat.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The marilith can make seven attacks: six with its longswords and one with its tail.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Tail
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) bludgeoning damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, it is grappled (escape DC 19). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, the marilith can automatically hit the target with its tail, and the marilith can't make tail attacks against other targets.

actions.name: Teleport
actions.desc: The marilith magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.desc: The marilith adds 5 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it. To do so, the marilith must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

content: The Marilith is a Large fiend of chaotic evil alignment, with an armor class of 18 and 189 hit points from 18d10 hit dice. It has a speed of 40 ft., with notable strengths in dexterity, constitution, and charisma. This demon is resistant to cold, fire, lightning, and nonmagical weapon attacks, and immune to poison damage. It possesses the Magic Resistance ability, granting advantage on saving throws against magical effects, as well as the ability to wield magical weapons. In combat, the Marilith can make seven attacks, including six with longswords and one with its tail. Its actions also include the ability to teleport up to 120 ft. to an unoccupied space. Additionally, it has the Reactive trait, allowing it to take a reaction on every turn in combat, and the Parry reaction to increase its AC against melee attacks. This formidable foe communicates in Abyssal and through telepathy up to 120 ft., with truesight extending to 120 ft. and a passive perception of 13.

name: Merfolk

special_abilities.name: Amphibious
special_abilities.desc: The merfolk can breathe air and water.

actions.name: Spear
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d6) piercing damage, or 4 (1d8) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

content: The Merfolk is a Medium humanoid creature with a subtype of merfolk, possessing neutral alignment. It has an armor class of 11 based on dexterity, 11 hit points, and a speed of 10 ft. walking and 40 ft. swimming. With a proficiency bonus of 2, it excels in Perception. This creature is Amphibious, capable of breathing both air and water. In combat, it wields a Spear with a +2 attack bonus, dealing 3 (1d6) piercing damage or 4 (1d8) if used with two hands. The Merfolk has a passive perception of 12 and understands Aquan and Common languages.

name: Medusa

special_abilities.name: Petrifying Gaze
special_abilities.desc:
When a creature that can see the medusa's eyes starts its turn within 30 ft. of the medusa, the medusa can force it to make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw if the medusa isn't incapacitated and can see the creature. If the saving throw fails by 5 or more, the creature is instantly petrified. Otherwise, a creature that fails the save begins to turn to stone and is restrained. The restrained creature must repeat the saving throw at the end of its next turn, becoming petrified on a failure or ending the effect on a success. The petrification lasts until the creature is freed by the greater restoration spell or other magic.
Unless surprised, a creature can avert its eyes to avoid the saving throw at the start of its turn. If the creature does so, it can't see the medusa until the start of its next turn, when it can avert its eyes again. If the creature looks at the medusa in the meantime, it must immediately make the save.
If the medusa sees itself reflected on a polished surface within 30 ft. of it and in an area of bright light, the medusa is, due to its curse, affected by its own gaze.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The medusa makes either three melee attacks--one with its snake hair and two with its shortsword--or two ranged attacks with its longbow.

actions.name: Snake Hair
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) poison damage.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage.

content: Medusa is a Medium lawful evil monstrosity with a natural armor class of 15, 127 hit points, and a speed of 30 ft. It has a proficiency bonus of 3 and excels in skills like Deception, Insight, Perception, and Stealth. Its Petrifying Gaze ability forces creatures to make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or become petrified. In combat, the Medusa can make multiple melee attacks with its Snake Hair and Shortsword, or ranged attacks with its Longbow, dealing piercing and poison damage. With darkvision of 60 ft. and a passive perception of 14, the Medusa is a formidable opponent.

name: Merrow

special_abilities.name: Amphibious
special_abilities.desc: The merrow can breathe air and water.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The merrow makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws or harpoon.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Harpoon
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it must succeed on a Strength contest against the merrow or be pulled up to 20 feet toward the merrow.

content: Merrow is a Large monstrosity with chaotic evil alignment, having a natural armor class of 13 and 45 hit points. It has a strength of 18, dexterity of 10, constitution of 15, intelligence of 8, wisdom of 10, and charisma of 9. With a proficiency bonus of 2, it can walk 10 ft. and swim 40 ft. Its abilities include Amphibious, allowing it to breathe air and water. In combat, Merrow can make two attacks with its bite and claws or harpoon through the Multiattack action. Its Bite attack deals 8 piercing damage, Claws deal 9 slashing damage, and Harpoon deals 11 piercing damage and can pull targets closer. It has darkvision of 60 ft. and speaks Abyssal and Aquan languages, making it a challenging opponent with a challenge rating of 2.

name: Minotaur Skeleton

special_abilities.name: Charge
special_abilities.desc: If the skeleton moves at least 10 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a gore attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 9 (2d8) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 10 feet away and knocked prone.

actions.name: Greataxe
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d12 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Gore
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage.

content: The Minotaur Skeleton is a Large undead creature with a lawful evil alignment. It has a natural armor class of 12 and 67 hit points, with a hit dice of 9d10+18. This creature has a speed of 40 ft. and excels in strength with a score of 18. It is immune to poison damage but vulnerable to bludgeoning. The Minotaur Skeleton has darkvision up to 60 ft. and understands Abyssal but cannot speak. With a challenge rating of 2, it possesses the Charge ability which deals extra piercing damage on a successful gore attack. In combat, it can use a Greataxe for slashing damage or Gore for piercing damage. Overall, the Minotaur Skeleton is a formidable opponent with a mix of offensive and defensive capabilities.

name: Mule

special_abilities.name: Beast of Burden
special_abilities.desc: The mule is considered to be a Large animal for the purpose of determining its carrying capacity.

special_abilities.name: Sure-Footed
special_abilities.desc: The mule has advantage on Strength and Dexterity saving throws made against effects that would knock it prone.

actions.name: Hooves
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

content: The Mule is a Medium-sized beast with unaligned alignment, 11 hit points, and a challenge rating of 0.125. It has an armor class of 10 based on Dexterity, a speed of 40 ft., and a proficiency bonus of 2. The Mule has strengths in Strength (14), Constitution (13), and Wisdom (10), with average Dexterity (10) and low Intelligence (2) and Charisma (5). It has passive perception of 10 and is proficient in no skills. The Mule's special abilities include being a Beast of Burden, which allows it to carry a Large animal's capacity, and Sure-Footed, granting advantage on saving throws against effects that would knock it prone. Its only action is using Hooves, a melee attack with a +2 to hit and dealing 4 bludgeoning damage.

name: Mimic

special_abilities.name: Shapechanger
special_abilities.desc: The mimic can use its action to polymorph into an object or back into its true, amorphous form. Its statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn 't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

special_abilities.name: Adhesive (Object Form Only)
special_abilities.desc: The mimic adheres to anything that touches it. A Huge or smaller creature adhered to the mimic is also grappled by it (escape DC 13). Ability checks made to escape this grapple have disadvantage.

special_abilities.name: False Appearance (Object Form Only)
special_abilities.desc: While the mimic remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary object.

special_abilities.name: Grappler
special_abilities.desc: The mimic has advantage on attack rolls against any creature grappled by it.

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage. If the mimic is in object form, the target is subjected to its Adhesive trait.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) acid damage.

content: The Mimic is a Medium monstrosity with a subtype of shapechanger, possessing a natural armor class of 12 and 58 hit points from 9d8 hit dice. Its speed is 15 ft. and it has strengths in strength, constitution, and wisdom. This neutral creature is immune to acid damage and the prone condition. It has darkvision of 60 ft. and a passive perception of 11. The Mimic has a challenge rating of 2 and proficiency in the skill of Stealth with a value of 5. Its special abilities include Shapechanger, Adhesive, False Appearance, and Grappler. In combat, the Mimic can use its Pseudopod or Bite attacks, both with an attack bonus of +5 and dealing various types of damage. Overall, the Mimic is a versatile and deceptive shapechanging creature with unique abilities and combat skills.

name: Mummy
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons
languages: the languages it knew in life

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The mummy can use its Dreadful Glare and makes one attack with its rotting fist.

actions.name: Rotting Fist
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be cursed with mummy rot. The cursed target can't regain hit points, and its hit point maximum decreases by 10 (3d6) for every 24 hours that elapse. If the curse reduces the target's hit point maximum to 0, the target dies, and its body turns to dust. The curse lasts until removed by the remove curse spell or other magic.

actions.name: Dreadful Glare
actions.desc: The mummy targets one creature it can see within 60 ft. of it. If the target can see the mummy, it must succeed on a DC 11 Wisdom saving throw against this magic or become frightened until the end of the mummy's next turn. If the target fails the saving throw by 5 or more, it is also paralyzed for the same duration. A target that succeeds on the saving throw is immune to the Dreadful Glare of all mummies (but not mummy lords) for the next 24 hours.

content: The Mummy is a Medium undead creature with a lawful evil alignment. It has a natural armor class of 11 and 58 hit points, derived from 9d8 hit dice. Its speed is 20 ft. and it has strength 16, dexterity 8, constitution 15, intelligence 6, wisdom 10, and charisma 12. The Mummy is proficient in saving throw: WIS with a proficiency bonus of 2. It is vulnerable to fire but resistant to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons, and immune to necrotic and poison damage. The Mummy is immune to being charmed, exhausted, frightened, paralyzed, and poisoned. It has darkvision up to 60 ft. and passive perception of 10. The Mummy speaks the languages it knew in life and has a challenge rating of 3. In combat, it can use its Multiattack action to perform Dreadful Glare and Rotting Fist attacks. The Rotting Fist attack deals bludgeoning and necrotic damage and can curse targets with mummy rot, reducing their hit point maximum until death. The Dreadful Glare can frighten and paralyze targets.

name: Minotaur

special_abilities.name: Charge
special_abilities.desc: If the minotaur moves at least 10 ft. straight toward a target and then hits it with a gore attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 9 (2d8) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 10 ft. away and knocked prone.

special_abilities.name: Labyrinthine Recall
special_abilities.desc: The minotaur can perfectly recall any path it has traveled.

special_abilities.name: Reckless
special_abilities.desc: At the start of its turn, the minotaur can gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls it makes during that turn, but attack rolls against it have advantage until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Greataxe
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d12 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Gore
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage.

content: The Minotaur is a Large monstrosity with chaotic evil alignment, boasting a natural armor class of 14 and 76 hit points. It has a speed of 40 ft. and excels in strength, wisdom, and constitution. The minotaur's special abilities include Charge, allowing it to deal extra piercing damage and potentially push targets away, Labyrinthine Recall for perfect path recall, and Reckless to gain advantage on melee attacks. In combat, it wields a Greataxe for 17 slashing damage and a Gore attack for 13 piercing damage. With darkvision of 60 ft. and passive perception of 17, the minotaur speaks Abyssal and excels in perception. Its challenge rating is 3, granting 700 xp upon defeat.

name: Nightmare
languages: understands Abyssal, Common, and Infernal but can't speak

special_abilities.name: Confer Fire Resistance
special_abilities.desc: The nightmare can grant resistance to fire damage to anyone riding it.

special_abilities.name: Illumination
special_abilities.desc: The nightmare sheds bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 feet.

actions.name: Hooves
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) fire damage.

actions.name: Ethereal Stride
actions.desc: The nightmare and up to three willing creatures within 5 feet of it magically enter the Ethereal Plane from the Material Plane, or vice versa.

content: Nightmare is a Large fiend of neutral evil alignment with a natural armor class of 13, 68 hit points, and a proficiency bonus of 2. It has a speed of 60 ft. walking and 90 ft. flying, and is immune to fire damage. With strength of 18, dexterity of 15, constitution of 16, intelligence of 10, wisdom of 13, and charisma of 15, Nightmare also has a passive perception of 11. It can understand Abyssal, Common, and Infernal languages but cannot speak. In combat, it can confer fire resistance to riders and shed light in a 10-foot radius. Its actions include a Hooves attack dealing bludgeoning and fire damage, as well as an Ethereal Stride ability to shift between planes. With a challenge rating of 3, Nightmare's XP is 700.

name: Nalfeshnee
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons

special_abilities.name: Magic Resistance
special_abilities.desc: The nalfeshnee has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The nalfeshnee uses Horror Nimbus if it can. It then makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 32 (5d10 + 5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) slashing damage.

actions.name: Horror Nimbus
actions.desc: The nalfeshnee magically emits scintillating, multicolored light. Each creature within 15 feet of the nalfeshnee that can see the light must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the nalfeshnee's Horror Nimbus for the next 24 hours.

actions.name: Teleport
actions.desc: The nalfeshnee magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

content: The Nalfeshnee is a Large demon fiend with chaotic evil alignment, boasting an armor class of 18 and 184 hit points. It has a speed of 20 ft. walking and 30 ft. flying, with notable strengths in strength, constitution, and intelligence. This creature is resistant to cold, fire, lightning, and nonmagical weapon damage, and immune to poison, with a proficiency in saving throws for CON, INT, WIS, and CHA. It possesses truesight up to 120 ft., telepathy, and a passive perception of 11. The Nalfeshnee's special ability is Magic Resistance, granting it advantage against magical effects. In combat, it uses a Multiattack action comprising Horror Nimbus, a Bite attack, and two Claw attacks. The Bite deals 32 piercing damage, while the Claws inflict 15 slashing damage. Additionally, it can emit a Horror Nimbus that frightens creatures within 15 ft. and has a teleportation ability up to 120 ft. This formidable demon presents a challenge rating of 13 with an XP value of 10000, making it a formidable adversary in any encounter.

name: Night Hag
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons that aren't silvered

special_abilities.name: Innate Spellcasting
special_abilities.desc:
The hag's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks). She can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

At will: detect magic, magic missile
2/day each: plane shift (self only), ray of enfeeblement, sleep

special_abilities.name: Magic Resistance
special_abilities.desc: The hag has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

special_abilities.name: Night Hag Items
special_abilities.desc:
A night hag carries two very rare magic items that she must craft for herself If either object is lost, the night hag will go to great lengths to retrieve it, as creating a new tool takes time and effort.
Heartstone: This lustrous black gem allows a night hag to become ethereal while it is in her possession. The touch of a heartstone also cures any disease. Crafting a heartstone takes 30 days.
Soul Bag: When an evil humanoid dies as a result of a night hag's Nightmare Haunting, the hag catches the soul in this black sack made of stitched flesh. A soul bag can hold only one evil soul at a time, and only the night hag who crafted the bag can catch a soul with it. Crafting a soul bag takes 7 days and a humanoid sacrifice (whose flesh is used to make the bag).

actions.name: Claws (Hag Form Only)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Change Shape
actions.desc: The hag magically polymorphs into a Small or Medium female humanoid, or back into her true form. Her statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment she is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. She reverts to her true form if she dies.

actions.name: Etherealness
actions.desc: The hag magically enters the Ethereal Plane from the Material Plane, or vice versa. To do so, the hag must have a heartstone in her possession.

actions.name: Nightmare Haunting
actions.desc: While on the Ethereal Plane, the hag magically touches a sleeping humanoid on the Material Plane. A protection from evil and good spell cast on the target prevents this contact, as does a magic circle. As long as the contact persists, the target has dreadful visions. If these visions last for at least 1 hour, the target gains no benefit from its rest, and its hit point maximum is reduced by 5 (1d10). If this effect reduces the target's hit point maximum to 0, the target dies, and if the target was evil, its soul is trapped in the hag's soul bag. The reduction to the target's hit point maximum lasts until removed by the greater restoration spell or similar magic.

content: Night Hag is a Medium fiend with natural armor class of 17, 112 hit points, and a speed of 30 ft. She excels in Deception, Insight, Perception, and Stealth skills with proficiency bonuses. Night Hag is immune to being charmed and resistant to cold, fire, and nonmagical weapon attacks. She has darkvision up to 120 ft. and a passive perception of 16. With a charisma-based innate spellcasting ability, Night Hag can cast detect magic, magic missile, plane shift, ray of enfeeblement, and sleep spells. Additionally, she has magic resistance and can polymorph, become ethereal, and haunt nightmares. Night Hag carries unique items like the heartstone for etherealness and disease cure, and the soul bag for trapping evil souls. She attacks with claws and can reduce a target's hit points through Nightmare Haunting.

name: Noble
desc:
**Nobles** wield great authority and influence as members of the upper class, possessing wealth and connections that can make them as powerful as monarchs and generals. A noble often travels in the company of guards, as well as servants who are commoners.

The noble’s statistics can also be used to represent **courtiers** who aren’t of noble birth.

actions.name: Rapier
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.desc: The noble adds 2 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it. To do so, the noble must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

content: The Noble is a Medium humanoid of any race with an armor class of 15 provided by a Breastplate. With 9 hit points and a hit dice of 2d8, the Noble has a speed of 30 ft. and excels in skills like Deception, Insight, and Persuasion. It has a passive perception of 12 and can wield a Rapier for 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage. Additionally, the Noble can use the Parry reaction to increase its AC against melee attacks. This aristocratic figure with a Challenge Rating of 0.125 is known for its charisma, intelligence, and wisdom, making it a formidable presence in any encounter.

name: Mummy Lord
damage_immunities: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons
languages: the languages it knew in life

special_abilities.name: Magic Resistance
special_abilities.desc: The mummy lord has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

special_abilities.name: Rejuvenation
special_abilities.desc: A destroyed mummy lord gains a new body in 24 hours if its heart is intact, regaining all its hit points and becoming active again. The new body appears within 5 feet of the mummy lord's heart.

special_abilities.name: Spellcasting
special_abilities.desc:
The mummy lord is a 10th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 17, +9 to hit with spell attacks). The mummy lord has the following cleric spells prepared:

- Cantrips (at will): sacred flame, thaumaturgy
- 1st level (4 slots): command, guiding bolt, shield of faith
- 2nd level (3 slots): hold person, silence, spiritual weapon
- 3rd level (3 slots): animate dead, dispel magic
- 4th level (3 slots): divination, guardian of faith
- 5th level (2 slots): contagion, insect plague
- 6th level (1 slot): harm

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The mummy can use its Dreadful Glare and makes one attack with its rotting fist.

actions.name: Rotting Fist
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 21 (6d6) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be cursed with mummy rot. The cursed target can't regain hit points, and its hit point maximum decreases by 10 (3d6) for every 24 hours that elapse. If the curse reduces the target's hit point maximum to 0, the target dies, and its body turns to dust. The curse lasts until removed by the remove curse spell or other magic.

actions.name: Dreadful Glare
actions.desc: The mummy lord targets one creature it can see within 60 feet of it. If the target can see the mummy lord, it must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw against this magic or become frightened until the end of the mummy's next turn. If the target fails the saving throw by 5 or more, it is also paralyzed for the same duration. A target that succeeds on the saving throw is immune to the Dreadful Glare of all mummies and mummy lords for the next 24 hours.

legendary_actions.name: Attack
legendary_actions.desc: The mummy lord makes one attack with its rotting fist or uses its Dreadful Glare.

legendary_actions.name: Blinding Dust
legendary_actions.desc: Blinding dust and sand swirls magically around the mummy lord. Each creature within 5 feet of the mummy lord must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the end of the creature's next turn.

legendary_actions.name: Blasphemous Word (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: The mummy lord utters a blasphemous word. Each non-undead creature within 10 feet of the mummy lord that can hear the magical utterance must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of the mummy lord's next turn.

legendary_actions.name: Channel Negative Energy (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: The mummy lord magically unleashes negative energy. Creatures within 60 feet of the mummy lord, including ones behind barriers and around corners, can't regain hit points until the end of the mummy lord's next turn.

legendary_actions.name: Whirlwind of Sand (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: The mummy lord magically transforms into a whirlwind of sand, moves up to 60 feet, and reverts to its normal form. While in whirlwind form, the mummy lord is immune to all damage, and it can't be grappled, petrified, knocked prone, restrained, or stunned. Equipment worn or carried by the mummy lord remain in its possession.

content: The Mummy Lord is a Medium undead creature with a lawful evil alignment and an armor class of 17. It has 97 hit points, with a hit dice of 13d8 and a hit points roll of 13d8+39. The Mummy Lord has a speed of 20 ft. and excels in Strength, Wisdom, and Charisma. It is proficient in saving throws related to Constitution, Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma, as well as skills like History and Religion. The Mummy Lord is immune to necrotic, poison, and nonmagical weapon damage, while being vulnerable to fire. It is resistant to conditions like charmed, exhaustion, and paralyzed. The Mummy Lord has darkvision up to 60 ft. and speaks the languages it knew in life. With a challenge rating of 15, the Mummy Lord possesses special abilities such as Magic Resistance, Rejuvenation, and potent Spellcasting capabilities as a 10th-level cleric. Its actions include a Multiattack with Dreadful Glare and Rotting Fist, which inflicts bludgeoning and necrotic damage. Additionally, the Mummy Lord can utilize Legendary Actions like Blinding Dust, Blasphemous Word, Channel Negative Energy, and Whirlwind of Sand to control the battlefield and incapacitate foes effectively.

name: Octopus

special_abilities.name: Hold Breath
special_abilities.desc: While out of water, the octopus can hold its breath for 30 minutes.

special_abilities.name: Underwater Camouflage
special_abilities.desc: The octopus has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made while underwater.

special_abilities.name: Water Breathing
special_abilities.desc: The octopus can breathe only underwater.

actions.name: Tentacles
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 10). Until this grapple ends, the octopus can't use its tentacles on another target.

actions.name: Ink Cloud
actions.desc: A 5-foot-radius cloud of ink extends all around the octopus if it is underwater. The area is heavily obscured for 1 minute, although a significant current can disperse the ink. After releasing the ink, the octopus can use the Dash action as a bonus action.

content: The Octopus is a small beast with unaligned alignment, an armor class of 12 (dex), 3 hit points, and a speed of 5 ft. walk and 30 ft. swim. It has strengths in dexterity (15) and weaknesses in intelligence (3) and charisma (4). With proficiencies in perception and stealth, the octopus has special abilities like Hold Breath, Underwater Camouflage, and Water Breathing. Its actions include Tentacles for melee attacks and Ink Cloud for creating a cloud of ink underwater. This creature has darkvision of 30 ft. and passive perception of 12, making it a stealthy and adaptable underwater predator.

name: Ochre Jelly

special_abilities.name: Amorphous
special_abilities.desc: The jelly can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

special_abilities.name: Spider Climb
special_abilities.desc: The jelly can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage plus 3 (1d6) acid damage.

reactions.name: Split
reactions.desc: When a jelly that is Medium or larger is subjected to lightning or slashing damage, it splits into two new jellies if it has at least 10 hit points. Each new jelly has hit points equal to half the original jelly's, rounded down. New jellies are one size smaller than the original jelly.

content: The Ochre Jelly is a Large ooze creature with 45 hit points, 8 dexterity armor class, and a challenge rating of 2. It has damage resistances to acid and immunities to lightning and slashing. This creature has special abilities such as Amorphous allowing it to move through narrow spaces and Spider Climb enabling it to climb difficult surfaces without checks. Its senses include blindsight up to 60 ft. and passive perception of 8. The Ochre Jelly can use its Pseudopod action dealing bludgeoning and acid damage. It also has a reaction called Split, where it splits into two new jellies when subjected to lightning or slashing damage. Overall, this creature is a formidable opponent with unique abilities and resistances.

name: Ogre

actions.name: Greatclub
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Javelin
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage.

content: Ogre is a Large giant creature with chaotic evil alignment, wearing Hide Armor with an armor class of 11. It has 59 hit points, a hit dice of 7d10, and a hit points roll of 7d10+21. The Ogre has a walking speed of 40 ft., strength of 19, dexterity of 8, constitution of 16, intelligence of 5, wisdom of 7, and charisma of 7. It has darkvision of 60 ft., passive perception of 8, and speaks Common and Giant languages. With a challenge rating of 2, proficiency bonus of 2, and 450 experience points, the Ogre's primary actions include the Greatclub and Javelin attacks, each dealing specific bludgeoning and piercing damage.

name: Ogre Zombie
languages: understands Common and Giant but can't speak

special_abilities.name: Undead Fortitude
special_abilities.desc: If damage reduces the zombie to 0 hit points, it must make a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5+the damage taken, unless the damage is radiant or from a critical hit. On a success, the zombie drops to 1 hit point instead.

actions.name: Morningstar
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

content: The Ogre Zombie is a Large undead creature with a neutral evil alignment, having 85 hit points and a constitution of 18. It has a strength of 19, dexterity of 6, and wisdom of 6, while being immune to poison damage and the poisoned condition. This creature has darkvision up to 60 ft. and a passive perception of 8. In combat, the Ogre Zombie wields a Morningstar, making a melee attack with +6 to hit and dealing 13 bludgeoning damage. It possesses the special ability Undead Fortitude, allowing it to resist dropping to 0 hit points. The Ogre Zombie understands Common and Giant languages but is unable to speak, presenting a challenge rating of 2 and a proficiency bonus of 2.

name: Owl

special_abilities.name: Flyby
special_abilities.desc: The owl doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

special_abilities.name: Keen Hearing and Sight
special_abilities.desc: The owl has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or sight.

actions.name: Talons
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 slashing damage.

content: The Owl is a Tiny beast with unaligned alignment, an armor class of 11 (based on dexterity), 1 hit point, 5 ft. walking speed, and 60 ft. flying speed. It has low strength (3), average dexterity (13), low constitution (8), very low intelligence (2), average wisdom (12), and low charisma (7). The owl excels in Perception and Stealth skills with a proficiency bonus of 3. It has darkvision up to 120 ft. and a passive perception of 13. Special abilities include Flyby, allowing the owl to avoid opportunity attacks while flying, and Keen Hearing and Sight, granting advantage on perception checks based on hearing or sight. In combat, the owl can use its Talons with a +3 to hit and deals 1 slashing damage. This creature has a challenge rating of 0 and 2 proficiency bonus, making it a beginner-level encounter worth 10 experience points.

name: Orc

special_abilities.name: Aggressive
special_abilities.desc: As a bonus action, the orc can move up to its speed toward a hostile creature that it can see.

actions.name: Greataxe
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d12 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Javelin
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

content: The Orc is a Medium humanoid creature of chaotic evil alignment with an armor class of 13 thanks to its Hide Armor. It has 15 hit points, a hit dice of 2d8, and a hit points roll of 2d8+6. With a strength of 16, dexterity of 12, constitution of 16, intelligence of 7, wisdom of 11, and charisma of 10, it excels in intimidating others. Additionally, it possesses darkvision up to 60 ft. and has a passive perception of 10. The Orc is proficient in the Skill: Intimidation with a proficiency bonus of 2. In combat, it can use its Aggressive ability to move swiftly toward a hostile creature. Armed with a Greataxe and Javelin, the Orc delivers powerful slashing and piercing damage, respectively. This creature speaks Common and Orc, and has a challenge rating of 0.5, granting 100 experience points upon defeat.

name: Otyugh

special_abilities.name: Limited Telepathy
special_abilities.desc: The otyugh can magically transmit simple messages and images to any creature within 120 ft. of it that can understand a language. This form of telepathy doesn't allow the receiving creature to telepathically respond.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The otyugh makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its tentacles.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw against disease or become poisoned until the disease is cured. Every 24 hours that elapse, the target must repeat the saving throw, reducing its hit point maximum by 5 (1d10) on a failure. The disease is cured on a success. The target dies if the disease reduces its hit point maximum to 0. This reduction to the target's hit point maximum lasts until the disease is cured.

actions.name: Tentacle
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 4 (1d8) piercing damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, it is grappled (escape DC 13) and restrained until the grapple ends. The otyugh has two tentacles, each of which can grapple one target.

actions.name: Tentacle Slam
actions.desc: The otyugh slams creatures grappled by it into each other or a solid surface. Each creature must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or take 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage and be stunned until the end of the otyugh's next turn. On a successful save, the target takes half the bludgeoning damage and isn't stunned.

content: The Otyugh is a Large aberration with a neutral alignment, boasting an armor class of 14 from its natural armor. With 114 hit points and a constitution of 19, it has a proficiency in saving throws for constitution. This creature has darkvision up to 120 ft. and limited telepathy, allowing it to communicate simple messages to nearby creatures. In combat, the Otyugh can make three attacks: one bite and two tentacle attacks, each with their own unique effects. The bite attack deals 12 piercing damage and can induce poison, while the tentacle attack can grapple and restrain targets. Additionally, the Otyugh can slam grappled creatures for bludgeoning damage and stun them. With a challenge rating of 5, this creature presents a formidable foe for adventurers.

name: Owlbear

special_abilities.name: Keen Sight and Smell
special_abilities.desc: The owlbear has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight or smell.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The owlbear makes two attacks: one with its beak and one with its claws.

actions.name: Beak
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 10 (1d10 + 5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) slashing damage.

content: The Owlbear is a Large monstrosity with an unaligned alignment, an armor class of 13, 59 hit points, and a speed of 40 ft. It has strengths in strength (20), dexterity (12), and constitution (17), with proficiency in Perception. This creature has darkvision up to 60 ft., passive perception of 13, and a challenge rating of 3. Special abilities include Keen Sight and Smell, granting advantage on Perception checks. In combat, it can use Multiattack to make two attacks with its beak and claws, dealing piercing and slashing damage respectively. The Owlbear's attacks have an attack bonus of +7 and deal significant damage.

name: Pegasus
languages: understands Celestial, Common, Elvish, and Sylvan but can't speak

actions.name: Hooves
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

content: Pegasus is a Large celestial creature with chaotic good alignment, having an armor class of 12 based on dexterity. It has 59 hit points, moves at 60 ft. per round on land and 90 ft. while flying. With a strength of 18, dexterity of 15, constitution of 16, intelligence of 10, wisdom of 15, and charisma of 13, it excels in saving throws for dexterity, wisdom, and charisma, along with proficiency in Perception. It has a passive perception of 16 and understands Celestial, Common, Elvish, and Sylvan languages but cannot speak. Pegasus has a challenge rating of 2, proficiency bonus of 2, and earns 450 xp. In combat, it uses its Hooves to make a Melee Weapon Attack with +6 to hit, dealing 11 bludgeoning damage with 2d6+4 dice.

name: Panther

special_abilities.name: Keen Smell
special_abilities.desc: The panther has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

special_abilities.name: Pounce
special_abilities.desc: If the panther moves at least 20 ft. straight toward a creature and then hits it with a claw attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 12 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the panther can make one bite attack against it as a bonus action.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage.

content: Panther is a Medium beast with unaligned alignment, having an armor class of 12 (dex). It has 13 hit points, 3d8 hit dice, and a speed of 50 ft. walk and 40 ft. climb. With a strength of 14, dexterity of 15, and wisdom of 14, it excels in skills like Perception (proficiency value: 4) and Stealth (proficiency value: 6). It has a passive perception of 14 and special abilities like Keen Smell for advantage on perception checks relying on smell. Panther's Bite and Claw attacks have an attack bonus of +4 and deal piercing and slashing damage respectively. It also has the Pounce ability to knock targets prone with a DC 12 Strength saving throw. With a challenge rating of 0.25, Panther provides 50 XP upon defeat.

name: Oni

special_abilities.name: Innate Spellcasting
special_abilities.desc:
The oni's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 13). The oni can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

At will: darkness, invisibility
1/day each: charm person, cone of cold, gaseous form, sleep

special_abilities.name: Magic Weapons
special_abilities.desc: The oni's weapon attacks are magical.

special_abilities.name: Regeneration
special_abilities.desc: The oni regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hit point.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The oni makes two attacks, either with its claws or its glaive.

actions.name: Claw (Oni Form Only)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Glaive
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) slashing damage, or 9 (1d10 + 4) slashing damage in Small or Medium form.

actions.name: Change Shape
actions.desc: The oni magically polymorphs into a Small or Medium humanoid, into a Large giant, or back into its true form. Other than its size, its statistics are the same in each form. The only equipment that is transformed is its glaive, which shrinks so that it can be wielded in humanoid form. If the oni dies, it reverts to its true form, and its glaive reverts to its normal size.

content: The Oni is a Large giant creature with lawful evil alignment and an armor class of 16, wearing Chain Mail. It has 110 hit points, a hit dice of 13d10, and a speed of 30 ft. It excels in strength (19), charisma (15), and proficiency in saving throws (DEX, CON, WIS, CHA) and skills (Arcana, Deception, Perception). The oni has darkvision of 60 ft. and a passive perception of 14, speaks Common and Giant languages, and possesses innate spellcasting abilities using Charisma (spell save DC 13) to cast spells like darkness, invisibility, charm person, cone of cold, gaseous form, and sleep. It can regenerate 10 hit points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hit point. In combat, it can make two attacks with claws or a glaive, both dealing significant slashing damage. The Oni can also change shape into different forms while maintaining its statistics, with the glaive transforming to be wielded in humanoid form.

name: Phase Spider
desc: A phase spider possesses the magical ability to phase in and out of the Ethereal Plane. It seems to appear out of nowhere and quickly vanishes after attacking. Its movement on the Ethereal Plane before coming back to the Material Plane makes it seem like it can teleport.

special_abilities.name: Ethereal Jaunt
special_abilities.desc: As a bonus action, the spider can magically shift from the Material Plane to the Ethereal Plane, or vice versa.

special_abilities.name: Spider Climb
special_abilities.desc: The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

special_abilities.name: Web Walker
special_abilities.desc: The spider ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 11 Constitution saving throw, taking 18 (4d8) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If the poison damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, the target is stable but poisoned for 1 hour, even after regaining hit points, and is paralyzed while poisoned in this way.

content: The Phase Spider is a Large monstrosity with an unaligned alignment and a natural armor class of 13. It has 32 hit points, 5d10 hit dice, and a speed of 30 ft. for both walking and climbing. With a strength of 15, dexterity of 15, constitution of 12, intelligence of 6, wisdom of 10, and charisma of 6, it excels in stealth with a proficiency bonus of 6 in Skill: Stealth. The Phase Spider has darkvision for 60 ft. and a passive perception of 10. Its special abilities include Ethereal Jaunt, Spider Climb, and Web Walker, allowing it to teleport between planes, climb difficult surfaces, and ignore movement restrictions from webbing. In combat, it can make a Bite attack with a +4 bonus to hit, dealing 7 piercing damage plus 18 poison damage on a failed DC 11 Constitution saving throw. This creature poses a challenge rating of 3, providing 700 XP upon defeat.

name: Poisonous Snake

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 10 Constitution saving throw, taking 5 (2d4) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

content: The Poisonous Snake is a Tiny beast with an armor class of 13 based on dexterity. It has 2 hit points and a speed of 30 ft. for both walking and swimming. With a dexterity of 16, it excels in agility. Its attack, Bite, has a +5 bonus to hit and deals 1 piercing damage, along with 5 poison damage on a failed DC 10 Constitution saving throw. The snake's senses include blindsight within 10 ft. and a passive perception of 10. Although its strength and intelligence are low, its proficiency bonus is 2. This creature poses a challenge rating of 0.125 and yields 25 experience points when defeated.

name: Polar Bear

special_abilities.name: Keen Smell
special_abilities.desc: The bear has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The bear makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage.

content: The Polar Bear is a Large beast with an unaligned alignment and a natural armor class of 12. It has 42 hit points, a hit dice of 5d10, and a hit points roll of 5d10+15. With a strength of 20 and a wisdom of 13, the bear excels in perception with a passive perception of 13. It has a proficiency bonus of 2 and is proficient in the Skill: Perception. The bear's special ability, Keen Smell, grants advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks relying on smell. In combat, it can make a Multiattack with a Bite and Claws, dealing piercing and slashing damage respectively. The Bite attack has a +7 to hit and deals 1d8+5 piercing damage, while the Claws attack has the same +7 to hit and deals 2d6+5 slashing damage. This creature's challenge rating is 2, offering 450 experience points upon defeat.

name: Pony

actions.name: Hooves
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

content: Pony is a Medium-sized beast with unaligned alignment, having an armor class of 10 based on dexterity. It has 11 hit points, 2d8 hit dice, and a speed of 40 ft. Its attributes include 15 strength, 10 dexterity, 13 constitution, 2 intelligence, 11 wisdom, and 7 charisma. With a proficiency bonus of 2 and a challenge rating of 0.125, Pony's XP is 25. It has hooves as its action, with +4 to hit and dealing 7 bludgeoning damage. Additionally, Pony has passive perception of 10 and no known proficiencies or languages.

name: Planetar
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons

special_abilities.name: Angelic Weapons
special_abilities.desc: The planetar's weapon attacks are magical. When the planetar hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra 5d8 radiant damage (included in the attack).

special_abilities.name: Divine Awareness
special_abilities.desc: The planetar knows if it hears a lie.

special_abilities.name: Innate Spellcasting
special_abilities.desc:
The planetar's spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 20). The planetar can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: detect evil and good, invisibility (self only)
3/day each: blade barrier, dispel evil and good, flame strike, raise dead
1/day each: commune, control weather, insect plague

special_abilities.name: Magic Resistance
special_abilities.desc: The planetar has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The planetar makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Greatsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (4d6 + 7) slashing damage plus 22 (5d8) radiant damage.

actions.name: Healing Touch
actions.desc: The planetar touches another creature. The target magically regains 30 (6d8 + 3) hit points and is freed from any curse, disease, poison, blindness, or deafness.

content: The Planetar is a Large celestial creature with a lawful good alignment, boasting an impressive natural armor class of 19 and 200 hit points from 16d10 hit dice. With a speed of 40 ft. walking and 120 ft. flying, the Planetar excels in combat with a strength of 24, dexterity of 20, constitution of 24, intelligence of 19, wisdom of 22, and charisma of 25. Proficient in saving throws for constitution, wisdom, and charisma, as well as perception skills, the Planetar is resistant to radiant damage and nonmagical weapon attacks, while immune to conditions like charmed, exhaustion, and frightened. Equipped with truesight, passive perception of 21, and the ability to speak all languages with telepathy up to 120 ft., the Planetar is a formidable opponent with a challenge rating of 16. Special abilities include Angelic Weapons for extra radiant damage, Divine Awareness to detect lies, and Innate Spellcasting with a variety of spells like detect evil and good, flame strike, and control weather. Additionally, Magic Resistance grants advantage on saving throws against magical effects. In combat, the Planetar can make two melee attacks with a Greatsword dealing slashing and radiant damage, and has a Healing Touch ability to restore hit points and cure ailments.

name: Pit Fiend
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons that aren't silvered

special_abilities.name: Fear Aura
special_abilities.desc: Any creature hostile to the pit fiend that starts its turn within 20 feet of the pit fiend must make a DC 21 Wisdom saving throw, unless the pit fiend is incapacitated. On a failed save, the creature is frightened until the start of its next turn. If a creature's saving throw is successful, the creature is immune to the pit fiend's Fear Aura for the next 24 hours.

special_abilities.name: Magic Resistance
special_abilities.desc: The pit fiend has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

special_abilities.name: Magic Weapons
special_abilities.desc: The pit fiend's weapon attacks are magical.

special_abilities.name: Innate Spellcasting
special_abilities.desc:
The pit fiend's spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 21). The pit fiend can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: detect magic, fireball
3/day each: hold monster, wall of fire

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The pit fiend makes four attacks: one with its bite, one with its claw, one with its mace, and one with its tail.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (4d6 + 8) piercing damage. The target must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw or become poisoned. While poisoned in this way, the target can't regain hit points, and it takes 21 (6d6) poison damage at the start of each of its turns. The poisoned target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 10 ft. , one target. Hit: 17 (2d8 + 8) slashing damage.

actions.name: Mace
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 10ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d6 + 8) bludgeoning damage plus 21 (6d6) fire damage.

actions.name: Tail
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 10ft., one target. Hit: 24 (3d10 + 8) bludgeoning damage.

content: The Pit Fiend is a Large fiend subtype devil with lawful evil alignment, boasting an armor class of 19 from natural defenses and 300 hit points. It has a strength of 26, dexterity of 14, constitution of 24, intelligence of 22, wisdom of 18, and charisma of 24. Notable proficiencies include saving throws for DEX, CON, and WIS, while possessing damage resistances to cold and nonmagical weapons. Immune to fire and poison, the Pit Fiend has truesight of 120 ft. and passive perception of 14. It speaks Infernal and has telepathy up to 120 ft., with a challenge rating of 20 and proficiency bonus of 6. Special abilities like Fear Aura, Magic Resistance, and Magic Weapons enhance its combat prowess, along with innate spellcasting capabilities. The Pit Fiend's actions involve a Multiattack with bite, claw, mace, and tail strikes, each dealing specific damage types and effects. Overall, the Pit Fiend is a formidable adversary with a range of offensive and defensive capabilities suited for intense battles.

name: Priest
desc:
Priests bring the teachings of their gods to the common folk. They are the spiritual leaders of temples and shrines and often hold positions of influence in their communities. Evil priests might work openly under a tyrant, or they might be the leaders of religious sects hidden in the shadows of good society, overseeing depraved rites.

A priest typically has one or more acolytes to help with religious ceremonies and other sacred duties.

special_abilities.name: Divine Eminence
special_abilities.desc: As a bonus action, the priest can expend a spell slot to cause its melee weapon attacks to magically deal an extra 10 (3d6) radiant damage to a target on a hit. This benefit lasts until the end of the turn. If the priest expends a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the extra damage increases by 1d6 for each level above 1st.

special_abilities.name: Spellcasting
special_abilities.desc:
The priest is a 5th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 13, +5 to hit with spell attacks). The priest has the following cleric spells prepared:

- Cantrips (at will): light, sacred flame, thaumaturgy
- 1st level (4 slots): cure wounds, guiding bolt, sanctuary
- 2nd level (3 slots): lesser restoration, spiritual weapon
- 3rd level (2 slots): dispel magic, spirit guardians

actions.name: Mace
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage.

content: The Priest is a Medium humanoid of any race with any alignment, possessing an armor class of 13 with a Chain Shirt. They have 27 hit points and a hit dice of 5d8, with a proficiency bonus of 2. Their strengths lie in their wisdom and charisma, with proficiencies in Medicine, Persuasion, and Religion skills. The Priest's special abilities include Divine Eminence, allowing for extra radiant damage on melee attacks, and Spellcasting as a 5th-level cleric with spells like light, cure wounds, and spiritual weapon. In combat, they wield a Mace for bludgeoning damage. Overall, the Priest serves as a spiritual leader with influence in their community, guiding their acolytes in religious duties and ceremonies.
