name: Purple Worm

special_abilities.name: Tunneler
special_abilities.desc: The worm can burrow through solid rock at half its burrow speed and leaves a 10-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The worm makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its stinger.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc:
Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (3d8 + 9) piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw or be swallowed by the worm. A swallowed creature is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the worm, and it takes 21 (6d6) acid damage at the start of each of the worm's turns.
If the worm takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the worm must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall prone in a space within 10 feet of the worm. If the worm dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse by using 20 feet of movement, exiting prone.

actions.name: Tail Stinger
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. Hit: 19 (3d6 + 9) piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 19 Constitution saving throw, taking 42 (12d6) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

content: The Purple Worm is a Gargantuan monstrosity with an armor class of 18, 247 hit points, and a speed of 50 ft. walking and 30 ft. burrowing. It has high strength, constitution, and proficiency in Constitution saving throws and Wisdom saving throws. With blindsight, tremorsense, and a passive perception of 9, the Purple Worm is a formidable creature capable of burrowing through solid rock with its Tunneler special ability. In combat, it can make two attacks with its Bite and Tail Stinger, dealing piercing damage and potentially swallowing its foes. The Bite attack includes acid damage and the possibility of regurgitating swallowed creatures. The Tail Stinger attack inflicts poison damage on failed saving throws. Overall, the Purple Worm presents a challenging encounter with its potent offensive capabilities and defensive attributes.

name: Pseudodragon
languages: understands Common and Draconic but can't speak

special_abilities.name: Keen Senses
special_abilities.desc: The pseudodragon has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight, hearing, or smell.

special_abilities.name: Magic Resistance
special_abilities.desc: The pseudodragon has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

special_abilities.name: Limited Telepathy
special_abilities.desc: The pseudodragon can magically communicate simple ideas, emotions, and images telepathically with any creature within 100 ft. of it that can understand a language.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Sting
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or become poisoned for 1 hour. If the saving throw fails by 5 or more, the target falls unconscious for the same duration, or until it takes damage or another creature uses an action to shake it awake.

content: The Pseudodragon is a Tiny dragon creature with a neutral good alignment, having a natural armor class of 13 and 7 hit points. It has a speed of 15 ft. walking and 60 ft. flying, with abilities such as Keen Senses granting advantage on Perception checks and Limited Telepathy allowing telepathic communication within 100 ft. It is proficient in Perception and Stealth skills, and has a proficiency bonus of 2. The Pseudodragon's bite and sting attacks both deal 4 piercing damage, with the sting attack potentially poisoning or incapacitating the target. With Magic Resistance providing advantage against spells and other magical effects, this creature presents a challenge rating of 0.25 and offers 50 XP when defeated.

name: Plesiosaurus

special_abilities.name: Hold Breath
special_abilities.desc: The plesiosaurus can hold its breath for 1 hour.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) piercing damage.

content: Plesiosaurus is a Large beast with unaligned alignment, an armor class of 13, 68 hit points, and a speed of 20 ft. walking and 40 ft. swimming. It has strengths in strength, dexterity, and constitution, with lower intelligence, wisdom, and charisma. Proficient in Perception and Stealth, it also has a passive perception of 13. With a challenge rating of 2, it has a proficiency bonus of 2 and special ability to hold its breath for 1 hour. In combat, it can use its Bite attack with a +6 to hit, dealing 14 piercing damage.

name: Quasit
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons

special_abilities.name: Shapechanger
special_abilities.desc: The quasit can use its action to polymorph into a beast form that resembles a bat (speed 10 ft. fly 40 ft.), a centipede (40 ft., climb 40 ft.), or a toad (40 ft., swim 40 ft.), or back into its true form . Its statistics are the same in each form, except for the speed changes noted. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed . It reverts to its true form if it dies.

special_abilities.name: Magic Resistance
special_abilities.desc: The quasit has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Claw (Bite in Beast Form)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or take 5 (2d4) poison damage and become poisoned for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Scare
actions.desc: One creature of the quasit's choice within 20 ft. of it must succeed on a DC 10 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, with disadvantage if the quasit is within line of sight, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Invisibility
actions.desc: The quasit magically turns invisible until it attacks or uses Scare, or until its concentration ends (as if concentrating on a spell). Any equipment the quasit wears or carries is invisible with it.

content: Quasit is a Tiny fiend demon with chaotic evil alignment, possessing an armor class of 13 from dexterity. It has 7 hit points, a speed of 40 ft., and notable damage resistances to cold, fire, lightning, and nonmagical weapons. This creature is immune to poison damage and resistant to being poisoned. With darkvision of 120 ft. and passive perception of 10, the Quasit speaks Abyssal and Common languages, boasting a challenge rating of 1. Special abilities include Shapechanger, allowing transformation into various beasts, and Magic Resistance for saving throws against spells. Its actions include Claw (Bite in Beast Form) dealing piercing and poison damage, Scare inducing fear in targets, and Invisibility. This versatile entity is proficient in Stealth and possesses proficiency in skill usage, making it a formidable adversary in combat scenarios.

name: Quipper
desc: A quipper is a carnivorous fish with sharp teeth. Quippers can adapt to any aquatic environment, including cold subterranean lakes. They frequently gather in swarms; the statistics for a swarm of quippers appear later in this appendix.

special_abilities.name: Blood Frenzy
special_abilities.desc: The quipper has advantage on melee attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its hit points.

special_abilities.name: Water Breathing
special_abilities.desc: The quipper can breathe only underwater.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing damage.

content: Quipper is a Tiny beast with unaligned alignment, having a dexterity of 16 and a swim speed of 40 ft. It has 1 hit point, darkvision of 60 ft., and a passive perception of 8. This carnivorous fish with sharp teeth can adapt to any aquatic environment and frequently gathers in swarms. The quipper has advantage on melee attack rolls against creatures without full hit points, and can only breathe underwater. Its Bite action involves a +5 attack bonus, dealing 1 piercing damage.

name: Rat

special_abilities.name: Keen Smell
special_abilities.desc: The rat has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +0 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing damage.

content: The Rat is a Tiny beast with an unaligned alignment, an armor class of 10 based on dexterity, 1 hit point, a 20 ft. walking speed, strength of 2, dexterity of 11, constitution of 9, intelligence of 2, wisdom of 10, and charisma of 4. It has darkvision of 30 ft. and a passive perception of 10. The Rat has a challenge rating of 0 and a proficiency bonus of 2, with special ability Keen Smell granting advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks relying on smell. Its Bite action has a +0 attack bonus and deals 1 piercing damage. The Rat is proficient in no skills, has no damage vulnerabilities, resistances, or immunities, and no condition immunities.

name: Rakshasa
damage_vulnerabilities: piercing from magic weapons wielded by good creatures
damage_immunities: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons

special_abilities.name: Limited Magic Immunity
special_abilities.desc: The rakshasa can't be affected or detected by spells of 6th level or lower unless it wishes to be. It has advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects.

special_abilities.name: Innate Spellcasting
special_abilities.desc:
The rakshasa's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 18, +10 to hit with spell attacks). The rakshasa can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

At will: detect thoughts, disguise self, mage hand, minor illusion
3/day each: charm person, detect magic, invisibility, major image, suggestion
1/day each: dominate person, fly, plane shift, true seeing

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The rakshasa makes two claw attacks

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) slashing damage, and the target is cursed if it is a creature. The magical curse takes effect whenever the target takes a short or long rest, filling the target's thoughts with horrible images and dreams. The cursed target gains no benefit from finishing a short or long rest. The curse lasts until it is lifted by a remove curse spell or similar magic.

content: The Rakshasa is a Medium fiend with lawful evil alignment, boasting an armor class of 16 from its natural defenses. It has 110 hit points derived from 13d8 hit dice, with a hit points roll of 13d8+52. This creature has a speed of 40 ft. and excels in Charisma with a score of 20, along with notable proficiencies in Deception and Insight. Notable attributes include 14 in Strength, 17 in Dexterity, 18 in Constitution, 13 in Intelligence, and 16 in Wisdom. It possesses darkvision up to 60 ft. and a passive perception of 13, able to speak Common and Infernal. The Rakshasa is resistant to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical weapons, while being vulnerable to piercing from magic weapons wielded by good entities. It has a challenge rating of 13, proficiency bonus of 5, and special abilities like Limited Magic Immunity and Innate Spellcasting with a variety of spells at its disposal. In combat, the Rakshasa can make two claw attacks through its Multiattack action, dealing slashing damage with a +7 attack bonus.

name: Remorhaz

special_abilities.name: Heated Body
special_abilities.desc: A creature that touches the remorhaz or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 10 (3d6) fire damage.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 40 (6d10 + 7) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) fire damage. If the target is a creature, it is grappled (escape DC 17). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the remorhaz can't bite another target.

actions.name: Swallow
actions.desc:
The remorhaz makes one bite attack against a Medium or smaller creature it is grappling. If the attack hits, that creature takes the bite's damage and is swallowed, and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the creature is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the remorhaz, and it takes 21 (6d6) acid damage at the start of each of the remorhaz's turns.
If the remorhaz takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the remorhaz must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall prone in a space within 10 feet of the remorhaz. If the remorhaz dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse using 15 feet of movement, exiting prone.

content: The Remorhaz is a Huge monstrosity with an armor class of 17, 195 hit points, and a challenge rating of 11. It has strengths in strength, constitution, and proficiency bonus, with damage immunities to cold and fire. This creature possesses the special ability Heated Body, dealing fire damage to those who touch or attack it in melee. It can also use actions like Bite, which grapples and restrains targets, and Swallow, which engulfs and damages swallowed creatures. The Remorhaz has darkvision, tremorsense, and a passive perception of 10, making it a formidable opponent in combat.

name: Reef Shark
desc: Smaller than giant sharks and hunter sharks, reef sharks inhabit shallow waters and coral reefs, gathering in small packs to hunt. A full-grown specimen measures 6 to 10 feet long.

special_abilities.name: Pack Tactics
special_abilities.desc: The shark has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the shark's allies is within 5 ft. of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

special_abilities.name: Water Breathing
special_abilities.desc: The shark can breathe only underwater.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.

content: Reef Shark is a Medium-sized beast with an unaligned alignment, 12 natural armor class, 22 hit points, and a swim speed of 40 ft. It has 14 strength, 13 dexterity, and 13 constitution, with proficiency in Perception and a passive perception of 12. This creature has a challenge rating of 0.5 and special abilities like Pack Tactics and Water Breathing. In combat, it can make a Bite attack with a +4 to hit, dealing 6 piercing damage. This shark inhabits shallow waters and coral reefs, hunting in packs and measuring 6 to 10 feet long.

name: Raven

special_abilities.name: Mimicry
special_abilities.desc: The raven can mimic simple sounds it has heard, such as a person whispering, a baby crying, or an animal chittering. A creature that hears the sounds can tell they are imitations with a successful DC 10 Wisdom (Insight) check.

actions.name: Beak
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing damage.

content: The Raven is a Tiny beast with unaligned alignment, a tiny size, and a Dexterity score of 14. It has an Armor Class of 12, 1 hit point, and a speed of 10 ft. walking and 50 ft. flying. It has a Strength of 2, Constitution of 8, Intelligence of 2, Wisdom of 12, and Charisma of 6. The Raven has a proficiency bonus of 2 and a passive Perception of 13. It can mimic sounds with its Mimicry ability and attack with its Beak for 1 piercing damage. It is proficient in the Perception skill (Skill: Perception).

name: Rhinoceros

special_abilities.name: Charge
special_abilities.desc: If the rhinoceros moves at least 20 ft. straight toward a target and then hits it with a gore attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 9 (2d8) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Gore
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

content: The Rhinoceros is a Large beast with unaligned alignment, a natural armor class of 11, 45 hit points, and a 6d10+12 hit points roll. It has a walk speed of 40 ft., high strength of 21, low dexterity of 8, constitution of 15, wisdom of 12, and charisma of 6. With a proficiency bonus of 2, it has a challenge rating of 2 and provides 450 XP. Its passive perception is 11 and it has the special ability Charge, allowing it to deal extra bludgeoning damage with a gore attack. The Rhinoceros can use its Gore action to make a melee weapon attack with a +7 attack bonus, dealing 14 bludgeoning damage with 2d8+5 damage dice.

name: Riding Horse

actions.name: Hooves
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

content: The Riding Horse is a Large beast with unaligned alignment, an armor class of 10 based on dexterity, 13 hit points from 2d10 hit dice, a speed of 60 ft. for walking, and strength of 16, dexterity of 10, constitution of 12, intelligence of 2, wisdom of 11, and charisma of 7. It has a passive perception of 10 and proficiency bonus of 2, with 25 XP and a challenge rating of 0.25. The horse's only action is Hooves, a melee weapon attack with a +5 attack bonus that deals 8 bludgeoning damage (2d4+3).

name: Roc

special_abilities.name: Keen Sight
special_abilities.desc: The roc has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The roc makes two attacks: one with its beak and one with its talons.

actions.name: Beak
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 27 (4d8 + 9) piercing damage.

actions.name: Talons
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 23 (4d6 + 9) slashing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 19). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the roc can't use its talons on another target.

content: The Roc is a gargantuan monstrosity with unaligned alignment, boasting a natural armor class of 15 and an impressive 248 hit points derived from 16d20 hit dice. With a strength of 28, constitution of 20, and proficiency in saving throws for DEX, CON, WIS, and CHA, this creature excels in physical combat and perception. Its special ability, Keen Sight, grants advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks relying on sight. In battle, the Roc utilizes Multiattack to strike with its beak and talons, dealing piercing and slashing damage respectively. The Roc's talons can grapple targets with an escape DC of 19, restraining them until the grapple ends. With a challenge rating of 11, this formidable creature poses a significant threat, offering 7200 XP upon defeat.

name: Roper

special_abilities.name: False Appearance
special_abilities.desc: While the roper remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal cave formation, such as a stalagmite.

special_abilities.name: Grasping Tendrils
special_abilities.desc: The roper can have up to six tendrils at a time. Each tendril can be attacked (AC 20; 10 hit points; immunity to poison and psychic damage). Destroying a tendril deals no damage to the roper, which can extrude a replacement tendril on its next turn. A tendril can also be broken if a creature takes an action and succeeds on a DC 15 Strength check against it.

special_abilities.name: Spider Climb
special_abilities.desc: The roper can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The roper makes four attacks with its tendrils, uses Reel, and makes one attack with its bite.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (4d8 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Tendril
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 50 ft., one creature. Hit: The target is grappled (escape DC 15). Until the grapple ends, the target is restrained and has disadvantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws, and the roper can't use the same tendril on another target.

actions.name: Reel
actions.desc: The roper pulls each creature grappled by it up to 25 ft. straight toward it.

content: The Roper is a Large monstrosity with neutral evil alignment, boasting a natural armor class of 20 and 93 hit points. This creature has impressive Strength (18) and Wisdom (16) but lacks in Dexterity (8) and Charisma (6). It is proficient in Perception and Stealth skills. With special abilities like False Appearance and Grasping Tendrils, the Roper can blend in with cave formations and attack with up to six tendrils. Its actions include Multiattack, where it makes four tendril attacks, uses Reel, and bites with a +7 to hit. The Roper can also grapple targets with its tendrils and pull them towards itself with Reel. Known for its Spider Climb ability, this creature can scale difficult surfaces and move upside down on ceilings effortlessly.

name: Saber-Toothed Tiger

special_abilities.name: Keen Smell
special_abilities.desc: The tiger has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

special_abilities.name: Pounce
special_abilities.desc: If the tiger moves at least 20 ft. straight toward a creature and then hits it with a claw attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the tiger can make one bite attack against it as a bonus action.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d10 + 5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage.

content: The Saber-Toothed Tiger is a Large beast with unaligned alignment, 52 hit points, and a speed of 40 ft. It has an armor class of 12 based on dexterity, and its abilities include strength (18), dexterity (14), constitution (15), intelligence (3), wisdom (12), and charisma (8). Proficiencies in Perception (value: 3) and Stealth (value: 6) enhance its skills. With a passive perception of 13, the tiger has special abilities like Keen Smell and Pounce, which involve advantage on perception checks relying on smell and a chance to knock targets prone. Its actions include Bite (10 piercing damage) and Claw (12 slashing damage), both with a +6 attack bonus. This formidable creature has a challenge rating of 2 and proficiency bonus of 2, making it a dangerous opponent.

name: Rug of Smothering

special_abilities.name: Antimagic Susceptibility
special_abilities.desc: The rug is incapacitated while in the area of an antimagic field. If targeted by dispel magic, the rug must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the caster's spell save DC or fall unconscious for 1 minute.

special_abilities.name: Damage Transfer
special_abilities.desc: While it is grappling a creature, the rug takes only half the damage dealt to it, and the creature grappled by the rug takes the other half.

special_abilities.name: False Appearance
special_abilities.desc: While the rug remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal rug.

actions.name: Smother
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one Medium or smaller creature. Hit: The creature is grappled (escape DC 13). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, blinded, and at risk of suffocating, and the rug can't smother another target. In addition, at the start of each of the target's turns, the target takes 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

content: The Rug of Smothering is a Large construct with an armor class of 12, 33 hit points, and a speed of 10 ft. It has damage immunities to poison and psychic, as well as condition immunities to being blinded, charmed, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, and poisoned. With a strength of 17, dexterity of 14, and proficiency bonus of 2, it can make a Smother attack with a +5 attack bonus. Special abilities include Antimagic Susceptibility, Damage Transfer, and False Appearance. This challenging foe has a passive perception of 6 and a challenge rating of 2, making it a formidable opponent in combat.

name: Sahuagin

special_abilities.name: Blood Frenzy
special_abilities.desc: The sahuagin has advantage on melee attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its hit points.

special_abilities.name: Limited Amphibiousness
special_abilities.desc: The sahuagin can breathe air and water, but it needs to be submerged at least once every 4 hours to avoid suffocating.

special_abilities.name: Shark Telepathy
special_abilities.desc: The sahuagin can magically command any shark within 120 feet of it, using a limited telepathy.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The sahuagin makes two melee attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws or spear.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) slashing damage.

actions.name: Spear
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage, or 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

content: Sahuagin is a Medium humanoid creature with lawful evil alignment, having a natural armor class of 12 and 22 hit points from 4d8 hit dice. It has a speed of 30 ft. walking and 40 ft. swimming, with strength 13, dexterity 11, constitution 12, intelligence 12, wisdom 13, and charisma 9. This creature has proficiency in Perception skill with a bonus of 5 and passive perception of 15, along with abilities like Blood Frenzy granting advantage on melee attacks against wounded foes. Sahuagin can breathe air and water and has limited telepathy to command sharks within 120 feet. In combat, it can make two melee attacks with its bite and claws or spear. The bite attack has +3 to hit and deals 1d4+1 piercing damage, while claws deal 1d4+1 slashing damage, and the spear attack deals 1d6+1 or 1d8+1 piercing damage depending on usage.

name: Salamander
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons

special_abilities.name: Heated Body
special_abilities.desc: A creature that touches the salamander or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 ft. of it takes 7 (2d6) fire damage.

special_abilities.name: Heated Weapons
special_abilities.desc: Any metal melee weapon the salamander wields deals an extra 3 (1d6) fire damage on a hit (included in the attack).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The salamander makes two attacks: one with its spear and one with its tail.

actions.name: Spear
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20 ft./60 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage, or 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack, plus 3 (1d6) fire damage.

actions.name: Tail
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) fire damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 14). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, the salamander can automatically hit the target with its tail, and the salamander can't make tail attacks against other targets.

content: The Salamander is a Large elemental creature with a neutral evil alignment. It has a natural armor class of 15 and 90 hit points, with a hit dice of 12d10. The Salamander is resistant to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical weapons, immune to fire damage, and vulnerable to cold damage. It possesses darkvision up to 60 ft. and has a passive perception of 10. The Salamander's Heated Body ability inflicts fire damage on creatures that touch or attack it in melee. Additionally, its Heated Weapons ability grants extra fire damage to metal melee weapons it wields. In combat, the Salamander can make two attacks with its spear and tail, dealing piercing and bludgeoning damage along with fire damage. Its abilities, proficiency bonus of 3, and challenge rating of 5 make it a formidable foe in battle.

name: Scorpion

actions.name: Sting
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 1 piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 9 Constitution saving throw, taking 4 (1d8) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

content: The Scorpion is a Tiny beast with natural armor class of 11, 1 hit points, and a speed of 10 ft. It has low strength (2), average dexterity (11), below-average constitution (8), very low intelligence (1), low wisdom (8), and low charisma (2). It has blindsight of 10 ft. and passive perception of 9. The Scorpion has a proficiency bonus of 2 and an XP value of 10, with no specific proficiencies or damage vulnerabilities, resistances, or immunities. Its Sting action involves a +2 attack bonus, dealing 1 piercing damage and requiring a DC 9 Constitution saving throw for an additional 4 poison damage on a failed save.

name: Scout
desc: Scouts are skilled hunters and trackers who offer their services for a fee. Most hunt wild game, but a few work as bounty hunters, serve as guides, or provide military reconnaissance.

special_abilities.name: Keen Hearing and Sight
special_abilities.desc: The scout has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or sight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The scout makes two melee attacks or two ranged attacks.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, ranged 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.

content: Scout is a Medium humanoid of any race and alignment, proficient in Nature, Perception, Stealth, and Survival with a proficiency bonus of 2. With 16 hit points and a hit dice of 3d8, the scout wears Leather Armor with an armor class of 13. It has a passive perception of 15 and Keen Hearing and Sight, granting advantage on perception checks relying on hearing or sight. The scout's multiattack allows for two melee or ranged attacks using a Shortsword (1d6+2 piercing damage) or Longbow (1d8+2 piercing damage). It has a speed of 30 ft. and speaks any one language, usually Common, while possessing strengths in dexterity, wisdom, and constitution.

name: Sea Hag

special_abilities.name: Amphibious
special_abilities.desc: The hag can breathe air and water.

special_abilities.name: Horrific Appearance
special_abilities.desc:
Any humanoid that starts its turn within 30 feet of the hag and can see the hag's true form must make a DC 11 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is frightened for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, with disadvantage if the hag is within line of sight, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the hag's Horrific Appearance for the next 24 hours.
Unless the target is surprised or the revelation of the hag's true form is sudden, the target can avert its eyes and avoid making the initial saving throw. Until the start of its next turn, a creature that averts its eyes has disadvantage on attack rolls against the hag.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Death Glare
actions.desc: The hag targets one frightened creature she can see within 30 ft. of her. If the target can see the hag, it must succeed on a DC 11 Wisdom saving throw against this magic or drop to 0 hit points.

actions.name: Illusory Appearance
actions.desc:
The hag covers herself and anything she is wearing or carrying with a magical illusion that makes her look like an ugly creature of her general size and humanoid shape. The effect ends if the hag takes a bonus action to end it or if she dies.
The changes wrought by this effect fail to hold up to physical inspection. For example, the hag could appear to have no claws, but someone touching her hand might feel the claws. Otherwise, a creature must take an action to visually inspect the illusion and succeed on a DC 16 Intelligence (Investigation) check to discern that the hag is disguised.

content: Sea Hag, a Medium fey of chaotic evil alignment, possesses a natural armor class of 14 and 52 hit points with a hit dice of 7d8. With a walking speed of 30 ft. and swimming speed of 40 ft., this creature has strengths in strength, constitution, and charisma. Additionally, it has darkvision up to 60 ft., passive perception of 11, and speaks Aquan, Common, and Giant languages. Notable abilities include being amphibious, able to breathe air and water, and having a horrific appearance that can frighten humanoids within 30 ft. Actions include using claws to deal 10 slashing damage and using a death glare to potentially reduce a target to 0 hit points. Illusory Appearance allows the hag to disguise itself with a magical illusion, requiring a DC 16 Intelligence check to discern the deception. With a challenge rating of 2 and proficiency bonus of 2, the Sea Hag is a formidable foe worth 450 experience points.

name: Red Dragon Wyrmling

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) fire damage.

actions.name: Fire Breath
actions.desc: The dragon exhales fire in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC l3 Dexterity saving throw, taking 24 (7d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

content: The Red Dragon Wyrmling is a Medium-sized dragon with chaotic evil alignment, boasting an armor class of 17, 75 hit points, and a proficiency bonus of 2. It has a strength of 19, dexterity of 10, constitution of 17, intelligence of 12, wisdom of 11, and charisma of 15. This dragon is immune to fire damage and has darkvision up to 60 ft., with a passive perception of 14. It is proficient in saving throws for DEX, CON, WIS, and CHA, as well as in the skills of Perception and Stealth. The Red Dragon Wyrmling's actions include a Bite attack dealing piercing and fire damage, as well as a Fire Breath ability that can unleash fiery devastation in a cone, requiring a Dexterity saving throw. This dragon's challenge rating is 4, providing 1100 XP upon defeat.

name: Rust Monster

special_abilities.name: Iron Scent
special_abilities.desc: The rust monster can pinpoint, by scent, the location of ferrous metal within 30 feet of it.

special_abilities.name: Rust Metal
special_abilities.desc: Any nonmagical weapon made of metal that hits the rust monster corrodes. After dealing damage, the weapon takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to damage rolls. If its penalty drops to -5, the weapon is destroyed. Nonmagical ammunition made of metal that hits the rust monster is destroyed after dealing damage.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage.

actions.name: Antennae
actions.desc:
The rust monster corrodes a nonmagical ferrous metal object it can see within 5 feet of it. If the object isn't being worn or carried, the touch destroys a 1-foot cube of it. If the object is being worn or carried by a creature, the creature can make a DC 11 Dexterity saving throw to avoid the rust monster's touch.
If the object touched is either metal armor or a metal shield being worn or carried, its takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to the AC it offers. Armor reduced to an AC of 10 or a shield that drops to a +0 bonus is destroyed. If the object touched is a held metal weapon, it rusts as described in the Rust Metal trait.

content: The Rust Monster is a Medium-sized monstrosity with an armor class of 14. It has 27 hit points and a speed of 40 ft. Its abilities include Iron Scent, allowing it to sense ferrous metal within 30 ft, and Rust Metal, which corrodes nonmagical metal weapons upon contact. The Rust Monster can attack with its Bite, dealing 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage, and use its Antennae to corrode metal objects within 5 ft. It has darkvision up to 60 ft and a passive perception of 11. This creature is unaligned and has a challenge rating of 0.5. Its primary attributes are strength (13), dexterity (12), constitution (13), intelligence (2), wisdom (13), and charisma (6).

name: Sea Horse

special_abilities.name: Water Breathing
special_abilities.desc: The sea horse can breathe only underwater.

content: The Sea Horse is a Tiny beast with unaligned alignment, having a dexterity of 12 and a passive perception of 10. It has 11 armor class based on dexterity, 1 hit point with a 1d4 hit dice, and a swim speed of 20 ft. This creature has low strength, constitution, intelligence, wisdom, and charisma scores, making it weak in combat. It is immune to damage, resistant to conditions, and proficient in no skills. Its Water Breathing special ability allows it to breathe only underwater. The sea horse poses no challenge with a challenge rating of 0 and a proficiency bonus of 2, yielding no experience points when defeated.

name: Shield Guardian
languages: understands commands given in any language but can't speak

special_abilities.name: Bound
special_abilities.desc: The shield guardian is magically bound to an amulet. As long as the guardian and its amulet are on the same plane of existence, the amulet's wearer can telepathically call the guardian to travel to it, and the guardian knows the distance and direction to the amulet. If the guardian is within 60 feet of the amulet's wearer, half of any damage the wearer takes (rounded up) is transferred to the guardian.

special_abilities.name: Regeneration
special_abilities.desc: The shield guardian regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hit. point.

special_abilities.name: Spell Storing
special_abilities.desc: A spellcaster who wears the shield guardian's amulet can cause the guardian to store one spell of 4th level or lower. To do so, the wearer must cast the spell on the guardian. The spell has no effect but is stored within the guardian. When commanded to do so by the wearer or when a situation arises that was predefined by the spellcaster, the guardian casts the stored spell with any parameters set by the original caster, requiring no components. When the spell is cast or a new spell is stored, any previously stored spell is lost.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The guardian makes two fist attacks.

actions.name: Fist
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

reactions.name: Shield
reactions.desc: When a creature makes an attack against the wearer of the guardian's amulet, the guardian grants a +2 bonus to the wearer's AC if the guardian is within 5 feet of the wearer.

content: The Shield Guardian is a Large construct with an armor class of 17 and 142 hit points, proficient in Multiattack with Fist attacks dealing 11 bludgeoning damage. It has a strength of 18, constitution of 18, and immunity to poison damage. The guardian is bound to an amulet, regenerates 10 hit points at the start of its turn, and can store spells cast on it by a spellcaster. Additionally, it can react by providing a +2 AC bonus to the wearer of its amulet within 5 feet. The Shield Guardian has darkvision, blindsight, and immunity to conditions like charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, and poisoned. Its passive perception is 10, and it understands all languages but cannot speak, with a proficiency bonus of 3 and a challenge rating of 7.

name: Shambling Mound

special_abilities.name: Lightning Absorption
special_abilities.desc: Whenever the shambling mound is subjected to lightning damage, it takes no damage and regains a number of hit points equal to the lightning damage dealt.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The shambling mound makes two slam attacks. If both attacks hit a Medium or smaller target, the target is grappled (escape DC 14), and the shambling mound uses its Engulf on it.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Engulf
actions.desc: The shambling mound engulfs a Medium or smaller creature grappled by it. The engulfed target is blinded, restrained, and unable to breathe, and it must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw at the start of each of the mound's turns or take 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage. If the mound moves, the engulfed target moves with it. The mound can have only one creature engulfed at a time.

content: The Shambling Mound is a Large plant creature with an unaligned alignment, an armor class of 15, 136 hit points, and a speed of 20 ft. walking and swimming. It has a strength of 18, dexterity of 8, constitution of 16, intelligence of 5, wisdom of 10, and charisma of 5. The creature is proficient in Stealth with a value of 2 and has damage resistances to cold and fire, as well as immunity to lightning damage. It is immune to being blinded and exhaustion. The Shambling Mound has blindsight for 60 ft. and a passive perception of 10. It has a challenge rating of 5, proficiency bonus of 3, and special ability called Lightning Absorption. In combat, it can make two slam attacks and engulf targets if they are Medium or smaller. Its slam attack has an attack bonus of +7 and deals 13 bludgeoning damage. The creature can also engulf a grappled target, causing blindness, restraint, and suffocation.

name: Shadow
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons

special_abilities.name: Amorphous
special_abilities.desc: The shadow can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

special_abilities.name: Shadow Stealth
special_abilities.desc: While in dim light or darkness, the shadow can take the Hide action as a bonus action. Its stealth bonus is also improved to +6.

special_abilities.name: Sunlight Weakness
special_abilities.desc: While in sunlight, the shadow has disadvantage on attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws.

actions.name: Strength Drain
actions.desc:
Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) necrotic damage, and the target's Strength score is reduced by 1d4. The target dies if this reduces its Strength to 0. Otherwise, the reduction lasts until the target finishes a short or long rest.
If a non-evil humanoid dies from this attack, a new shadow rises from the corpse 1d4 hours later.

content: Shadow is a Medium undead creature with chaotic evil alignment, having a Dexterity armor class of 12 and hit points of 16. It has a speed of 40 ft., and damage vulnerabilities to radiant attacks. The shadow is resistant to acid, cold, fire, lightning, thunder, and nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing weapons, while being immune to necrotic and poison damage. It is immune to various conditions like exhaustion, frightened, and paralyzed, and has darkvision of 60 ft. with a passive perception of 10. This creature has a challenge rating of 0.5 and proficiency bonus of 2, with special abilities including Amorphous, Shadow Stealth, and Sunlight Weakness. Its main action is Strength Drain, dealing necrotic damage and reducing the target's Strength score.

name: Satyr

special_abilities.name: Magic Resistance
special_abilities.desc: The satyr has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Ram
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (2d4 + 1) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1 d6 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Shortbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

content: The Satyr is a Medium fey creature with chaotic neutral alignment, wearing Leather Armor granting an armor class of 14. It has 31 hit points, 7d8 hit dice, and a speed of 40 ft. with strengths in dexterity and charisma. Proficient in Perception, Performance, and Stealth skills, the Satyr has Magic Resistance, granting advantage against magical effects. It can attack with a Ram, Shortsword, or Shortbow, with varying damage types and bonuses. Additionally, it has passive perception of 12, knows Common, Elvish, and Sylvan languages, and has a challenge rating of 0.5.

name: Shrieker

special_abilities.name: False Appearance
special_abilities.desc: While the shrieker remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary fungus.

reactions.name: Shriek
reactions.desc: When bright light or a creature is within 30 feet of the shrieker, it emits a shriek audible within 300 feet of it. The shrieker continues to shriek until the disturbance moves out of range and for 1d4 of the shrieker's turns afterward

content: The Shrieker is a Medium-sized plant creature with unaligned alignment, an armor class of 5 based on dexterity, 13 hit points, and 3d8 hit dice. It has a speed of 0 ft. and is weak in strength, dexterity, and charisma, but has average constitution, intelligence, and high wisdom. The Shrieker is immune to being blinded and frightened, has blindsight for 30 ft., passive perception of 6, and a proficiency bonus of 2. It has a special ability called False Appearance where it can appear as an ordinary fungus when motionless. The Shrieker can emit a shriek audible within 300 feet when in bright light or near a creature within 30 feet, continuing to shriek for a duration of 1d4 turns afterward. Its challenge rating is 0, with an XP value of 10.

name: Specter
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons
languages: understands all languages it knew in life but can't speak

special_abilities.name: Incorporeal Movement
special_abilities.desc: The specter can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

special_abilities.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
special_abilities.desc: While in sunlight, the specter has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: Life Drain
actions.desc: Melee Spell Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 10 (3d6) necrotic damage. The target must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or its hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. This reduction lasts until the creature finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0.

content: Specter is a Medium undead creature with chaotic evil alignment and an armor class of 12. It has 22 hit points, a hit dice of 5d8, and a fly speed of 50 ft. with the ability to hover. Specter is immune to necrotic and poison damage, resistant to acid, cold, fire, lightning, thunder, and nonmagical weapon attacks, and has condition immunities like charmed, exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, and unconscious. It has darkvision of 60 ft., passive perception of 10, and understands all languages but cannot speak. Specter has a challenge rating of 1 and a proficiency bonus of 2, granting it special abilities like Incorporeal Movement and Sunlight Sensitivity. Its main action is Life Drain, dealing 10 necrotic damage on a successful attack and reducing the target's hit point maximum on a failed Constitution saving throw.

name: Silver Dragon Wyrmling

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Breath Weapons
actions.desc:
The dragon uses one of the following breath weapons.
Cold Breath. The dragon exhales an icy blast in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw, taking 18 (4d8) cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
Paralyzing Breath. The dragon exhales paralyzing gas in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be paralyzed for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

content: The Silver Dragon Wyrmling is a Medium dragon with lawful good alignment, boasting a natural armor class of 17 and 45 hit points. It has a speed of 30 ft. walking and 60 ft. flying, with notable strengths in strength, constitution, and charisma. Proficient in Dexterity, Constitution, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws, as well as Perception and Stealth skills, this dragon is immune to cold damage and has darkvision up to 60 ft. Its actions include a Bite attack dealing 1d10 + 4 piercing damage and Breath Weapons offering cold and paralyzing breath options, each with their own effects and saving throws. With a challenge rating of 2 and an XP value of 450, the Silver Dragon Wyrmling is a formidable foe to encounter in Draconic language.

name: Spider

special_abilities.name: Spider Climb
special_abilities.desc: The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

special_abilities.name: Web Sense
special_abilities.desc: While in contact with a web, the spider knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

special_abilities.name: Web Walker
special_abilities.desc: The spider ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 1 piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 9 Constitution saving throw or take 2 (1d4) poison damage.

content: The Spider is a Tiny beast with unaligned alignment and a Dexterity armor class of 12. It has 1 hit point, a hit dice of 1d4, and a speed of 20 ft. for both walking and climbing. With a Strength of 2, Dexterity of 14, Constitution of 8, Intelligence of 1, Wisdom of 10, and Charisma of 2, it excels in stealth with a proficiency bonus of 2. The spider has darkvision of 30 ft. and a passive perception of 12. It is immune to poison damage and has special abilities like Spider Climb, Web Sense, and Web Walker. Its Bite attack has a +4 attack bonus, dealing 1 piercing damage and potentially 2 poison damage on a failed Constitution saving throw.

name: Solar
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons

special_abilities.name: Angelic Weapons
special_abilities.desc: The solar's weapon attacks are magical. When the solar hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra 6d8 radiant damage (included in the attack).

special_abilities.name: Divine Awareness
special_abilities.desc: The solar knows if it hears a lie.

special_abilities.name: Innate Spellcasting
special_abilities.desc:
The solar's spell casting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 25). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: detect evil and good, invisibility (self only)
3/day each: blade barrier, dispel evil and good, resurrection
1/day each: commune, control weather

special_abilities.name: Magic Resistance
special_abilities.desc: The solar has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The solar makes two greatsword attacks.

actions.name: Greatsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +15 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (4d6 + 8) slashing damage plus 27 (6d8) radiant damage.

actions.name: Slaying Longbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) piercing damage plus 27 (6d8) radiant damage. If the target is a creature that has 190 hit points or fewer, it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or die.

actions.name: Flying Sword
actions.desc: The solar releases its greatsword to hover magically in an unoccupied space within 5 ft. of it. If the solar can see the sword, the solar can mentally command it as a bonus action to fly up to 50 ft. and either make one attack against a target or return to the solar's hands. If the hovering sword is targeted by any effect, the solar is considered to be holding it. The hovering sword falls if the solar dies.

actions.name: Healing Touch
actions.desc: The solar touches another creature. The target magically regains 40 (8d8 + 4) hit points and is freed from any curse, disease, poison, blindness, or deafness.

legendary_actions.name: Teleport
legendary_actions.desc: The solar magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 120 ft. to an unoccupied space it can see.

legendary_actions.name: Searing Burst (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: The solar emits magical, divine energy. Each creature of its choice in a 10 -foot radius must make a DC 23 Dexterity saving throw, taking 14 (4d6) fire damage plus 14 (4d6) radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

legendary_actions.name: Blinding Gaze (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: The solar targets one creature it can see within 30 ft. of it. If the target can see it, the target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until magic such as the lesser restoration spell removes the blindness.

content: The Solar is a Large celestial being with lawful good alignment, boasting an impressive armor class of 21, 243 hit points, and high ability scores including strength, dexterity, constitution, intelligence, wisdom, and charisma. It is proficient in saving throws for intelligence, wisdom, and charisma, as well as in the Perception skill. The Solar is resistant to radiant damage and nonmagical weapon attacks, immune to necrotic and poison damage, and possesses condition immunities including being charmed, exhausted, frightened, and poisoned. This celestial creature has truesight up to 120 feet, passive perception of 24, and can speak all languages with telepathy up to 120 feet. With a challenge rating of 21, the Solar has special abilities such as Angelic Weapons for extra radiant damage, Divine Awareness for detecting lies, and Magic Resistance for advantage against magical effects. Its innate spellcasting abilities allow it to cast various spells like detect evil and good, invisibility, blade barrier, dispel evil and good, resurrection, commune, and control weather. In combat, the Solar can make multiattacks with its greatsword, use a slaying longbow, command a flying sword, and perform healing touch. Additionally, it has legendary actions including teleportation, searing burst with fire and radiant damage, and blinding gaze to blind targets.

name: Spy
desc: Rulers, nobles, merchants, guildmasters, and other wealthy individuals use spies to gain the upper hand in a world of cutthroat politics. A spy is trained to secretly gather information. Loyal spies would rather die than divulge information that could compromise them or their employers.

special_abilities.name: Cunning Action
special_abilities.desc: On each of its turns, the spy can use a bonus action to take the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

special_abilities.name: Sneak Attack (1/Turn)
special_abilities.desc: The spy deals an extra 7 (2d6) damage when it hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 ft. of an ally of the spy that isn't incapacitated and the spy doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The spy makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Hand Crossbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

content: The Spy is a Medium humanoid creature of any race and alignment, with a Dexterity armor class of 12, 27 hit points, and a walk speed of 30 ft. This skilled individual has proficiency in deception, insight, investigation, perception, persuasion, and stealth, as well as a passive perception of 16. With a proficiency bonus of 2 and XP of 200, the Spy possesses special abilities like Cunning Action and Sneak Attack, enabling it to take bonus actions and deal extra damage in combat. In battle, the Spy can make two melee attacks with a shortsword, hitting with a +4 attack bonus and dealing 5 piercing damage, or use a hand crossbow for ranged attacks. This versatile creature is adept at gathering information covertly and excels in cutthroat politics, making it a valuable asset in any campaign.

name: Sprite

actions.name: Longsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 slashing damage.

actions.name: Shortbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 40/160 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or become poisoned for 1 minute. If its saving throw result is 5 or lower, the poisoned target falls unconscious for the same duration, or until it takes damage or another creature takes an action to shake it awake.

actions.name: Heart Sight
actions.desc: The sprite touches a creature and magically knows the creature's current emotional state. If the target fails a DC 10 Charisma saving throw, the sprite also knows the creature's alignment. Celestials, fiends, and undead automatically fail the saving throw.

actions.name: Invisibility
actions.desc: The sprite magically turns invisible until it attacks or casts a spell, or until its concentration ends (as if concentrating on a spell). Any equipment the sprite wears or carries is invisible with it.

content: Sprite is a tiny fey creature with neutral good alignment, wearing Leather Armor for an armor class of 15. It has 2 hit points, a speed of 10 ft. walking and 40 ft. flying, and excels in dexterity and intelligence with scores of 18 and 14 respectively. With a proficiency bonus of 2, it is proficient in Perception and Stealth skills. In combat, Sprite can use a Longsword or Shortbow for 1 slashing or piercing damage respectively. It also possesses the abilities of Heart Sight to sense emotions and Invisibility to disappear from sight until attacking or casting a spell. Additionally, it has passive perception of 13, speaks Common, Elvish, and Sylvan, and has a challenge rating of 0.25.

name: Spirit Naga

special_abilities.name: Rejuvenation
special_abilities.desc: If it dies, the naga returns to life in 1d6 days and regains all its hit points. Only a wish spell can prevent this trait from functioning.

special_abilities.name: Spellcasting
special_abilities.desc:
The naga is a 10th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks), and it needs only verbal components to cast its spells. It has the following wizard spells prepared:

- Cantrips (at will): mage hand, minor illusion, ray of frost
- 1st level (4 slots): charm person, detect magic, sleep
- 2nd level (3 slots): detect thoughts, hold person
- 3rd level (3 slots): lightning bolt, water breathing
- 4th level (3 slots): blight, dimension door
- 5th level (2 slots): dominate person

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw, taking 31 (7d8) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

content: The Spirit Naga is a Large monstrosity creature with chaotic evil alignment, an armor class of 15, 75 hit points, and a speed of 40 ft. It has strong abilities in strength, dexterity, constitution, intelligence, wisdom, and charisma. Proficient in saving throws for dexterity, constitution, wisdom, and charisma, it also possesses damage immunities to poison and condition immunities to being charmed and poisoned. With darkvision of 60 ft. and passive perception of 12, it speaks Abyssal and Common languages. At challenge rating 8, it has special abilities including Rejuvenation and Spellcasting as a 10th-level spellcaster with a spell save DC of 14 and +6 to hit with spell attacks using verbal components. Its spell repertoire includes various spells such as mage hand, charm person, lightning bolt, and dominate person. In combat, it can use its Bite action to deal piercing and poison damage.

name: Steam Mephit

special_abilities.name: Death Burst
special_abilities.desc: When the mephit dies, it explodes in a cloud of steam. Each creature within 5 ft. of the mephit must succeed on a DC 10 Dexterity saving throw or take 4 (1d8) fire damage.

special_abilities.name: Innate Spellcasting
special_abilities.desc: The mephit can innately cast blur, requiring no material components. Its innate spellcasting ability is Charisma.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 2 (1d4) slashing damage plus 2 (1d4) fire damage.

actions.name: Steam Breath
actions.desc: The mephit exhales a 15-foot cone of scalding steam. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 10 Dexterity saving throw, taking 4 (1d8) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

content: The Steam Mephit is a Small elemental creature with neutral evil alignment, 21 hit points, and a challenge rating of 0.25. It has a proficiency bonus of 2 and languages Aquan and Ignan. This mephit has damage immunities to fire and poison, as well as darkvision up to 60 ft. Its special abilities include Death Burst, where it explodes in a cloud of steam upon death, dealing fire damage to nearby creatures, and Innate Spellcasting of blur using Charisma as its spellcasting ability. The mephit's actions include Claws, a melee attack that deals slashing and fire damage, and Steam Breath, which exhales scalding steam in a cone, causing fire damage. The mephit's senses include passive perception of 10, and its speed is 30 ft. for both walking and flying.

name: Stone Golem
damage_immunities: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons that aren't adamantine
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

special_abilities.name: Immutable Form
special_abilities.desc: The golem is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

special_abilities.name: Magic Resistance
special_abilities.desc: The golem has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

special_abilities.name: Magic Weapons
special_abilities.desc: The golem's weapon attacks are magical.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The golem makes two slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Slow
actions.desc: The golem targets one or more creatures it can see within 10 ft. of it. Each target must make a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw against this magic. On a failed save, a target can't use reactions, its speed is halved, and it can't make more than one attack on its turn. In addition, the target can take either an action or a bonus action on its turn, not both. These effects last for 1 minute. A target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

content: The Stone Golem is a Large construct with an armor class of 17, 178 hit points, and a speed of 30 ft. It has high strength (22), constitution (20), and low charisma (1) and intelligence (3). The golem is immune to poison, psychic damage, and nonmagical weapon attacks. It is also immune to conditions like charmed, paralyzed, and petrified. With darkvision of 120 ft., the golem has advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects. Its actions include a Multiattack with two slam attacks and a Slow ability that targets creatures within 10 ft. The golem's Slam attack has a +10 to hit and deals 19 bludgeoning damage. It understands its creator's language but cannot speak and is proficient in saving throws. The Stone Golem's challenge rating is 10, with special abilities like Immutable Form and Magic Weapons.

name: Stone Giant

special_abilities.name: Stone Camouflage
special_abilities.desc: The giant has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in rocky terrain.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The giant makes two greatclub attacks.

actions.name: Greatclub
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Rock
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. Hit: 28 (4d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 17 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

reactions.name: Rock Catching
reactions.desc: If a rock or similar object is hurled at the giant, the giant can, with a successful DC 10 Dexterity saving throw, catch the missile and take no bludgeoning damage from it.

content: Stone Giant is a Huge giant with neutral alignment, having a natural armor class of 17 and 126 hit points. With a strength of 23, dexterity of 15, and constitution of 20, it excels in skills like Saving Throw: DEX (proficiency value of 5), Saving Throw: CON (proficiency value of 8), Skill: Athletics (proficiency value of 12), and more. This creature possesses Stone Camouflage, granting advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks in rocky terrain. In combat, it utilizes Multiattack to make two greatclub attacks and wields a Greatclub for melee attacks with an attack bonus of +9, dealing 19 bludgeoning damage. Additionally, it can throw Rocks with an attack bonus of +9, inflicting 28 bludgeoning damage and potentially knocking the target prone on a failed saving throw. Notably, the Stone Giant can catch thrown objects with Rock Catching, showcasing its agility. Its senses include darkvision up to 60 ft. and a passive perception of 14, while its languages are in Giant. This formidable creature has a challenge rating of 7 and proficiently navigates its environment with a speed of 40 ft. on foot.

name: Storm Giant

special_abilities.name: Amphibious
special_abilities.desc: The giant can breathe air and water.

special_abilities.name: Innate Spellcasting
special_abilities.desc:
The giant's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 17). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

At will: detect magic, feather fall, levitate, light
3/day each: control weather, water breathing

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The giant makes two greatsword attacks.

actions.name: Greatsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 30 (6d6 + 9) slashing damage.

actions.name: Rock
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. Hit: 35 (4d12 + 9) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Lightning Strike
actions.desc: The giant hurls a magical lightning bolt at a point it can see within 500 feet of it. Each creature within 10 feet of that point must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw, taking 54 (12d8) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

content: The Storm Giant is a Huge giant with chaotic good alignment, boasting 230 hit points and impressive abilities such as Amphibiousness and Innate Spellcasting with spells like detect magic and control weather. Its armor class is 16 with Scale Mail, and it has damage resistances to cold, immunities to lightning and thunder, and proficiency in skills like Athletics and Perception. In combat, it can make two Greatsword attacks or hurl rocks for significant damage, and use Lightning Strike to unleash a powerful lightning bolt. With high strength, wisdom, and charisma, the Storm Giant poses a challenge rating of 13 and offers a proficiency bonus of 5, making it a formidable foe in any encounter.

name: Stirge

actions.name: Blood Drain
actions.desc:
Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage, and the stirge attaches to the target. While attached, the stirge doesn't attack. Instead, at the start of each of the stirge's turns, the target loses 5 (1d4 + 3) hit points due to blood loss.
The stirge can detach itself by spending 5 feet of its movement. It does so after it drains 10 hit points of blood from the target or the target dies. A creature, including the target, can use its action to detach the stirge.

content: The Stirge is a Tiny beast with unaligned alignment, an armor class of 14, 2 hit points, and a challenge rating of 0.125. It has a walk speed of 10 ft. and a fly speed of 40 ft., with darkvision up to 60 ft. and a passive perception of 9. The Stirge has a strength of 4, dexterity of 16, constitution of 11, intelligence of 2, wisdom of 8, and charisma of 6. Its main action is the Blood Drain, a melee attack with +5 to hit, dealing 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage and attaching to the target. The Stirge can detach itself by spending 5 feet of movement after draining 10 hit points of blood or if the target dies. It has proficiency bonus of 2 and an XP value of 25.

name: Succubus/Incubus
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons

special_abilities.name: Telepathic Bond
special_abilities.desc: The fiend ignores the range restriction on its telepathy when communicating with a creature it has charmed. The two don't even need to be on the same plane of existence.

special_abilities.name: Shapechanger
special_abilities.desc: The fiend can use its action to polymorph into a Small or Medium humanoid, or back into its true form. Without wings, the fiend loses its flying speed. Other than its size and speed, its statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

actions.name: Claw (Fiend Form Only)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Charm
actions.desc:
One humanoid the fiend can see within 30 feet of it must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be magically charmed for 1 day. The charmed target obeys the fiend's verbal or telepathic commands. If the target suffers any harm or receives a suicidal command, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on a success. If the target successfully saves against the effect, or if the effect on it ends, the target is immune to this fiend's Charm for the next 24 hours.
The fiend can have only one target charmed at a time. If it charms another, the effect on the previous target ends.

actions.name: Draining Kiss
actions.desc: The fiend kisses a creature charmed by it or a willing creature. The target must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw against this magic, taking 32 (5d10 + 5) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The target's hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0.

actions.name: Etherealness
actions.desc: The fiend magically enters the Ethereal Plane from the Material Plane, or vice versa.

content: Succubus/Incubus is a Medium fiend with a natural armor class of 15, 66 hit points, and a proficiency bonus of 2. It has a speed of 30 ft. walking and 60 ft. flying, with strengths in dexterity, charisma, and proficiency in skills like Deception, Insight, Perception, Persuasion, and Stealth. This neutral evil shapechanger is resistant to cold, fire, lightning, poison, and nonmagical weapon attacks and has darkvision up to 60 ft. It can communicate telepathically, charm humanoid targets, and use Etherealness to move between planes. The fiend can also polymorph, with its Claw attack dealing 6 slashing damage and its Draining Kiss inflicting 32 psychic damage and reducing the target's hit point maximum until a long rest.
